16.130.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ pāśupateśvaram ..
ugraseneśvarāddevi pūrvabhāge vyavasthitam .. 1 ..
16.130.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवं पाशुपतेश्वरम् ..
उग्रसेनेश्वराद्देवि पूर्वभागे व्यवस्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.130.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the god Pāśupateśvara, / situated to the east of Ugraseneśvara, O goddess.

16.130.s:
gopādityāttathāgneyyāṃ dhruveśāddakṣiṇāṃ śritam ..
sarvapāpaharaṃ devi pūrvabhāge vyavasthitam .. 2 ..
16.130.d:
गोपादित्यात्तथाग्नेय्यां ध्रुवेशाद्दक्षिणां श्रितम् ..
सर्वपापहरं देवि पूर्वभागे व्यवस्थितम् .. 2 ..
16.130.m: Likewise in the southeast from Gopāditya, situated to the south from Dhruveśa, / removing all sins, O goddess, situated in the eastern quarter.

16.130.s:
gopādityāttathā liṃgaṃ darśanātsarvakāmadam ..
asminyuge samākhyātaṃ saṃtoṣeśvarasaṃjñitam .. 3 ..
16.130.d:
गोपादित्यात्तथा लिंगं दर्शनात्सर्वकामदम् ..
अस्मिन्युगे समाख्यातं संतोषेश्वरसंज्ञितम् .. 3 ..
16.130.m: Likewise, from Gopāditya, the liṅga grants all desires upon darśana; / in this yuga it is celebrated by the name Saṃtoṣeśvara.

16.130.s:
saṃtuṣṭo bhagavānyasmātteṣāṃ tatra tapasvinām ..
tena saṃtoṣanāmnā tu prakhyātaṃ dharaṇītale .. 4 ..
16.130.d:
संतुष्टो भगवान्यस्मात्तेषां तत्र तपस्विनाम् ..
तेन संतोषनाम्ना तु प्रख्यातं धरणीतले .. 4 ..
16.130.m: Because the Lord was pleased there with those ascetics, / therefore it is renowned on the face of the earth by the name Saṃtoṣa.

16.130.s:
yugaliṃgaṃ mahādevi siddhisthānaṃ mahāprabham ..
sthānaṃ pāśupatānāṃ ca bheṣajaṃ pāparogiṇām .. 5 ..
16.130.d:
युगलिंगं महादेवि सिद्धिस्थानं महाप्रभम् ..
स्थानं पाशुपतानां च भेषजं पापरोगिणाम् .. 5 ..
16.130.m: It is a liṅga of the yuga, O great goddess, an abode of perfections of great radiance, / the seat of the Pāśupatas, and medicine for those afflicted with the disease of sin.

16.130.s:
catvāro munayaḥ siddhāstasmim̐lliṃge yaśasvini..
vāmadevastu sāvarṇiraghoraḥ kapilastathā..
tasmim̐lliṃge tu saṃsiddhā anādīśe niraṃjane..6..
16.130.d:
चत्वारो मुनयः सिद्धास्तस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे यशस्विनि..
वामदेवस्तु सावर्णिरघोरः कपिलस्तथा..
तस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे तु संसिद्धा अनादीशे निरंजने..6..
16.130.m: Four sages attained perfection at that liṅga, O illustrious lady: / Vāmadeva, Sāvarṇi, Aghora, and Kapila— / they attained perfection at that liṅga, Anādīśa, the taintless one.

16.130.s:
tasya devasya sāmīpye vane śrīmukhasaṃjñitam..
lakṣmīsthānaṃ mahādevi siddhayogaistu sevitam..7..
16.130.d:
तस्य देवस्य सामीप्ये वने श्रीमुखसंज्ञितम्..
लक्ष्मीस्थानं महादेवि सिद्धयोगैस्तु सेवितम्..7..
16.130.m: Near that god, in the forest known as Śrīmukha, / is the abode of Lakṣmī, O great goddess, frequented by those with perfected yoga.

16.130.s:
tatra pāśupatāḥ śreṣṭhā mama liṃgārcane ratāḥ..
teṣāṃ caiva nivāsārthaṃ taddevyā nirmitaṃ vanam .. 8 ..
16.130.d:
तत्र पाशुपताः श्रेष्ठा मम लिंगार्चने रताः..
तेषां चैव निवासार्थं तद्देव्या निर्मितं वनम् .. 8 ..
16.130.m: There the excellent Pāśupatas are devoted to the worship of my liṅga; / and for their dwelling, that forest was created by the goddess.

16.130.s:
tasya madhye tu suśroṇi liṃgaṃ pūrvamukhaṃ sthitam ..
tasminpāśupatāḥ siddhā aghorādyā maharṣayaḥ ..
anenaiva śarīreṇa gatāste śivamandiram .. 9 ..
16.130.d:
तस्य मध्ये तु सुश्रोणि लिंगं पूर्वमुखं स्थितम् ..
तस्मिन्पाशुपताः सिद्धा अघोराद्या महर्षयः ..
अनेनैव शरीरेण गतास्ते शिवमन्दिरम् .. 9 ..
16.130.m: In the midst of it, O fair-hipped lady, stands an east-facing liṅga; / there the Pāśupatas attained perfection, the great seers Aghora and the rest; / in this very body they went to Śiva's abode.

16.130.s:
tatra prābhāsike kṣetre surasiddhaniṣevite ..
rocate me sadā vāsastasminnāyatane śubhe ..
sarveṣāmeva sthānānāmatiramyamatipriyam .. 7.1.130.10 ..
16.130.d:
तत्र प्राभासिके क्षेत्रे सुरसिद्धनिषेविते ..
रोचते मे सदा वासस्तस्मिन्नायतने शुभे ..
सर्वेषामेव स्थानानामतिरम्यमतिप्रियम् .. 7.1.130.10 ..
16.130.m: There, in the sacred field of Prabhāsa, frequented by gods and Siddhas, / I ever delight in dwelling in that auspicious sanctuary, / most delightful, most dear among all abodes.

16.130.s:
tatra pāśupatā devi mama dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ ..
mama putrāstu te sarve brahmacaryeṇa saṃyutāḥ .. 11 ..
16.130.d:
तत्र पाशुपता देवि मम ध्यानपरायणाः ..
मम पुत्रास्तु ते सर्वे ब्रह्मचर्येण संयुताः .. 11 ..
16.130.m: There the Pāśupatas, O goddess, are wholly devoted to meditation upon me; / and all of them, endowed with celibacy, are my sons.

16.130.s:
dāntāḥ śāṃtā jitakrodhā brāhmaṇāste tapasvinaḥ ..
talliṃgasya prabhāvena siddhiṃ te paramāṃ gatāḥ .. 12 ..
16.130.d:
दान्ताः शांता जितक्रोधा ब्राह्मणास्ते तपस्विनः ..
तल्लिंगस्य प्रभावेन सिद्धिं ते परमां गताः .. 12 ..
16.130.m: Self-controlled, tranquil, with anger subdued, those brahmins are ascetic; / by the power of that liṅga, they attained supreme perfection.

16.130.s: tasmāttaṃ pūjayennityaṃ kṣetravāsī dvijottamaḥ .. 13 ..
16.130.d: तस्मात्तं पूजयेन्नित्यं क्षेत्रवासी द्विजोत्तमः .. 13 ..
16.130.m: Therefore the best of the twice-born residing in the sacred field should worship it constantly.

16.130.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
bhagavandevadeveśa saṃsārārṇavatāraka ..
prabhāse tu mahākṣetre tvadīyavratacāriṇām .. 14 ..
16.130.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
भगवन्देवदेवेश संसारार्णवतारक ..
प्रभासे तु महाक्षेत्रे त्वदीयव्रतचारिणाम् .. 14 ..
16.130.m: The Goddess said: / O Lord, O Lord of the gods, who ferry across the ocean of saṃsāra, / in the great sacred field of Prabhāsa, of those observing your vow,

16.130.s:
sthānaṃ teṣāṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ yogaṃ pāśupataṃ tathā ..
kathayasva prasādena liṃgamāhātmyamuttamam .. 15 ..
16.130.d:
स्थानं तेषां महत्पुण्यं योगं पाशुपतं तथा ..
कथयस्व प्रसादेन लिंगमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् .. 15 ..
16.130.m: their great holy abode, as well as the Pāśupata yoga, / tell me by your grace, [and] the supreme māhātmya of the liṅga.

16.130.s:
kimādināma devasya kathaṃ pūjyo narottamaiḥ ..
kathaṃ pāśupatāstatra sadehāḥ svargamāgatāḥ ..16..
16.130.d:
किमादिनाम देवस्य कथं पूज्यो नरोत्तमैः ..
कथं पाशुपतास्तत्र सदेहाः स्वर्गमागताः ..16..
16.130.m: What is the primordial name of the god? How is he to be worshipped by the best of men? / How did the Pāśupatas go to heaven there with their bodies?

16.130.s: etatkathaya deveśa dayāṃ kṛtvā mama prabho .. 17 ..
16.130.d: एतत्कथय देवेश दयां कृत्वा मम प्रभो .. 17 ..
16.130.m: Tell me this, O Lord of the gods, having shown compassion to me, O master.

16.130.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
yastvayā pṛchyate bhadre yogaḥ pāśupato mahān ..
teṣāṃ caiva prabhāvo yastathā liṃgasya suvrate .. 18 ..
16.130.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
यस्त्वया पृछ्यते भद्रे योगः पाशुपतो महान् ..
तेषां चैव प्रभावो यस्तथा लिंगस्य सुव्रते .. 18 ..
16.130.m: Īśvara said: / The great Pāśupata yoga that is inquired about by you, O auspicious one, / and what the power of those [ascetics] is, as well as of the liṅga, O lady of good vows—

16.130.s:
anādīśasya devasya ādināma mahāprabhe ..
tasmim̐lliṃge tu ye devi madīyavratamāśritāḥ .. 19 ..
16.130.d:
अनादीशस्य देवस्य आदिनाम महाप्रभे ..
तस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे तु ये देवि मदीयव्रतमाश्रिताः .. 19 ..
16.130.m: the primordial name of the god of great radiance is Anādīśa; / and at that liṅga, O goddess, those who have taken refuge in my vow,

16.130.s:
ciraṃ niyogaṃ suśroṇi vrataṃ pāśupataṃ mahat ..
dhārayaṃti yathoktaṃ tu mama vismayakārakam ..
teṣāmanugrahārthāya mama cittaṃ pradhāvati .. 7.1.130.20 ..
16.130.d:
चिरं नियोगं सुश्रोणि व्रतं पाशुपतं महत् ..
धारयंति यथोक्तं तु मम विस्मयकारकम् ..
तेषामनुग्रहार्थाय मम चित्तं प्रधावति .. 7.1.130.20 ..
16.130.m: for a long time, O fair-hipped lady, uphold the great Pāśupata vow, / the perpetual rule as prescribed, which causes wonder to me; / to show favor to them, my mind rushes forth.

16.130.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
harasya vacanaṃ śrutvā devī vismayamāgatā ..
uvāca vacanaṃ viprāḥ sarvalokapatiṃ patim .. 21 ... .
16.130.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
हरस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा देवी विस्मयमागता ..
उवाच वचनं विप्राः सर्वलोकपतिं पतिम् .. 21 ... .
16.130.m: Sūta said: / Having heard Hara's words, the goddess was filled with wonder; / she spoke words, O brahmins, to her husband, the lord of all the worlds:

16.130.s:
mamāpi kautukaṃ deva kimakārṣīttato bhavān ..
tadbrūhi me mahādeva yadyahaṃ tava vallabhā .. 22 ..
16.130.d:
ममापि कौतुकं देव किमकार्षीत्ततो भवान् ..
तद्ब्रूहि मे महादेव यद्यहं तव वल्लभा .. 22 ..
16.130.m: Curiosity has arisen in me as well, O god: what did you do then? / Tell me that, O Mahādeva, if I am dear to you.

16.130.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā mahādevo jagāda tām ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi mama bhaktaviceṣṭitam .. 23 ..
16.130.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा महादेवो जगाद ताम् ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि मम भक्तविचेष्टितम् .. 23 ..
16.130.m: Having heard those words of hers, Mahādeva said to her: / Listen, O goddess, I shall describe the deeds of my devotees.

16.130.s:
dṛṣṭvā caiva taponiṣṭhāṃ teṣāmādyaḥ sureśvaraḥ ..
uvāca vacanaṃ devaḥ praṇatānpārśvataḥ sthitān .. 24 .. ..
16.130.d:
दृष्ट्वा चैव तपोनिष्ठां तेषामाद्यः सुरेश्वरः ..
उवाच वचनं देवः प्रणतान्पार्श्वतः स्थितान् .. 24 .. ..
16.130.m: Having seen their steadfastness in austerity, the god, the primordial Lord of gods, / spoke words to those standing by his side bowing down:

16.130.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
gaccha śīghraṃ nandikeśa yatra te mama putrakāḥ ..
caraṃti ca vrataṃ ghoraṃ madīyaṃ cātiduṣkaram .. 25 ..
16.130.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
गच्छ शीघ्रं नन्दिकेश यत्र ते मम पुत्रकाः ..
चरंति च व्रतं घोरं मदीयं चातिदुष्करम् .. 25 ..
16.130.m: Īśvara said: / Go quickly, Nandikeśa, where those sons of mine / are practicing that terrible vow of mine, which is very difficult to perform.

16.130.s:
tatkṣetrasya prabhāvena bhaktyā ca mama nityaśaḥ ..
tena te munayaḥ siddhāḥ svaśarīreṇa suvratāḥ .. 26 ..
16.130.d:
तत्क्षेत्रस्य प्रभावेन भक्त्या च मम नित्यशः ..
तेन ते मुनयः सिद्धाः स्वशरीरेण सुव्रताः .. 26 ..
16.130.m: By the power of that sacred field and by devotion to me constantly, / those sages, practitioners of good vows, have attained perfection in their own bodies.

16.130.s:
tasmānmadvacanānnandingaccha prābhāsikaṃ śubham ..
āmantraya tvaṃ tānsarvānkailāsaṃ śīghramānaya .. 27 ..
16.130.d:
तस्मान्मद्वचनान्नन्दिन्गच्छ प्राभासिकं शुभम् ..
आमन्त्रय त्वं तान्सर्वान्कैलासं शीघ्रमानय .. 27 ..
16.130.m: Therefore, by my word, O Nandin, go to auspicious Prabhāsa; / invite them all and bring them quickly to Kailāsa.

16.130.s:
idaṃ padmaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ sanālaṃ kalikojjvalam ..
liṃgasya mūrdhni dattvedaṃ padmanālamihānaya .. 28 ..
16.130.d:
इदं पद्मं गृहाण त्वं सनालं कलिकोज्ज्वलम् ..
लिंगस्य मूर्ध्नि दत्त्वेदं पद्मनालमिहानय .. 28 ..
16.130.m: Take this lotus with its stalk, radiant with a bud; / having placed this on the crown of the liṅga, bring the lotus-stalk here.

16.130.s:
muktastadā sa vai nandī devadevena śaṃbhunā ..
kailāsanilayāttasmātprabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ .. 29 ..
16.130.d:
मुक्तस्तदा स वै नन्दी देवदेवेन शंभुना ..
कैलासनिलयात्तस्मात्प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागतः .. 29 ..
16.130.m: Sent then by Śambhu, the god of gods, / Nandī went from that abode of Kailāsa to the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.130.s:
dṛṣṭvā caiva punarliṅgaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā tāṃścaiva yogīndrānparaṃ vismayamāgataḥ .. 7.1.130.30 ..
16.130.d:
दृष्ट्वा चैव पुनर्लिङ्गं देवदेवस्य शूलिनः ..
दृष्ट्वा तांश्चैव योगीन्द्रान्परं विस्मयमागतः .. 7.1.130.30 ..
16.130.m: And having seen once more the liṅga of the god of gods, the trident-bearer, / and having seen those lords of yogins, he was filled with supreme wonder.

16.130.s:
keciddhyānaratāstatra kecidyogaṃ samāśritāḥ ..
kecidvyākhyāṃ prakurvanti vicāramapi cāpare ..31..
16.130.d:
केचिद्ध्यानरतास्तत्र केचिद्योगं समाश्रिताः ..
केचिद्व्याख्यां प्रकुर्वन्ति विचारमपि चापरे ..31..
16.130.m: Some were engaged in meditation there, some had taken refuge in yoga; / some were offering exposition, and others were engaging in inquiry.

16.130.s:
kurvantyanye liṃgapūjāṃ praṇāmaṃ ca tathā'pare ..
pradakṣiṇaṃ prakurvanti sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇamanti ca .. 32 ..
16.130.d:
कुर्वन्त्यन्ये लिंगपूजां प्रणामं च तथाऽपरे ..
प्रदक्षिणं प्रकुर्वन्ति साष्टांगं प्रणमन्ति च .. 32 ..
16.130.m: Others were performing worship of the liṅga, and others likewise bowing down; / they circumambulated and bowed down with eight limbs [touching the ground].

16.130.s:
kecitstutiṃ prakurvanti bhāvayajñaistathā pare ..
kecitpūjāṃ ca kurvanti ahiṃsākusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 33 ..
16.130.d:
केचित्स्तुतिं प्रकुर्वन्ति भावयज्ञैस्तथा परे ..
केचित्पूजां च कुर्वन्ति अहिंसाकुसुमैः शुभैः .. 33 ..
16.130.m: Some offered praise with sacrifices of the heart, and others likewise; / some performed worship with auspicious, uninjurious flowers.

16.130.s:
bhasmasnānaṃ prakurvaṃti gaṇḍukaiḥ snāpayanti ca ..
evaṃ vyākulatāṃ yātaṃ tapasvigaṇamaṇḍalam .. 34 ..
16.130.d:
भस्मस्नानं प्रकुर्वंति गण्डुकैः स्नापयन्ति च ..
एवं व्याकुलतां यातं तपस्विगणमण्डलम् .. 34 ..
16.130.m: They performed ritual ablution with ash and bathed [the liṅga] with mouthfuls [of water]; / thus the circle of ascetics was thrown into agitation.

16.130.s:
tattādṛśamathālokya nandī vismayamāgataḥ ..
cintayāmāsa manasā sarvaṃ teṣāṃ nirīkṣya ca .. 35 ..
16.130.d:
तत्तादृशमथालोक्य नन्दी विस्मयमागतः ..
चिन्तयामास मनसा सर्वं तेषां निरीक्ष्य च .. 35 ..
16.130.m: Then, seeing them behaving in that manner, Nandī was filled with amazement; / observing everything about them, he reflected in his mind:

16.130.s:
āgato'hamimaṃ deśaṃ na kaścinmāṃ nirīkṣate..
na kenacidahaṃ pṛṣṭo'bhyāgataḥ kutra kasya ca .. 36 ..
16.130.d:
आगतोऽहमिमं देशं न कश्चिन्मां निरीक्षते..
न केनचिदहं पृष्टोऽभ्यागतः कुत्र कस्य च .. 36 ..
16.130.m: "I have arrived in this region, yet no one looks at me; / no one has asked me: 'Whence have you arrived, and whose [attendant] are you?'

16.130.s:
ahaṃkārāvṛtāḥ sarve na vadanti ca māṃ kvacit ..
evaṃ manasi saṃdhāya liṃgapārśvamupāgataḥ .. .. 37 ..
16.130.d:
अहंकारावृताः सर्वे न वदन्ति च मां क्वचित् ..
एवं मनसि संधाय लिंगपार्श्वमुपागतः .. .. 37 ..
16.130.m: All of them are shrouded in pride and do not speak to me at all." / Having pondered thus in his mind, he approached the side of the liṅga.

16.130.s:
dattaṃ liṃgasya tatpadmanālaṃ chittvā tu nandinā ..
arcayitvā tu tannandī liṃgaṃ pāśupateśvaram ..
nālaṃ gṛhītvā yatnena ṛṣīnvacanamabravīt .. 38 ..
16.130.d:
दत्तं लिंगस्य तत्पद्मनालं छित्त्वा तु नन्दिना ..
अर्चयित्वा तु तन्नन्दी लिंगं पाशुपतेश्वरम् ..
नालं गृहीत्वा यत्नेन ऋषीन्वचनमब्रवीत् .. 38 ..
16.130.m: Severing the lotus stalk offered to the liṅga, Nandī, / having worshipped that liṅga of Pāśupateśvara / and carefully taken hold of the stalk, spoke these words to the seers:

16.130.s:
.. nandikeśvara uvāca .. ..
śāsanāddevadevasya bhavatāṃ pārśvamāgataḥ ..
ājñāpayati deveśastapasvigaṇamaṇḍalam .. 39 ...
16.130.d:
.. नन्दिकेश्वर उवाच .. ..
शासनाद्देवदेवस्य भवतां पार्श्वमागतः ..
आज्ञापयति देवेशस्तपस्विगणमण्डलम् .. 39 ...
16.130.m: Nandikeśvara said: / "By command of the God of gods, I have come to your presence; / the Lord of gods gives an order to the circle of ascetics:

16.130.s:
yuṣmābhistatra gantavyaṃ yatra devaḥ sanātanaḥ ..
yuṣmānsarvānsamādāya gamiṣyāmi bhavālayam .. 7.1.130.40 ..
16.130.d:
युष्माभिस्तत्र गन्तव्यं यत्र देवः सनातनः ..
युष्मान्सर्वान्समादाय गमिष्यामि भवालयम् .. 7.1.130.40 ..
16.130.m: 'You must go to that place where the eternal God is; / taking you all with me, I will proceed to the abode of Bhava.

16.130.s:
uttiṣṭhatāśu gacchāmaḥ kailāsaṃ parvatottamam ..
tūṣṇīṃbhūtāstataḥ sarve procuste saṃjñayā dvijāḥ ..
gamyatāmagrato nandinpaścādeṣyāmahe vayam .. 41 ..
16.130.d:
उत्तिष्ठताशु गच्छामः कैलासं पर्वतोत्तमम् ..
तूष्णींभूतास्ततः सर्वे प्रोचुस्ते संज्ञया द्विजाः ..
गम्यतामग्रतो नन्दिन्पश्चादेष्यामहे वयम् .. 41 ..
16.130.m: Arise quickly, let us go to Kailāsa, the supreme mountain.'" / Then, remaining silent, all the twice-born replied to him by gesture: / "Go ahead, Nandī; we shall come afterwards."

16.130.s:
evamuktastu munibhirnandī śīghrataraṃ gataḥ ..
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ kupitenāntarātmanā .. 42 ..
16.130.d:
एवमुक्तस्तु मुनिभिर्नन्दी शीघ्रतरं गतः ..
कथयामास तत्सर्वं कुपितेनान्तरात्मना .. 42 ..
16.130.m: Thus addressed by the sages, Nandī departed very swiftly; / with an inner self filled with anger, he recounted everything:

16.130.s:
.. nandikeśvara uvāca .. ..
deva tatra gato'haṃ vai yatra te yoginaḥ sthitāḥ ..
santoṣito na caivāhaṃ kenacittatra saṃsthitaḥ .. 43 ..
16.130.d:
.. नन्दिकेश्वर उवाच .. ..
देव तत्र गतोऽहं वै यत्र ते योगिनः स्थिताः ..
सन्तोषितो न चैवाहं केनचित्तत्र संस्थितः .. 43 ..
16.130.m: Nandikeśvara said: / "O God, I went indeed to where those yogins abide; / staying there, I was not greeted with welcome by anyone at all.

16.130.s:
na māṃ deva nirīkṣante nālapaṃti kathaṃcana ..
padmaṃ tatra mayā deva sthāpitaṃ liṃga mūrdhani .. 44 ...
16.130.d:
न मां देव निरीक्षन्ते नालपंति कथंचन ..
पद्मं तत्र मया देव स्थापितं लिंग मूर्धनि .. 44 ...
16.130.m: O God, they do not look at me, nor do they speak to me in any way; / O God, a lotus was placed there by me on the head of the liṅga.

16.130.s:
uktaṃ deva mayā teṣāṃ yogīndrāṇāṃ maheśvara ..
ājñaptā devadevena ihāgacchata mā ciram .. 45 ..
16.130.d:
उक्तं देव मया तेषां योगीन्द्राणां महेश्वर ..
आज्ञप्ता देवदेवेन इहागच्छत मा चिरम् .. 45 ..
16.130.m: O God, O Maheśvara, I said to those kings of yogins: / 'You have been ordered by the God of gods: come here without delay.'

16.130.s:
etacchrutvā vacaḥ svāminsarve tatra maharṣayaḥ ..
āgamiṣyāma iti vai pṛṣṭhato gaccha mā ciram .. 46 ..
16.130.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचः स्वामिन्सर्वे तत्र महर्षयः ..
आगमिष्याम इति वै पृष्ठतो गच्छ मा चिरम् .. 46 ..
16.130.m: Having heard this speech, O Master, all the great seers there [said]: / 'We shall come indeed; go on ahead without delay.'

16.130.s:
ityukte taistathā deva ahaṃ śīghramihāgataḥ ..
śṛṇu cemaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kuru me prabho .. 47 ..
16.130.d:
इत्युक्ते तैस्तथा देव अहं शीघ्रमिहागतः ..
शृणु चेमं गृहाण त्वं यथेष्टं कुरु मे प्रभो .. 47 ..
16.130.m: When it was thus spoken by them, O God, I quickly came here; / hear this, take [it], and do with me as you please, O Lord.

16.130.s:
ekaṃ me saṃśayaṃ deva cchettumarhasi sāṃpratam ..
mayā vinā mahādeva āgamiṣyaṃti te katham ..
saṃśayo me mahādeva kathayasva maheśvara .. 48 ... ..
16.130.d:
एकं मे संशयं देव च्छेत्तुमर्हसि सांप्रतम् ..
मया विना महादेव आगमिष्यंति ते कथम् ..
संशयो मे महादेव कथयस्व महेश्वर .. 48 ... ..
16.130.m: O God, you ought now to dispel one doubt of mine; / O Mahādeva, how will they come without me? / This is my doubt, O Mahādeva; tell me, O Maheśvara."

16.130.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu naṃdinyathāścaryaṃ teṣāṃ vai bhāvitātmanām ..
na dṛśyanta ime siddhā māṃ muktvā'nyaiḥ surairapi ..49..
16.130.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु नंदिन्यथाश्चर्यं तेषां वै भावितात्मनाम् ..
न दृश्यन्त इमे सिद्धा मां मुक्त्वाऽन्यैः सुरैरपि ..49..
16.130.m: Īśvara said: / "Listen, Nandī, to the wonder of those whose souls are purified; / these perfected beings cannot be seen, except by me, even by the gods.

16.130.s:
madbhāvabhāvitāste vai yogaṃ viṃdaṃti śāṃkaram ..
paśyaitatkautukaṃ naṃdindarśayāmi tavādhunā .. 7.1.130.50 ..
16.130.d:
मद्भावभावितास्ते वै योगं विंदंति शांकरम् ..
पश्यैतत्कौतुकं नंदिन्दर्शयामि तवाधुना .. 7.1.130.50 ..
16.130.m: Absorbed in my nature, they attain Śāṃkara yoga; / behold this marvel, Nandī: I will show it to you now.

16.130.s:
ānītaṃ yattvayā nālaṃ tasminnāle tu sūkṣmavat ..
praviśya cāgatāḥ sarve yogaiśvaryabalena ca ..51..
16.130.d:
आनीतं यत्त्वया नालं तस्मिन्नाले तु सूक्ष्मवत् ..
प्रविश्य चागताः सर्वे योगैश्वर्यबलेन च ..51..
16.130.m: Inside that stalk which was brought by you, having entered like subtle particles / into that stalk, they all have arrived through the power of yogic sovereignty."

16.130.s:
evamuktastadā naṃdī vismayotphullalocanaḥ ..
apaśyannālamadhyasthānmaharṣīnparamāṇuvat..52..
16.130.d:
एवमुक्तस्तदा नंदी विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनः ..
अपश्यन्नालमध्यस्थान्महर्षीन्परमाणुवत्..52..
16.130.m: Thus addressed at that time, Nandī, his eyes wide with wonder, / saw the great seers situated inside the stalk like minute atoms.

16.130.s:
yathārkaraśmimadhyasthā dṛśyante paramāṇavaḥ ..
evaṃ tannālamadhyasthā dṛśyaṃta ṛṣayaḥ pṛthak .. 53 ..
16.130.d:
यथार्करश्मिमध्यस्था दृश्यन्ते परमाणवः ..
एवं तन्नालमध्यस्था दृश्यंत ऋषयः पृथक् .. 53 ..
16.130.m: Just as minute atoms are seen inside a ray of the sun, / so the seers were seen individually within that stalk.

16.130.s:
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā naṃdī vismayotphullalocanaḥ ..
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ gatvā kiñcinnevābravītpunaḥ .. 54 ..
16.130.d:
एवं दृष्ट्वा तदा नंदी विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनः ..
आश्चर्यं परमं गत्वा किञ्चिन्नेवाब्रवीत्पुनः .. 54 ..
16.130.m: Seeing thus, Nandī, his eyes wide with wonder / and having attained supreme astonishment, said nothing further at all.

16.130.s:
evaṃ tatkautukaṃ dṛṣṭvā devī vacanamabravīt ..
kiṃ dṛśyate mahādeva hṛṣṭaḥ kasmānmaheśvara ..55..
16.130.d:
एवं तत्कौतुकं दृष्ट्वा देवी वचनमब्रवीत् ..
किं दृश्यते महादेव हृष्टः कस्मान्महेश्वर ..55..
16.130.m: Seeing that wonder, the Goddess spoke these words: / "What is being seen, O Mahādeva? Why are you joyful, O Maheśvara?"

16.130.s: ityukte vacane devyā provācedaṃ maheśvaraḥ.. ..56..
16.130.d: इत्युक्ते वचने देव्या प्रोवाचेदं महेश्वरः.. ..56..
16.130.m: When these words were spoken by the Goddess, Maheśvara said this:

16.130.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
yogayuktā mahātmāno yoge pāśupate sthitāḥ ..
ete māṃ ca samārādhya prabhāsakṣetravāsinam ..
īdṛśīṃ siddhimāpannāḥ svacchaṃdagaticāriṇaḥ.. 57 ..
16.130.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
योगयुक्ता महात्मानो योगे पाशुपते स्थिताः ..
एते मां च समाराध्य प्रभासक्षेत्रवासिनम् ..
ईदृशीं सिद्धिमापन्नाः स्वच्छंदगतिचारिणः.. 57 ..
16.130.m: Īśvara said: / "These great souls are united in yoga, established in Pāśupata yoga; / having worshipped me who dwell in the Prabhāsa sacred field, / they have attained such perfection, moving about with unimpeded motion."

16.130.s:
ityuktavati deveśa ṛṣayaste mahāprabhāḥ ..
padmanālādviniḥsṛtya sarve vai yogamāyayā ..
pradakṣiṇāṃ prakurvaṃti devaṃ devyā bahiṣkṛtam.. 58 ..
16.130.d:
इत्युक्तवति देवेश ऋषयस्ते महाप्रभाः ..
पद्मनालाद्विनिःसृत्य सर्वे वै योगमायया ..
प्रदक्षिणां प्रकुर्वंति देवं देव्या बहिष्कृतम्.. 58 ..
16.130.m: When the Lord of gods had said this, those seers of great splendor, / having emerged from the lotus stalk, all through yogic power, / performed circumambulation around the God, excluding the Goddess.

16.130.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kimarthaṃ māṃ na paśyaṃti durācārā ime dvijāḥ ..
vismayo'yaṃ mahādeva kathayasva prasādataḥ .. 59 .. ..
16.130.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
किमर्थं मां न पश्यंति दुराचारा इमे द्विजाः ..
विस्मयोऽयं महादेव कथयस्व प्रसादतः .. 59 .. ..
16.130.m: The Goddess said: / "For what reason do these ill-behaved twice-born not look at me? / This is an amazement, O Mahādeva; tell me out of your grace."

16.130.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
prakṛtitvānna paśyaṃti siddhā hyete mahātapāḥ ..
evamuktā tu girijā devedevena śūlinā .. 7.1.130.60 ..
16.130.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
प्रकृतित्वान्न पश्यंति सिद्धा ह्येते महातपाः ..
एवमुक्ता तु गिरिजा देवेदेवेन शूलिना .. 7.1.130.60 ..
16.130.m: Īśvara said: / "Because of [your] being Material Nature, these perfected beings of great austerity do not look [at you]." / When the mountain-born [goddess] was thus addressed by the God of gods who bears the trident,

16.130.s:
cukopa teṣāṃ suśroṇī śaśāpa krodhitānanā ..
strīlaulyena durācārā nāśameṣyatha garviṇaḥ .. 61 ..
16.130.d:
चुकोप तेषां सुश्रोणी शशाप क्रोधितानना ..
स्त्रीलौल्येन दुराचारा नाशमेष्यथ गर्विणः .. 61 ..
16.130.m: she of beautiful hips became angry at them and, her face inflamed with wrath, cursed them: / "Ill-behaved and arrogant ones, through longing for women you will meet your ruin!

16.130.s:
rājapratigrahāsaktā vṛttyā devārcane ratāḥ..
bhaviṣyatha kalau prāpte liṃgadravyopajīvinaḥ .. 62 ..
16.130.d:
राजप्रतिग्रहासक्ता वृत्त्या देवार्चने रताः..
भविष्यथ कलौ प्राप्ते लिंगद्रव्योपजीविनः .. 62 ..
16.130.m: Attached to gifts from kings, devoted to the worship of deities merely as a livelihood, / when the Kali age arrives, you will live on the property of the liṅga!

16.130.s:
veśyāsaktāśca saṃbhrāṃtā sarvalokabahiṣkṛtāḥ ..
devadravyavināśāya bhaviṣyatha kalau yuge .. 63 ..
16.130.d:
वेश्यासक्ताश्च संभ्रांता सर्वलोकबहिष्कृताः ..
देवद्रव्यविनाशाय भविष्यथ कलौ युगे .. 63 ..
16.130.m: Attached to courtesans, bewildered, and expelled from all society, / you will bring ruin to the property of the deities in the Kali age!"

16.130.s:
iti datte tadā śāpa ṛṣīṇāṃ ca mahātmanām ..
gaurīṃ prasādayāmāsuste ca sarve sureśvarāḥ .. 64 ..
16.130.d:
इति दत्ते तदा शाप ऋषीणां च महात्मनाम् ..
गौरीं प्रसादयामासुस्ते च सर्वे सुरेश्वराः .. 64 ..
16.130.m: When that curse had thus been laid upon the great-souled seers, / all those lords of the gods propitiated Gaurī.

16.130.s:
devadevasya vacanātprasannā sā'bhavatpunaḥ ..
nālaṃ devo'pi saṃgṛhya dakṣiṇāśāṃ samākṣipat .. 65 ..
16.130.d:
देवदेवस्य वचनात्प्रसन्ना साऽभवत्पुनः ..
नालं देवोऽपि संगृह्य दक्षिणाशां समाक्षिपत् .. 65 ..
16.130.m: At the word of the God of gods, she became pleased once more; / and the God, taking up the stalk, hurled it in the southern direction.

16.130.s:
patitaṃ tacca vai nālaṃ prabhāsakṣetramadhyataḥ ..
tadeva liṃgaṃ saṃjātaṃ mahānāleti viśrutam .. 66 ..
16.130.d:
पतितं तच्च वै नालं प्रभासक्षेत्रमध्यतः ..
तदेव लिंगं संजातं महानालेति विश्रुतम् .. 66 ..
16.130.m: That stalk fell right into the midst of the Prabhāsa sacred field; / that very [stalk] became a liṅga, renowned as Mahānāla.

16.130.s:
kalau yuge ca saṃprāpte taddhruveśvarasaṃjñitam..
saṃsthitaṃ cottareśāne tasmātpāśupateśvarāt ..67 ..
16.130.d:
कलौ युगे च संप्राप्ते तद्ध्रुवेश्वरसंज्ञितम्..
संस्थितं चोत्तरेशाने तस्मात्पाशुपतेश्वरात् ..67 ..
16.130.m: And when the Kali age arrived, it came to be known as Dhruveśvara, / situated to the northeast of that Pāśupateśvara.

16.130.s:
purā'nādīśanāmeti paścātpāśupateśvaraḥ ..
prabhāse tu mahākṣetre sthitaḥ pātakanāśanaḥ ..68..
16.130.d:
पुराऽनादीशनामेति पश्चात्पाशुपतेश्वरः ..
प्रभासे तु महाक्षेत्रे स्थितः पातकनाशनः ..68..
16.130.m: Formerly its name was Anādīśa, and later Pāśupateśvara; / it stands in the great sacred field of Prabhāsa, destroying sins.

16.130.s:
idaṃ sthānaṃ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mama vrataniṣevaṇam ..
idaṃ liṃgaṃ paraṃ brahma anādīśeti saṃjñitam .. 69..
16.130.d:
इदं स्थानं परं श्रेष्ठं मम व्रतनिषेवणम् ..
इदं लिंगं परं ब्रह्म अनादीशेति संज्ञितम् .. 69..
16.130.m: This is the supreme, foremost place where my observance is practiced; / this liṅga, known as Anādīśa, is the supreme Brahman.

16.130.s:
atra siddhiśca muktiśca brāhmaṇānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ ..
anenaiva śarīreṇa ṣaḍbhirmāsastu siddhyati .. 7.1.130.70 ..
16.130.d:
अत्र सिद्धिश्च मुक्तिश्च ब्राह्मणानां न संशयः ..
अनेनैव शरीरेण षड्भिर्मासस्तु सिद्ध्यति .. 7.1.130.70 ..
16.130.m: Here brahmins attain perfection and liberation, without doubt; / with this very body, one attains perfection within six months.

16.130.s:
saṃsārasya vimokṣārthamidaṃ liṃgaṃ tu dṛśyatām ..
durlabhaṃ sarvalokānāmidaṃ mokṣapradaṃ param..
idaṃ pāśupataṃ jñānamasmim̐lliṃge pratiṣṭhitam .. 71 ..
16.130.d:
संसारस्य विमोक्षार्थमिदं लिंगं तु दृश्यताम् ..
दुर्लभं सर्वलोकानामिदं मोक्षप्रदं परम्..
इदं पाशुपतं ज्ञानमस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 71 ..
16.130.m: Let this liṅga be beheld for liberation from the cycle of worldly existence; / it is hard to attain for all worlds, the supreme bestower of liberation; / this Pāśupata wisdom is established in this liṅga.

16.130.s:
yaścainaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā māghe māsi niraṃtaram ..
sarveṣāṃ vai kratūnāṃ ca dānānāṃ labhate phalam .. 72 ..
16.130.d:
यश्चैनं पूजयेद्भक्त्या माघे मासि निरंतरम् ..
सर्वेषां वै क्रतूनां च दानानां लभते फलम् .. 72 ..
16.130.m: And whoever worships it with devotion constantly in the month of Māgha / obtains the fruit of all sacrifices and gifts.

16.130.s: hiraṇyaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ .. 73 ..
16.130.d: हिरण्यं तत्र दातव्यं सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः .. 73 ..
16.130.m: Gold should be given there by those who desire the full fruit of the pilgrimage.

16.130.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
paśupāśavimokṣārthaṃ samyakpāśupateśvaram .. 74 ..
16.130.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ..
पशुपाशविमोक्षार्थं सम्यक्पाशुपतेश्वरम् .. 74 ..
16.130.m: Thus, O Goddess, has been recounted this sin-destroying māhātmya / of Pāśupateśvara, which brings about liberation from the bondage of the individual soul."

16.130.s:
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ pūjyo brāhmaṇa ucyate ..
tasya caivādhikāro'sti cāsminpāśupateśvare .. 75 ..
16.130.d:
चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां पूज्यो ब्राह्मण उच्यते ..
तस्य चैवाधिकारोऽस्ति चास्मिन्पाशुपतेश्वरे .. 75 ..
16.130.m: The brahmin is declared to be venerable among all four classes; / and he alone has authority over this Pāśupateśvara. // 75

16.130.s:
yaddevatānāṃ prathamaṃ pavitraṃ viśvavrataṃ pāśupataṃ babhūva ..
ayaṃ panthā naiṣṭhiko vai mayokto yena devā yāṃti bhuvanāni viśvā .. 76 ..
16.130.d:
यद्देवतानां प्रथमं पवित्रं विश्वव्रतं पाशुपतं बभूव ..
अयं पन्था नैष्ठिको वै मयोक्तो येन देवा यांति भुवनानि विश्वा .. 76 ..
16.130.m: Since this Pāśupata universal vow became the first purifier among the deities, / I have declared this absolute path, by which the gods attain all the worlds. // 76

16.130.s:
surāṃ pītvā gurudārāṃśca gatvā steyaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇaṃ cāpi hatvā ..
bhasmacchanno bhasmaśayyāśayāno rudrādhyāyī mucyate pātakebhyaḥ .. 77 ..
16.130.d:
सुरां पीत्वा गुरुदारांश्च गत्वा स्तेयं कृत्वा ब्राह्मणं चापि हत्वा ..
भस्मच्छन्नो भस्मशय्याशयानो रुद्राध्यायी मुच्यते पातकेभ्यः .. 77 ..
16.130.m: Even having drunk wine, approached the wife of one's guru, committed theft, or killed a brahmin, / one covered with ash, lying upon a bed of ash, and reciting the Rudra hymns is freed from these sins. // 77

16.130.s:
agnirityādinā bhasma gṛhītvāṃgāni saṃspṛśet ..
gṛhṇīyātsaṃyate cāgnau bhasma tadgṛhavāsinām .. 78 ..
16.130.d:
अग्निरित्यादिना भस्म गृहीत्वांगानि संस्पृशेत् ..
गृह्णीयात्संयते चाग्नौ भस्म तद्गृहवासिनाम् .. 78 ..
16.130.m: Taking the ash with the formula beginning 'Agni is [ash]', one should touch the limbs; / and from a carefully kept fire one should take the ash of householders. // 78

16.130.s:
agniriti bhasma vāyuriti bhasma jalamiti bhasma sthalamiti bhasma sarvaṃ ha vā idaṃ bhasmābhavat ..
etāni cakṣūṃṣi nādīkṣitaḥ saṃspṛśet .. 79 ..
16.130.d:
अग्निरिति भस्म वायुरिति भस्म जलमिति भस्म स्थलमिति भस्म सर्वं ह वा इदं भस्माभवत् ..
एतानि चक्षूंषि नादीक्षितः संस्पृशेत् .. 79 ..
16.130.m: 'Fire is ash, wind is ash, water is ash, earth is ash, indeed all this became ash.' / One who is uninitiated must not touch these eyes. // 79

16.130.s:
brāhmaṇaiśca samādeyaṃ na tu śūdraiḥ kadācana ..
nādhikāro'sti śūdrasya vrate pāśupate sadā .. 7.1.130.80 ..
16.130.d:
ब्राह्मणैश्च समादेयं न तु शूद्रैः कदाचन ..
नाधिकारोऽस्ति शूद्रस्य व्रते पाशुपते सदा .. 7.1.130.80 ..
16.130.m: It must be taken up by brahmins, but never by śūdras; / a śūdra never has authority regarding the Pāśupata vow. // 80

16.130.s:
brāhmaṇeṣvadhikāro'sti vrate pāśupate śubhe ..
brāhmaṇīṃ tanumāsthāya saṃbhavāmi yugeyuge .. 81 ..
16.130.d:
ब्राह्मणेष्वधिकारोऽस्ति व्रते पाशुपते शुभे ..
ब्राह्मणीं तनुमास्थाय संभवामि युगेयुगे .. 81 ..
16.130.m: Authority regarding the auspicious Pāśupata vow belongs to brahmins; / assuming a brahmin body, I am born age after age. // 81

16.130.s:
caṇḍālaveśmanyatha vā smaśāne rājñaśca mārgeśvatha vartmamadhye ..
karīṣamadhye niḥsṛtā narādhamāḥ śaivaṃ padaṃ yāṃti na saṃśayo'tra .. 82 ..
16.130.d:
चण्डालवेश्मन्यथ वा स्मशाने राज्ञश्च मार्गेश्वथ वर्त्ममध्ये ..
करीषमध्ये निःसृता नराधमाः शैवं पदं यांति न संशयोऽत्र .. 82 ..
16.130.m: Whether in an outcaste's dwelling, a cremation ground, on the king's highway, in the middle of a road, / or fallen into dried cowdung, the lowest of men attain the realm of Śiva—of this there is no doubt. // 82

16.130.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśī tisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye pāśupateśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśaduttaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ .. 130 ..
16.130.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशी तिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पाशुपतेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिंशदुत्तरशततमोध्यायः .. 130 ..
16.130.m: Thus ends the one hundred and thirtieth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Pāśupateśvara,' in the first [part], the Glory of the Prabhāsa Sacred Field, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. // 130

16.131.s:
.. śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ nāleśvaramiti śrutam ..
dhruveśvareti talliṃgaṃ kathaṃ vai saṃbabhūva ha .. 1 ..
16.131.d:
.. श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
यदेतद्भवता प्रोक्तं नालेश्वरमिति श्रुतम् ..
ध्रुवेश्वरेति तल्लिंगं कथं वै संबभूव ह .. 1 ..
16.131.m: The goddess said: / This [liṅga] which was mentioned by you, heard of as Nāleśvara, / how indeed did it come to be called the liṅga of Dhruveśvara? // 1

16.131.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi dhruveśvaramahodayam ..
yacchrutvā mānavo devi mucyate bhavabaṃdhanāt .. 2 ..
16.131.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि ध्रुवेश्वरमहोदयम् ..
यच्छ्रुत्वा मानवो देवि मुच्यते भवबंधनात् .. 2 ..
16.131.m: Īśvara said: / Listen, O goddess, I shall proclaim the great glory of Dhruveśvara, / hearing which, O goddess, a mortal is freed from the bond of worldly existence. // 2

16.131.s:
uttānapādanṛpateḥ putro'bhūddhruvasaṃjñitaḥ ..
mahātmā jñānasaṃpannaḥ sarvajñaḥ priyadarśanaḥ .. 3 ..
16.131.d:
उत्तानपादनृपतेः पुत्रोऽभूद्ध्रुवसंज्ञितः ..
महात्मा ज्ञानसंपन्नः सर्वज्ञः प्रियदर्शनः .. 3 ..
16.131.m: There was a son of King Uttānapāda named Dhruva, / noble-minded, endowed with knowledge, all-knowing, and pleasant to behold. // 3

16.131.s:
sa kadācitsamāsādya prabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam ..
tatāpa vipulaṃ devi tapaḥ paramadāruṇam .. 4 ..
16.131.d:
स कदाचित्समासाद्य प्रभासं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् ..
तताप विपुलं देवि तपः परमदारुणम् .. 4 ..
16.131.m: Once having reached the excellent sacred field of Prabhāsa, / he performed extensive, exceedingly fierce austerity, O goddess. // 4

16.131.s:
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram ..
saṃpūjayati sadbhaktyā stauti stotraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 5 ..
16.131.d:
दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं तु प्रतिष्ठाप्य महेश्वरम् ..
संपूजयति सद्भक्त्या स्तौति स्तोत्रैः पृथग्विधैः .. 5 ..
16.131.m: Having established Maheśvara for a divine thousand years, / he worshipped with true devotion and praised him with diverse hymns. // 5

16.131.s: tatstotraṃ te pravakṣyāmi yenāhaṃ tuṣṭimāgataḥ .. 6 ..
16.131.d: तत्स्तोत्रं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि येनाहं तुष्टिमागतः .. 6 ..
16.131.m: I shall tell you that hymn by which I was pleased. // 6

16.131.s:
.. dhruva uvāca .. ..
kailāsatuṃgaśikharaṃ pravikampyamānaṃ kailāsaśṛṃgasadṛśena daśānanena ..
yaḥ pādapadmaparipīḍanayā dadhāra taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi .. 7 ..
16.131.d:
.. ध्रुव उवाच .. ..
कैलासतुंगशिखरं प्रविकम्प्यमानं कैलासशृंगसदृशेन दशाननेन ..
यः पादपद्मपरिपीडनया दधार तं शंकरं शरणदं शरणं व्रजामि .. 7 ..
16.131.m: Dhruva said: / He who held the high peak of Kailāsa being shaken by the ten-headed [Rāvaṇa], who was like a peak of Kailāsa, / by pressing down his lotus-like toe—to that Śaṃkara, granter of refuge, I go for refuge. // 7

16.131.s:
yenāsurāścāpi danośca putrā vidyādharoragagaṇaiśca vṛtāḥ samagrāḥ ..
saṃyojitā na tu phalaṃ phalamūlamuktāstaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi .. 8 ..
16.131.d:
येनासुराश्चापि दनोश्च पुत्रा विद्याधरोरगगणैश्च वृताः समग्राः ..
संयोजिता न तु फलं फलमूलमुक्तास्तं शंकरं शरणदं शरणं व्रजामि .. 8 ..
16.131.m: He by whom all the asuras and Danu's sons, accompanied by hosts of vidyādharas and serpents, / were united [to his service] yet released from [the cycle of] fruits, roots, and actions—to that Śaṃkara, granter of refuge, I go for refuge. // 8

16.131.s:
yasyākhilaṃ jagadidaṃ vaśavarti nityaṃ yo'ṣṭābhireva tanubhirbhuvanāni bhuṃkte ..
yatkāraṇaṃ paramakāraṇakāraṇānāṃ taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi ..9..
16.131.d:
यस्याखिलं जगदिदं वशवर्ति नित्यं योऽष्टाभिरेव तनुभिर्भुवनानि भुंक्ते ..
यत्कारणं परमकारणकारणानां तं शंकरं शरणदं शरणं व्रजामि ..9..
16.131.m: To whose control this entire universe is ever subject, who enjoys the worlds through his eight bodies alone, / who is the cause of supreme causes—to that Śaṃkara, granter of refuge, I go for refuge. // 9

16.131.s:
yaḥ savyapāṇikamalāgranakhena devastatpaṃcamaṃ ca sahasaiva purātiruṣṭaḥ ..
brāhmaṃ śirastaruṇapadmanibhaṃ cakarta taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi ..7.1.131.10...
16.131.d:
यः सव्यपाणिकमलाग्रनखेन देवस्तत्पंचमं च सहसैव पुरातिरुष्टः ..
ब्राह्मं शिरस्तरुणपद्मनिभं चकर्त तं शंकरं शरणदं शरणं व्रजामि ..7.1.131.10...
16.131.m: The god who, exceedingly enraged of old, suddenly severed with the tip of the claw of his left lotus hand / the fifth, Brahma-head that was like a fresh lotus—to that Śaṃkara, granter of refuge, I go for refuge. // 10

16.131.s:
yasya praṇamya caraṇau varadasya bhaktyā śrutvā ca vāgbhiramalābhirataṃdritābhiḥ ..
dīptastamāṃsi nudati svakarairvivasvāṃstaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi .. .. 11 ..
16.131.d:
यस्य प्रणम्य चरणौ वरदस्य भक्त्या श्रुत्वा च वाग्भिरमलाभिरतंद्रिताभिः ..
दीप्तस्तमांसि नुदति स्वकरैर्विवस्वांस्तं शंकरं शरणदं शरणं व्रजामि .. .. 11 ..
16.131.m: Bowing with devotion at whose feet, having heard [his command] with pure, unwearied words, / the radiant sun dispels the darkness with his rays—to that Śaṃkara, granter of refuge, I go for refuge. // 11

16.131.s:
yaḥ paṭhetstavamidaṃ rucirārthaṃ mānavo dhruvakṛtaṃ niyatātmā ..
viprasaṃsadi sadā śucisiddhaḥ sa prayāti śivalokamanādim .. 12 ..
16.131.d:
यः पठेत्स्तवमिदं रुचिरार्थं मानवो ध्रुवकृतं नियतात्मा ..
विप्रसंसदि सदा शुचिसिद्धः स प्रयाति शिवलोकमनादिम् .. 12 ..
16.131.m: A restrained man who recites this hymn of charming meaning composed by Dhruva, / constantly purified and perfected in an assembly of brahmins, reaches the beginningless realm of Śiva. // 12

16.131.s:
tasyaivaṃ stuvato devi tuṣṭo'haṃ bhāvitātmanaḥ ..
pūrṇe varṣasahasrāṃte dhruvasyāha mahātmanaḥ .. 13 ..
16.131.d:
तस्यैवं स्तुवतो देवि तुष्टोऽहं भावितात्मनः ..
पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रांते ध्रुवस्याह महात्मनः .. 13 ..
16.131.m: While he of refined soul was praising me thus, O goddess, I was pleased; / at the end of a full thousand years, I said to noble-minded Dhruva: // 13

16.131.s:
putra tuṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te jātastvaṃ nirmalo'dhunā ..
divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya māṃ vigatajvaraḥ .. 14 ..
16.131.d:
पुत्र तुष्टोऽस्मि भद्रं ते जातस्त्वं निर्मलोऽधुना ..
दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मां विगतज्वरः .. 14 ..
16.131.m: 'O son, I am pleased; hail to you! You have now become spotless. / I grant you a divine eye; free from sorrow, look at me! // 14

16.131.s:
yacca te manasā kiñcitkāṃkṣitaṃ phalamuttamam ..
tatsarvaṃ te pradāsyāmi brūhi śīghraṃ mamāgrataḥ .. 15 ..
16.131.d:
यच्च ते मनसा किञ्चित्कांक्षितं फलमुत्तमम् ..
तत्सर्वं ते प्रदास्यामि ब्रूहि शीघ्रं ममाग्रतः .. 15 ..
16.131.m: Whatever supreme fruit you have desired in your mind, / I shall grant you all of that; speak quickly before me! // 15

16.131.s:
brāhmyaṃ vā vaiṣṇavaṃ śākraṃ padamanyatsudurlabham ..
dadāmi nātra saṃdeho bhaktyā saṃprīṇitastava .. 16 ..
16.131.d:
ब्राह्म्यं वा वैष्णवं शाक्रं पदमन्यत्सुदुर्लभम् ..
ददामि नात्र संदेहो भक्त्या संप्रीणितस्तव .. 16 ..
16.131.m: Whether the realm of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Indra, or any other exceedingly rare station, / I grant it, there is no doubt, pleased by your devotion.' // 16

16.131.s:
.. dhruva uvāca .. ..
brāhmyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ māhendraṃ padamāvṛttilakṣaṇam..
viditaṃ mama tatsarvaṃ manasā'pi na kāmaye..17..
16.131.d:
.. ध्रुव उवाच .. ..
ब्राह्म्यं वैष्णवं माहेन्द्रं पदमावृत्तिलक्षणम्..
विदितं मम तत्सर्वं मनसाऽपि न कामये..17..
16.131.m: Dhruva said: / 'The realms of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Mahendra are characterised by return; / all that is known to me, and I do not desire it even in thought. // 17

16.131.s:
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva bhaktiṃ dehi sunirmalām..
asmim̐lliṃge sadā vāsaṃ kuru deva vṛṣadhvaja..18..
16.131.d:
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव भक्तिं देहि सुनिर्मलाम्..
अस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे सदा वासं कुरु देव वृषध्वज..18..
16.131.m: If you are pleased with me, O God, grant me purest devotion; / and O God whose banner is a bull, make your dwelling forever in this liṅga.' // 18

16.131.s:
īśvara uvāca..
iti yatprārthitaṃ sarvaṃ taddattaṃ sarvameva hi..
sthānaṃ ca tasya taddhrauvyaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam..19..
16.131.d:
ईश्वर उवाच..
इति यत्प्रार्थितं सर्वं तद्दत्तं सर्वमेव हि..
स्थानं च तस्य तद्ध्रौव्यं तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम्..19..
16.131.m: Īśvara said: / All that he thus requested was indeed granted entirely, / and that eternal station of his became that supreme abode of Viṣṇu. // 19

16.131.s:
śrāvaṇasya tvamāvāsyāṃ yastalliṃgaṃ prapūjayet ..
āśvayukpaurṇamāsyāṃ vā so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 7.1.131.20 ..
16.131.d:
श्रावणस्य त्वमावास्यां यस्तल्लिंगं प्रपूजयेत् ..
आश्वयुक्पौर्णमास्यां वा सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 7.1.131.20 ..
16.131.m: He who worships that liṅga on the new moon day of the month of Śrāvaṇa, / or on the full moon day of Āśvina, obtains the fruit of an aśvamedha sacrifice. // 20

16.131.s:
aputro labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam ..
rūpavānsubhago bhogī sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ ..
haṃsayuktavimānena rudraloke mahīyate .. 21 ..
16.131.d:
अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रं धनार्थी लभते धनम् ..
रूपवान्सुभगो भोगी सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः ..
हंसयुक्तविमानेन रुद्रलोके महीयते .. 21 ..
16.131.m: The childless person obtains a son, the seeker of wealth obtains wealth; / handsome, fortunate, enjoying pleasures, and skilled in all scriptures, / he is glorified in the world of Rudra in an aerial chariot drawn by swans. // 21

16.131.s:
asurasuragaṇānāṃ pūjitasya dhruvasya kathayati kamanīyāṃ kīrtimetāṃ śṛṇoti ..
sakalasukhanidhānarudralokaṃ suśāṃtaḥ suragaṇadanunāthairarcitaṃ yātyanaṃtam .. 22 ..
16.131.d:
असुरसुरगणानां पूजितस्य ध्रुवस्य कथयति कमनीयां कीर्तिमेतां शृणोति ..
सकलसुखनिधानरुद्रलोकं सुशांतः सुरगणदनुनाथैरर्चितं यात्यनंतम् .. 22 ..
16.131.m: He who recites or hears this lovely glory of Dhruva, who was worshipped by hosts of asuras and gods, / perfectly tranquil, reaches the eternal realm of Rudra, the treasury of all bliss, adored by hosts of gods and chiefs of the Dānavas. // 22

16.131.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye dhruveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśaduttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ..131..
16.131.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एका शीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ध्रुवेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकत्रिंशदुत्तरशततमो ऽध्यायः ..131..
16.131.m: Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-first chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Dhruveśvara,' in the first [part], the Glory of the Prabhāsa Sacred Field, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. // 131

16.132.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi vaiṣṇavīṃ śaktimuttamām ..
someśādīśadigbhāge nātidūre vyavasthitām .. 1 ..
16.132.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि वैष्णवीं शक्तिमुत्तमाम् ..
सोमेशादीशदिग्भागे नातिदूरे व्यवस्थिताम् .. 1 ..
16.132.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the excellent Vaiṣṇavī Śakti, / situated in the north-eastern direction from Someśa, not very far away. // 1
She is famous as Siddhalakṣmī, the presiding deity of the sacred seat here. // 2

16.132.s:
brahmāṇḍe prathamaṃ pīṭhaṃ yatprabhāsaṃ vyavasthitam ..
tatra devi mahāpīṭhe yoginyo bhūcarāḥ khagāḥ ..
bhairaveṇa same tāstu krīḍante svecchayā priye .. 3..
16.132.d:
ब्रह्माण्डे प्रथमं पीठं यत्प्रभासं व्यवस्थितम् ..
तत्र देवि महापीठे योगिन्यो भूचराः खगाः ..
भैरवेण समे तास्तु क्रीडन्ते स्वेच्छया प्रिये .. 3..
16.132.m: Since Prabhāsa is situated as the first sacred seat in the universe, / there at that great sacred seat, O goddess, earthly and sky-roaming yoginīs / sport at will together with Bhairava, my beloved. // 3

16.132.s:
jālaṃdharaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ kāmarūpaṃ tathaiva ca ..
śrīmadrudranṛsiṃhaṃ ca caturthaṃ pīṭhamuttamam .. 4 ..
16.132.d:
जालंधरं महापीठं कामरूपं तथैव च ..
श्रीमद्रुद्रनृसिंहं च चतुर्थं पीठमुत्तमम् .. 4 ..
16.132.m: The great seat Jālaṃdhara, and likewise Kāmarūpa, / and the glorious Rudranṛsiṃha is the fourth excellent seat. 4

16.132.s:
ratnavīryaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ kāśmīraṃ pīṭhameva ca ..
etāni devi pīṭhāni yo vetti sa ca mantravit .. 5 ..
16.132.d:
रत्नवीर्यं महापीठं काश्मीरं पीठमेव च ..
एतानि देवि पीठानि यो वेत्ति स च मन्त्रवित् .. 5 ..
16.132.m: The great seat Ratnavīrya, and also the seat of Kāśmīra: / O goddess, he who knows these seats is a knower of mantras. 5

16.132.s:
sarveṣāṃ caiva pīṭhānāmādhāraṃ pīṭhamuttamam ..
saurāṣṭre tu mahādevi nāmnā khyātaṃ mahodayam ..
kāmarūpadharaṃ jñānaṃ yatrādyāpi pravartate .. 6 ..
16.132.d:
सर्वेषां चैव पीठानामाधारं पीठमुत्तमम् ..
सौराष्ट्रे तु महादेवि नाम्ना ख्यातं महोदयम् ..
कामरूपधरं ज्ञानं यत्राद्यापि प्रवर्तते .. 6 ..
16.132.m: And the excellent seat that is the foundation of all the seats, / famous by the name Mahodaya in Saurāṣṭra, O great goddess, / where knowledge assuming forms at will continues even today. 6

16.132.s:
tatra pīṭhe sthitā devī mahālakṣmīti viśrutā ..
sarvapāpapraśamanī sarvakāryaśubhapradā .. 7 ..
16.132.d:
तत्र पीठे स्थिता देवी महालक्ष्मीति विश्रुता ..
सर्वपापप्रशमनी सर्वकार्यशुभप्रदा .. 7 ..
16.132.m: There on that seat dwells the goddess renowned as Mahālakṣmī, / who pacifies all sins and grants auspiciousness in all undertakings. 7

16.132.s:
śrīpañcamyāṃ naro yastu pūjayettāṃ vidhānataḥ ..
gandhapuṣpādibhirbhaktyā tasyālakṣmībhayaṃ kutaḥ .. 8 ..
16.132.d:
श्रीपञ्चम्यां नरो यस्तु पूजयेत्तां विधानतः ..
गन्धपुष्पादिभिर्भक्त्या तस्यालक्ष्मीभयं कुतः .. 8 ..
16.132.m: The person who worships her according to the rules on Śrīpañcamī, / with devotion using perfumes, flowers, and the like, whence can there be any fear of misfortune for him? 8

16.132.s:
uttarāṃ diśamāsthāya mahāla kṣmyāstu sannidhau..
yo japenmantrarājñīṃ tāṃ siddhalakṣmīti viśrutām .. 9 ..
16.132.d:
उत्तरां दिशमास्थाय महाल क्ष्म्यास्तु सन्निधौ..
यो जपेन्मन्त्रराज्ञीं तां सिद्धलक्ष्मीति विश्रुताम् .. 9 ..
16.132.m: He who, facing the northern direction in the presence of Mahālakṣmī, / mutters that queen of mantras renowned as Siddhalakṣmī, 9

according to the rules of a hundred-thousand recitations, preceded by initiation, ablution, and the like, / accompanied by an oblation of one tenth [of the recitations] with the three sweets, auspicious fruits, and shoots, 10

16.132.s:
evaṃ pratyakṣatāṃ yāti tasya lakṣmīrna saṃśayaḥ ..
dadāti vāṃchitāṃ siddhimiha loke paratra ca .. 11 ..
16.132.d:
एवं प्रत्यक्षतां याति तस्य लक्ष्मीर्न संशयः ..
ददाति वांछितां सिद्धिमिह लोके परत्र च .. 11 ..
16.132.m: thus Lakṣmī becomes visible to him, without doubt; / she grants the desired siddhi in this world and in the next. 11

16.132.s:
tṛtīyāyāmathā ṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ vidhānataḥ ..
yastāṃ pūjayate bhaktyā tasya siddhiḥ kare sthitā .. 12 ..
16.132.d:
तृतीयायामथा ष्टम्यां चतुर्दश्यां विधानतः ..
यस्तां पूजयते भक्त्या तस्य सिद्धिः करे स्थिता .. 12 ..
16.132.m: He who worships her with devotion according to the rules on the third, / the eighth, and the fourteenth [tithis], siddhi rests in his hand. 12

16.132.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye siddhalakṣmīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 132 ..
16.132.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सिद्धलक्ष्मीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वात्रिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 132 ..
16.132.m: Thus ends the one hundred thirty-second chapter, titled “Description of the Greatness of Siddhalakṣmī,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 132

16.133.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatraiva saṃsthitā devi mahākālīti viśrutā ..
adhaḥ sthite mahāpīṭhe pātālavivarānvite .. 1 ..
16.133.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव संस्थिता देवि महाकालीति विश्रुता ..
अधः स्थिते महापीठे पातालविवरान्विते .. 1 ..
16.133.m: Īśvara said: / Dwellng right there, O goddess, is she renowned as Mahākālī, / on the lower great seat connected with the chasm of Pātāla. 1

16.133.s:
sarvaduḥkhapraśamanī sarvaśatrukṣayaṃkarī ..
pūjanīyā vidhānena kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ mahāniśi ..
gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpaiḥ kravyairbalibhireva ca .. 2 ..
16.133.d:
सर्वदुःखप्रशमनी सर्वशत्रुक्षयंकरी ..
पूजनीया विधानेन कृष्णाष्टम्यां महानिशि ..
गन्धैः पुष्पैस्तथा धूपैः क्रव्यैर्बलिभिरेव च .. 2 ..
16.133.m: She pacifies all sorrows and destroys all enemies; / she should be worshipped according to the rules at midnight on the dark eighth [tithi] / with perfumes, flowers, incenses, raw meats, and sacrificial offerings. 2

16.133.s:
phalatṛtīyāṃ nārī ca kuryādvai tatra bhāvitā ..
varṣamekaṃ site pakṣe devīṃ pūjya vidhānataḥ ..
phalāni brāhmaṇe deyānyeva nūnaṃ vidhānataḥ .. 3 ..
16.133.d:
फलतृतीयां नारी च कुर्याद्वै तत्र भाविता ..
वर्षमेकं सिते पक्षे देवीं पूज्य विधानतः ..
फलानि ब्राह्मणे देयान्येव नूनं विधानतः .. 3 ..
16.133.m: And a devoted woman should observe the Phalatṛtīyā vow there; / having worshipped the goddess according to the rules in the bright fortnight for one year, / fruits must certainly be given to a brahmin according to the rules. 3

16.133.s:
etāni varjayennakte hyannāni surasundari ..
niṣpāvā āḍhakī mudgā māṣāścaiva kulitthakāḥ..4..
16.133.d:
एतानि वर्जयेन्नक्ते ह्यन्नानि सुरसुन्दरि ..
निष्पावा आढकी मुद्गा माषाश्चैव कुलित्थकाः..4..
16.133.m: O beautiful goddess, she should avoid these foods during the night: / flat beans, pigeon peas, mung beans, black grams, and horse grams, 4

16.133.s:
masūrā rājamāṣāśca godhūmāstripuṭāstathā ..
caṇakā vartalā vāpi makuṣṭhāścaivamādayaḥ .. 5 ..
16.133.d:
मसूरा राजमाषाश्च गोधूमास्त्रिपुटास्तथा ..
चणका वर्तला वापि मकुष्ठाश्चैवमादयः .. 5 ..
16.133.m: lentils, cowpeas, wheat, grass peas, / chickpeas, peas, and moth beans, and the like. 5

16.133.s:
na bhakṣyāstāvatte devi yāvadgaurīvrataṃ caret ..
tasyāḥ puṇyaphalaṃ vakṣye kathyamānaṃ śṛṇuṣva me .. 6 ..
16.133.d:
न भक्ष्यास्तावत्ते देवि यावद्गौरीव्रतं चरेत् ..
तस्याः पुण्यफलं वक्ष्ये कथ्यमानं शृणुष्व मे .. 6 ..
16.133.m: These must not be eaten, O goddess, as long as she observes the vow of Gaurī. / Hear from me as I tell the meritorious fruit thereof: 6

16.133.s:
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ gṛhe tasyā na kadācitkṣayaṃ vrajet ..
duḥkhitā durbhagā dīnā sapta janmāni no bhavet .. 7 ..
16.133.d:
धनं धान्यं गृहे तस्या न कदाचित्क्षयं व्रजेत् ..
दुःखिता दुर्भगा दीना सप्त जन्मानि नो भवेत् .. 7 ..
16.133.m: wealth and grain in her house shall never suffer decline; / for seven births she shall not be sorrowful, unfortunate, or wretched. 7

16.133.s:
mahākālīvrataṃ proktaṃ devyā māhātmyasaṃyutam ..
kṛtaṃ pātakanāśāya sarvakāmasamṛddhaye .. 8 ..
16.133.d:
महाकालीव्रतं प्रोक्तं देव्या माहात्म्यसंयुतम् ..
कृतं पातकनाशाय सर्वकामसमृद्धये .. 8 ..
16.133.m: The vow of Mahākālī, accompanied by the greatness of the goddess, has been proclaimed; / it is performed for the destruction of wicked deeds and for the fulfillment of all desires. 8

16.133.s:
evaṃ devi samākhyātaṃ mahākālīmahodayam ..
kṣetrapīṭhaṃ mahādevi mantrasiddhipradāyakam .. 9 ..
16.133.d:
एवं देवि समाख्यातं महाकालीमहोदयम् ..
क्षेत्रपीठं महादेवि मन्त्रसिद्धिप्रदायकम् .. 9 ..
16.133.m: Thus, O goddess, the glorious [seat] of Mahākālī has been recounted, / a seat in the sacred field that bestows mantra-perfection, O great goddess. 9

16.133.s:
āśvayukchuklapakṣe tu navamyāṃ tatra jāgṛyāt ..
pīṭhe pūjābaliṃ dattvā mantraṃ kāmaṃ japanniśi ..
saumyacittaḥ samāpnoti vāṃchitāṃ siddhimuttamām .. 7.1.133.10 ..
16.133.d:
आश्वयुक्छुक्लपक्षे तु नवम्यां तत्र जागृयात् ..
पीठे पूजाबलिं दत्त्वा मन्त्रं कामं जपन्निशि ..
सौम्यचित्तः समाप्नोति वांछितां सिद्धिमुत्तमाम् .. 7.1.133.10 ..
16.133.m: One should keep vigil there on the ninth day in the bright fortnight of Āśvina; / having offered worship and oblations at the seat, muttering the mantra at night at will, / with a serene mind, one attains the highest desired perfection. 10

16.133.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mahākālīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 133 ..
16.133.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये महाकालीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयस्त्रिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 133 ..
16.133.m: Thus ends the one hundred thirty-third chapter, titled “Description of the Greatness of Mahākālī,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 133

16.134.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi puṣkarāvartakāṃ nadīm ..
brahmakuṃḍāduttarato nātidūre vyavasthitām .. 1 ..
16.134.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि पुष्करावर्तकां नदीम् ..
ब्रह्मकुंडादुत्तरतो नातिदूरे व्यवस्थिताम् .. 1 ..
16.134.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the Puṣkarāvartakā river, / situated not very far to the north of Brahmakuṇḍa. 1

16.134.s:
purā yajñe vartamāne somasya tu mahātmanaḥ ..
brahmā suragaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ ..2..
16.134.d:
पुरा यज्ञे वर्तमाने सोमस्य तु महात्मनः ..
ब्रह्मा सुरगणैः सार्धं प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागतः ..2..
16.134.m: Formerly, when the sacrifice of the high-souled Soma was going on, / Brahmā came to the sacred field of Prabhāsa along with the hosts of gods, 2

16.134.d:
सोमनाथप्रतिष्ठार्थमृक्षराजनिमंत्रितः ..
प्रतिज्ञातं पुरा तेन ब्रह्मणा लोककारिणा .. 3 ..
16.134.m: invited by the king of lunar mansions (the Moon) for the installation of Somanātha. / Formerly a promise had been made by that Brahmā, the creator of the world: 3

16.134.s:
yāvatsthāsyāmyahaṃ martye kasmiṃścitkāraṇāṃtare ..
tāvatsaṃdhyātrayaṃ vaṃdyaṃ nityameva tripuṣkare .. 4 ..
16.134.d:
यावत्स्थास्याम्यहं मर्त्ये कस्मिंश्चित्कारणांतरे ..
तावत्संध्यात्रयं वंद्यं नित्यमेव त्रिपुष्करे .. 4 ..
16.134.m: “As long as I abide among mortals for some reason or other, / so long must the three twilight rituals always be praised daily at Tripuṣkara.” 4

16.134.s:
etasminneva kāle tu lagnakāla upasthite ..
ādiṣṭaṃ śobhanaṃ kālaṃ brāhmaṇairdaivacintakaiḥ .. 5 ..
16.134.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु लग्नकाल उपस्थिते ..
आदिष्टं शोभनं कालं ब्राह्मणैर्दैवचिन्तकैः .. 5 ..
16.134.m: Just at that time, when the auspicious astrological hour had arrived, / the auspicious hour having been declared by the brahmins, the astrologers, 5

16.134.s:
tatastaṃ prasthitaṃ jñātvā puṣkare tu pitāmaham ..
saṃdhyārthaṃ rātrinātho vai vākyametaduvāca ha .. 6 ...
16.134.d:
ततस्तं प्रस्थितं ज्ञात्वा पुष्करे तु पितामहम् ..
संध्यार्थं रात्रिनाथो वै वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 6 ...
16.134.m: then the lord of the night, knowing that the Grandfather had departed to Puṣkara / for the twilight rite, spoke these words indeed: 6

16.134.s:
daivajñaiḥ kalitaḥ kāla eṣa eva śubhodayaḥ ..
yathā kālātyayo na syāttathā nītirvidhīyatām .. 7 ..
16.134.d:
दैवज्ञैः कलितः काल एष एव शुभोदयः ..
यथा कालात्ययो न स्यात्तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम् .. 7 ..
16.134.m: “This very hour has been calculated by the astrologers as an auspicious rising; / let proper conduct be arranged in such a way that the time is not missed.” 7

16.134.s:
taṃ jñātvā sāṃprataṃ kālaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ..
manasā cintayāmāsa puṣkarāṇi samāhitaḥ .. 8 ..
16.134.d:
तं ज्ञात्वा सांप्रतं कालं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ..
मनसा चिन्तयामास पुष्कराणि समाहितः .. 8 ..
16.134.m: Knowing that time to be the present one, Brahmā, the Grandfather of the worlds, / meditated upon the Puṣkaras with an attentive mind. 8

16.134.s:
tāni vai smṛtamātrāṇi brahmaṇā varavarṇini ..
prādurbhūtāni tatraiva nadyāstīre suśobhane .. 9 ..
16.134.d:
तानि वै स्मृतमात्राणि ब्रह्मणा वरवर्णिनि ..
प्रादुर्भूतानि तत्रैव नद्यास्तीरे सुशोभने .. 9 ..
16.134.m: As soon as they were merely remembered by Brahmā, O fair-complexioned lady, / they manifested right there on the beautiful bank of the river. 9

16.134.s:
āvartāstatra sañjātā jyeṣṭhamadhyakanīyasaḥ ..
atha nāmākarottasyā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ .. 7.1.134.10 ..
16.134.d:
आवर्तास्तत्र सञ्जाता ज्येष्ठमध्यकनीयसः ..
अथ नामाकरोत्तस्या ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः .. 7.1.134.10 ..
16.134.m: The whirlpools of the eldest, middle, and youngest [Puṣkara] arose there; / then Brahmā, the Grandfather of the worlds, gave her a name: 10

16.134.s:
puṣkarāvartakā nāmnā adyaprabhṛti śobhanā ..
nadī prayāsyate loke khyātiṃ mama prasādataḥ .. 11 ..
16.134.d:
पुष्करावर्तका नाम्ना अद्यप्रभृति शोभना ..
नदी प्रयास्यते लोके ख्यातिं मम प्रसादतः .. 11 ..
16.134.m: “From this day forward, by my grace, this auspicious river / named Puṣkarāvartakā shall become famous in the world. 11

16.134.s:
atra snātvā naro bhaktyā tarpayiṣyati yaḥ pitṝn ..
tripuṣkarasamaṃ puṇyaṃ lapsyate sa tathepsitam .. 12 ..
16.134.d:
अत्र स्नात्वा नरो भक्त्या तर्पयिष्यति यः पितॄन् ..
त्रिपुष्करसमं पुण्यं लप्स्यते स तथेप्सितम् .. 12 ..
16.134.m: Having bathed here, the man who with devotion offers libations to the ancestors / shall obtain merit equal to [bathing at] Tripuṣkara, and his desired goal likewise. 12

16.134.s:
śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣasya tṛtīyāyāṃ narottamaḥ ..
yaḥ pitṝṃstarpayettatra tṛptiḥ kalpāyutaṃ bhavet .. 13 ..
16.134.d:
श्रावणे शुक्लपक्षस्य तृतीयायां नरोत्तमः ..
यः पितॄंस्तर्पयेत्तत्र तृप्तिः कल्पायुतं भवेत् .. 13 ..
16.134.m: The best of men who offers libations to the ancestors there / on the third day of the bright fortnight in Śrāvaṇa, their satisfaction shall last for ten thousand kalpas.” 13

16.134.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye puṣkarāvartakānadīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 134..
16.134.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पुष्करावर्तकानदीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुस्त्रिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 134..
16.134.m: Thus ends the one hundred thirty-fourth chapter, titled “Description of the Greatness of the Puṣkarāvartakā River,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 134

16.135.s:
īśvara uvāca..
tatraiva saṃsthitāṃ paśyeddevīṃ duḥkhāṃtakāriṇīm..
śītaleti purā khyātā yuge dvāparasaṃjñite..
kalau punaḥ samākhyātāṃ kaliduḥkhāntakāriṇīm..1..
16.135.d:
ईश्वर उवाच..
तत्रैव संस्थितां पश्येद्देवीं दुःखांतकारिणीम्..
शीतलेति पुरा ख्याता युगे द्वापरसंज्ञिते..
कलौ पुनः समाख्यातां कलिदुःखान्तकारिणीम्..1..
16.135.m: Īśvara said: / Right there one should see the goddess who brings an end to sorrows; / formerly, in the age named Dvāpara, she was known as Śītalā, / and again in the Kali age she is proclaimed as the ender of Kali’s sorrows. 1

16.135.s:
śītalaṃ kurute dehaṃ bālānāṃ rogavarjitam..
pūjitā bhaktibhāvena tena sā śītalā smṛtā..2..
16.135.d:
शीतलं कुरुते देहं बालानां रोगवर्जितम्..
पूजिता भक्तिभावेन तेन सा शीतला स्मृता..2..
16.135.m: When worshipped with devotion, she makes the body of children cool / and free of disease; therefore she is remembered as Śītalā. 2

16.135.s:
visphoṭānāṃ praśāṃtyarthaṃ bālānāṃ caiva kāraṇāt ..
mānena māpitānkṛtvā masūrāṃstatra kuṭṭayet .. 3 ..
16.135.d:
विस्फोटानां प्रशांत्यर्थं बालानां चैव कारणात् ..
मानेन मापितान्कृत्वा मसूरांस्तत्र कुट्टयेत् .. 3 ..
16.135.m: For the appeasement of eruptions and for the sake of children, / one should measure out lentils by a standard measure and pound them there. 3

16.135.s:
śītalāpurato dattvā bālāḥ santu nirāmayāḥ ..
visphoṭacarcikādīnāṃ vātādīnāṃ śamo bhavet .. 4 ..
16.135.d:
शीतलापुरतो दत्त्वा बालाः सन्तु निरामयाः ..
विस्फोटचर्चिकादीनां वातादीनां शमो भवेत् .. 4 ..
16.135.m: Offering them in front of Śītalā, [praying] “May the children be free from disease,” / there shall be pacification of boils, scabs, and ailments caused by wind and the rest. 4
One should perform a śrāddha right there and feed brahmins there. (5)

16.135.s:
karpūraṃ kusumaṃ caiva mṛganābhiṃ sucandanam..
puṣpāṇi ca sugandhāni naivedyaṃ ghṛtapāyasam ..
nivedya devyai tatsarvaṃ daṃpatyoḥ paridhāpayet ..6..
16.135.d:
कर्पूरं कुसुमं चैव मृगनाभिं सुचन्दनम्..
पुष्पाणि च सुगन्धानि नैवेद्यं घृतपायसम् ..
निवेद्य देव्यै तत्सर्वं दंपत्योः परिधापयेत् ..6..
16.135.m:
Camphor, flowers, musk, good sandalwood,
fragrant blossoms, and an offering of milk-rice cooked in ghee—
having offered all that to the goddess, one should bestow clothing on a married couple. (6)

16.135.s:
navamyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu mālāṃ vilvamayīṃ śubhām..
bhaktyā nivedya tāṃ devyai sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāt .. 7 ..
16.135.d:
नवम्यां शुक्लपक्षे तु मालां विल्वमयीं शुभाम्..
भक्त्या निवेद्य तां देव्यै सर्वसिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् .. 7 ..
16.135.m:
Offering with devotion an auspicious garland of bilva leaves to the goddess
on the ninth day of the bright fortnight, one attains all perfections. (7)

16.135.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye duḥkhāntakāriṇītilāgaurīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcatriṃduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..135....
16.135.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये दुःखान्तकारिणीतिलागौरीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चत्रिंदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..135....
16.135.m: Thus ends the one hundred thirty-fifth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Duḥkhāntakāriṇī-Tilāgaurī', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. (135)

16.136.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi lomaśeśvaramuttamam ..
duḥkhāntakāriṇīpūrve dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam .. 1 ..
16.136.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लोमशेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
दुःखान्तकारिणीपूर्वे धनुषां सप्तके स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.136.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to the excellent Lomaśeśvara,
situated seven bows' lengths east of Duḥkhāntakāriṇī. (1)

16.136.s:
sthāpitaṃ tatra deveśi lomaśena maharṣiṇā ..
guhāmadhye mahāliṃgaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā suduścaram .. 2 ..
16.136.d:
स्थापितं तत्र देवेशि लोमशेन महर्षिणा ..
गुहामध्ये महालिंगं तपः कृत्वा सुदुश्चरम् .. 2 ..
16.136.m:
It was installed there inside a cave, O ruler of gods, by the great seer Lomaśa,
after performing austerity that was exceedingly difficult to accomplish. (2)

16.136.s:
koṭīnāṃ tritayaṃ sārdhamiṃdrādyāḥ svarbhujaḥ priye ..
yadā nāśaṃ gamiṣyaṃti tadā tasya kṣayo dhruvam .. 3 ..
16.136.d:
कोटीनां त्रितयं सार्धमिंद्राद्याः स्वर्भुजः प्रिये ..
यदा नाशं गमिष्यंति तदा तस्य क्षयो ध्रुवम् .. 3 ..
16.136.m:
When three and a half crores of heavenly beings, Indra and the others, O beloved,
come to destruction, only then does his death certainly occur. (3)

16.136.s:
yāvaṃti deharomāṇi indrāstāvanta eva ca ..
kramādindre vinaṣṭe tu tallomapatanaṃ bhavet .. 4 ..
16.136.d:
यावंति देहरोमाणि इन्द्रास्तावन्त एव च ..
क्रमादिन्द्रे विनष्टे तु तल्लोमपतनं भवेत् .. 4 ..
16.136.m:
As many hairs as there are on his body, just so many are the Indras;
with the successive destruction of each Indra, one hair of his falls out. (4)

16.136.s:
evamīśaprasādena cirāyurlomaśo'bhavat ..
brahmāṇaḥ ṣaḍvinaśyanti samagrāyuṣi lomaśe .. 5 ..
16.136.d:
एवमीशप्रसादेन चिरायुर्लोमशोऽभवत् ..
ब्रह्माणः षड्विनश्यन्ति समग्रायुषि लोमशे .. 5 ..
16.136.m:
Thus by the grace of Īśa, Lomaśa became long-lived.
Six Brahmās perish during the entire lifespan of Lomaśa. (5)

16.136.s:
ya evaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā talliṃgaṃ lomaśārcitam ..
so'pi dīrghāyurāpnoti nirvyādhirnīrujaḥ sukhī .. 6 ..
16.136.d:
य एवं पूजयेद्भक्त्या तल्लिंगं लोमशार्चितम् ..
सोऽपि दीर्घायुराप्नोति निर्व्याधिर्नीरुजः सुखी .. 6 ..
16.136.m:
Whoever worships with devotion this liṅga venerated by Lomaśa,
he too attains long life, free from affliction, free from disease, and happy. (6)

16.136.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye lomaśeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 136 .. .. .. .. ..
16.136.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये लोमशेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्त्रिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 136 .. .. .. .. ..
16.136.m: Thus ends the one hundred thirty-sixth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Lomaśeśvara', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. (136)

16.137.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyetkṣetrapālamanuttamam ..
kaṃkālabhairavaṃnāma bhairaveṇa niyojitam ..
tasya kṣetrasya rakṣārthaṃ prāṇināṃ duṣṭacetasām .. 1 ..
16.137.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव संस्थितं पश्येत्क्षेत्रपालमनुत्तमम् ..
कंकालभैरवंनाम भैरवेण नियोजितम् ..
तस्य क्षेत्रस्य रक्षार्थं प्राणिनां दुष्टचेतसाम् .. 1 ..
16.137.m:
Īśvara said:
One should behold the peerless guardian of the field (kṣetrapāla) standing right there,
named Kaṅkālabhairava, appointed by Bhairava
for the protection of that field from living beings of evil intent. (1)

16.137.s:
śrāvaṇe śuklapañcamyāmaṣṭamyāmāśvinasya ca ..
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā balipuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt .. 2 ..
16.137.d:
श्रावणे शुक्लपञ्चम्यामष्टम्यामाश्विनस्य च ..
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या बलिपुष्पादिभिः क्रमात् .. 2 ..
16.137.m:
Whoever worships him with devotion with offerings, flowers, and the like in due order,
on the fifth day of the bright fortnight of Śrāvaṇa and on the eighth day of Āśvina, (2)

16.137.s:
tasya kṣetre nivasataḥ puṣkarasya mahātmanaḥ ..
nirvighnakārī bhavati tathā rakṣati putravat .. 3 ..
16.137.d:
तस्य क्षेत्रे निवसतः पुष्करस्य महात्मनः ..
निर्विघ्नकारी भवति तथा रक्षति पुत्रवत् .. 3 ..
16.137.m:
for him, living in the sacred field of the great-souled Puṣkara,
he removes all obstacles and protects him like a son. (3)

16.137.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kaṃkālabhairavakṣetrapālamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 137 ..
16.137.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कंकालभैरवक्षेत्रपालमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तत्रिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 137 ..
16.137.m: Thus ends the one hundred thirty-seventh chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of the Field Guardian Kaṅkālabhairava', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. (137)

16.138.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyaiva paścime bhāge dhanupāṃ pañcake sthitam ..
tṛṇabindvīśvaraṃnāma tīvrabhaktyā pratiṣṭhitam .. 1 ..
16.138.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्यैव पश्चिमे भागे धनुपां पञ्चके स्थितम् ..
तृणबिन्द्वीश्वरंनाम तीव्रभक्त्या प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 1 ..
16.138.m:
Īśvara said:
On its western side, situated at a distance of five bows' lengths,
is the one named Tṛṇabindvīśvara, established with intense devotion. (1)

16.138.s:
kṛtvā mahattapo devi tṛṇabiṃdumu nīśvaraḥ ..
māsimāsi kuśāgreṇa jalabiṃduṃ nipīya vai .. 2 ..
16.138.d:
कृत्वा महत्तपो देवि तृणबिंदुमु नीश्वरः ..
मासिमासि कुशाग्रेण जलबिंदुं निपीय वै .. 2 ..
16.138.m:
Having performed great austerity, O goddess, the lord of sages Tṛṇabindu,
drinking month by month a single drop of water from the tip of a kuśa grass, (2)

16.138.s:
saṃvatsarāṇyanekāni evamārādhya ceśvaram ..
saṃprāptaṃ paramāṃ siddhiṃ kṣetre prābhāsike śubhe .. 3 ..
16.138.d:
संवत्सराण्यनेकानि एवमाराध्य चेश्वरम् ..
संप्राप्तं परमां सिद्धिं क्षेत्रे प्राभासिके शुभे .. 3 ..
16.138.m:
and thus propitiating Īśvara for many years,
attained supreme perfection in the auspicious sacred field of Prabhāsa. (3)

16.138.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye tṛṇabiṃdvīśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmāṣṭātriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 138 ..
16.138.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये तृणबिंद्वीश्वरमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनामाष्टात्रिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 138 ..
16.138.m: Thus ends the one hundred thirty-eighth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Tṛṇabindvīśvara', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. (138)

16.139.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi citrādityamanuttamam ..
tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge brahmakuṇḍasamīpataḥ .. 1 ..
16.139.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि चित्रादित्यमनुत्तमम् ..
तस्यैव दक्षिणे भागे ब्रह्मकुण्डसमीपतः .. 1 ..
16.139.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to the peerless Citrāditya,
on its southern side, near the Brahmakuṇḍa. (1)

16.139.s:
mahāprabhāvo deveśi sarvadāridryanāśanaḥ ..
mitro nāma purā devi dharmātmā'bhūddharātale ..
kāyasthaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ nityaṃ bhūtahite rataḥ .. 2 ..
16.139.d:
महाप्रभावो देवेशि सर्वदारिद्र्यनाशनः ..
मित्रो नाम पुरा देवि धर्मात्माऽभूद्धरातले ..
कायस्थः सर्वभूतानां नित्यं भूतहिते रतः .. 2 ..
16.139.m:
He possesses great power, O ruler of gods, and destroys all poverty.
Formerly on earth, O goddess, there was a righteous man named Mitra,
who perceived the essence of all beings, always intent on the welfare of all creatures. (2)

16.139.s:
tasyāpatyadvayaṃ jajña ṛtukālābhigāminaḥ ..
putraḥ paramatejasvī citronāma varānane .. 3 ..
16.139.d:
तस्यापत्यद्वयं जज्ञ ऋतुकालाभिगामिनः ..
पुत्रः परमतेजस्वी चित्रोनाम वरानने .. 3 ..
16.139.m:
Two children were born to him as he approached [his wife] during the fertile season:
a son of supreme splendor named Citra, O fair-faced one, (3)

16.139.s: tathā citrā'bhavatkanyā rūpāḍhyā śīlamaṃḍanā .. 4 ..
16.139.d: तथा चित्राऽभवत्कन्या रूपाढ्या शीलमंडना .. 4 ..
16.139.m: and likewise a daughter was born, Citrā, richly endowed with beauty and adorned with good conduct. (4)

16.139.s:
ābhyāṃ tu jātamātrābhyāṃ mitraḥ pañcatvameyivān ..
atha tasya varā bhāryā saha tenāgnimāviśat .. 5 ..
16.139.d:
आभ्यां तु जातमात्राभ्यां मित्रः पञ्चत्वमेयिवान् ..
अथ तस्य वरा भार्या सह तेनाग्निमाविशत् .. 5 ..
16.139.m:
As soon as these two were born, Mitra attained dissolution into the five elements.
Then his excellent wife entered the fire along with him. (5)

16.139.s:
atha tau bālakau dīnāvṛṣibhiḥ paripālitau ..
vṛddhiṃ gatau mahāraṇye bālāveva sthitau vrate .. 6 ..
16.139.d:
अथ तौ बालकौ दीनावृषिभिः परिपालितौ ..
वृद्धिं गतौ महारण्ये बालावेव स्थितौ व्रते .. 6 ..
16.139.m:
Then those two helpless children, reared by seers,
grew up in the great forest, remaining committed to vows even as children. (6)

16.139.s:
prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya tapaḥ paramamāsthitau ..
pratiṣṭhāpya mahā devaṃ bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram .. 7 ..
16.139.d:
प्रभासं क्षेत्रमासाद्य तपः परममास्थितौ ..
प्रतिष्ठाप्य महा देवं भास्करं वारितस्करम् .. 7 ..
16.139.m:
Having arrived at the sacred field of Prabhāsa, they undertook supreme austerity,
having installed the great god, the sun, the stealer of waters. (7)

16.139.s:
pūjayāmāsa dharmātmā dhūpamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
vasiṣṭhakathitaiścaiva hyaṣṭaṣaṣṭisamanvitaiḥ ..
nāmabhiḥ sūryadeveśaṃ tuṣṭāva prāñjaliḥ prabhum .. 8 ..
16.139.d:
पूजयामास धर्मात्मा धूपमाल्यानुलेपनैः ..
वसिष्ठकथितैश्चैव ह्यष्टषष्टिसमन्वितैः ..
नामभिः सूर्यदेवेशं तुष्टाव प्राञ्जलिः प्रभुम् .. 8 ..

16.139.s:
.. citra uvāca .. ..
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ bhāskaraṃ gaganādhipam ..
ādidevaṃ jagannāthaṃ pāpaghnaṃ roganāśanam .. 9 ...
16.139.d:
.. चित्र उवाच .. ..
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं भास्करं गगनाधिपम् ..
आदिदेवं जगन्नाथं पापघ्नं रोगनाशनम् .. 9 ...
16.139.m:
Citra said:
Bowing with my head to the god, the sun, lord of the sky,
the primal god, lord of the universe, destroyer of sins, dispeller of disease, (9)

16.139.s: sahasrākṣaṃ sahasrāṃśuṃ sahasrakiraṇadyutim .. 7.1.139.10 ..
16.139.d: सहस्राक्षं सहस्रांशुं सहस्रकिरणद्युतिम् .. 7.1.139.10 ..
16.139.m: the thousand-eyed, thousand-rayed one, shining with the light of a thousand beams— (10)

16.139.s:
tamahaṃ saṃstaviṣyāmi saṃpṛktaṃ guhyanāmabhiḥ ..
muṃḍīrasvāminaṃ prātargaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame ..
kālapriyaṃ tu madhyāhne yamunātīramāśritam .. 11 ..
16.139.d:
तमहं संस्तविष्यामि संपृक्तं गुह्यनामभिः ..
मुंडीरस्वामिनं प्रातर्गंगासागरसंगमे ..
कालप्रियं तु मध्याह्ने यमुनातीरमाश्रितम् .. 11 ..

16.139.s:
mūlasthānaṃ cāstamane candrabhāgātaṭe sthitam..
yatra sāṃbaḥ svayaṃ siddha upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ ..12..
16.139.d:
मूलस्थानं चास्तमने चन्द्रभागातटे स्थितम्..
यत्र सांबः स्वयं सिद्ध उपवासपरायणः ..12..
16.139.m:
and Mūlasthāna at sunset, situated on the bank of the Candrabhāgā,
where Sāmba himself, dedicated to fasting, achieved perfection; (12)

16.139.s:
vārāṇasyāṃ lohitākṣaṃ gobhilākṣe bṛhanmukham ..
prayāgeṣu pratiṣṭhānaṃ vṛddhādityaṃ mahādyutim ..13..
16.139.d:
वाराणस्यां लोहिताक्षं गोभिलाक्षे बृहन्मुखम् ..
प्रयागेषु प्रतिष्ठानं वृद्धादित्यं महाद्युतिम् ..13..
16.139.m:
Lohitākṣa in Vārāṇasī; Bṛhanmukha in Gobhilākṣa;
Pratiṣṭhāna in Prayāga; the immensely brilliant Vṛddhāditya; (13)

16.139.s:
koṭyakṣe dvādaśādityaṃ gaṃgādityaṃ caturghaṭe ..
naimiṣe caiva goghne ca bhadraṃ bhadrapuṭe sthitam ..14..
16.139.d:
कोट्यक्षे द्वादशादित्यं गंगादित्यं चतुर्घटे ..
नैमिषे चैव गोघ्ने च भद्रं भद्रपुटे स्थितम् ..14..
16.139.m:
Dvādaśāditya at Koṭyakṣa; Gaṅgāditya at Caturghaṭa;
and in Naimiṣa, Goghna; Bhadra situated in Bhadrapuṭa; (14)

16.139.s:
jayāyāṃ vijayādityaṃ prabhāse svarṇavetasam ..
kurukṣetre ca sāmaṃtaṃ trimaṃtraṃ ca ilāvṛte ..15..
16.139.d:
जयायां विजयादित्यं प्रभासे स्वर्णवेतसम् ..
कुरुक्षेत्रे च सामंतं त्रिमंत्रं च इलावृते ..15..
16.139.m:
Vijayāditya in Jayā; Svarṇavetasa in Prabhāsa;
Sāmanta in Kurukṣetra; and Trimantra in Ilāvṛta; (15)

16.139.s:
mahendre kramaṇādityamṛṇe siddheśvaraṃ viduḥ ..
kauśāṃbyāṃ padmabodhaṃ ca brahmabāhau divākaram..16..
16.139.d:
महेन्द्रे क्रमणादित्यमृणे सिद्धेश्वरं विदुः ..
कौशांब्यां पद्मबोधं च ब्रह्मबाहौ दिवाकरम्..16..
16.139.m:
Kramaṇāditya on Mahendra; in Ṛṇa they know him as Siddheśvara;
Padmabodha in Kauśāmbī; Divākara in Brahmabāhu; (16)

16.139.s:
kedāre caṇḍakāṃtiṃ ca nitye ca timirāpaham ..
gaṃgāmārge śivadvāramādityaṃ bhūpradī pane ..17..
16.139.d:
केदारे चण्डकांतिं च नित्ये च तिमिरापहम् ..
गंगामार्गे शिवद्वारमादित्यं भूप्रदी पने ..17..
16.139.m:
Caṇḍakānti in Kedāra; and Timirāpaha in Nitya;
Śivadvāra on the path of the Gaṅgā; the Aditya in Bhūpradīpana; (17)

16.139.s:
haṃsaṃ sarasvatītīre viśvāmitraṃ pṛthūdake ..
ujjayinyāṃ naradvīpaṃ siddhāyāmamaladyutim ..18..
16.139.d:
हंसं सरस्वतीतीरे विश्वामित्रं पृथूदके ..
उज्जयिन्यां नरद्वीपं सिद्धायाममलद्युतिम् ..18..
16.139.m:
Haṃsa on the bank of the Sarasvatī; Viśvāmitra in Pṛthūdaka;
Naradvīpa in Ujjayinī; Amaladyuti in Siddhā; (18)

16.139.s:
sūryaṃ kuntīkumāre ca pañcanadyāṃ vibhāvasum ...
mathurāyāṃ vimalādityaṃ saṃjñādityaṃ tu saṃjñike .. 19 ..
16.139.d:
सूर्यं कुन्तीकुमारे च पञ्चनद्यां विभावसुम् ...
मथुरायां विमलादित्यं संज्ञादित्यं तु संज्ञिके .. 19 ..
16.139.m:
Sūrya in Kuntīkumāra; and Vibhāvasu in Pañcanada;
Vimalāditya in Mathurā; and Saṃjñāditya in Saṃjñika; (19)

16.139.s:
śrīkaṇṭhe caiva mārtaṇḍaṃ daśārṇe daśakaṃ smṛtam ..
godhane gopatiṃ devaṃ karṇaṃ caiva marusthale ..7.1.139.20...
16.139.d:
श्रीकण्ठे चैव मार्तण्डं दशार्णे दशकं स्मृतम् ..
गोधने गोपतिं देवं कर्णं चैव मरुस्थले ..7.1.139.20...
16.139.m:
Mārtaṇḍa in Śrīkaṇṭha; Daśaka is remembered in Daśārṇa;
the divine Gopati in Godhana; and Karṇa in the desert. (20)

16.139.s:
puṣpaṃ devapure caiva keśavārkaṃ tu lohite ..
vaidiśe caiva śārdūlaṃ śoṇe vāruṇavāsinam .. 21 ..
16.139.d:
पुष्पं देवपुरे चैव केशवार्कं तु लोहिते ..
वैदिशे चैव शार्दूलं शोणे वारुणवासिनम् .. 21 ..
16.139.m: And Puṣpa in Devapura, Keśavārka in Lohita, / Śārdūla in Vaidiśa, and the Dweller in Vāruṇa at the Śoṇa, 21

16.139.s:
vardhamāne ca sāṃbākhyaṃ kāmarūpe śubhaṃkaram ..
mihiraṃ kānyakubje ca maṃdāraṃ puṇyavardhane .. 22 ..
16.139.d:
वर्धमाने च सांबाख्यं कामरूपे शुभंकरम् ..
मिहिरं कान्यकुब्जे च मंदारं पुण्यवर्धने .. 22 ..
16.139.m: the one named Sāmba in Vardhamāna, Śubhaṃkara in Kāmarūpa, / Mihira in Kānyakubja, and Mandāra in Puṇyavardhana, 22

16.139.s:
gandhāre kṣobhaṇādityaṃ laṃkāyāmamaradyutim ..
karṇādityaṃ ca caṃpāyāṃ prabodhe śubhadarśinam .. 23 ..
16.139.d:
गन्धारे क्षोभणादित्यं लंकायाममरद्युतिम् ..
कर्णादित्यं च चंपायां प्रबोधे शुभदर्शिनम् .. 23 ..
16.139.m: Kṣobhaṇāditya in Gandhāra, Amaradyuti in Laṅkā, / Karṇāditya in Campā, and Śubhadarśin in Prabodha, 23

16.139.s:
dvārā vatyāṃ tu pārvatyaṃ himavante himāpaham ..
mahātejaṃ tu lauhitye amalāṃge ca dhūjaṭim .. 24 ..
16.139.d:
द्वारा वत्यां तु पार्वत्यं हिमवन्ते हिमापहम् ..
महातेजं तु लौहित्ये अमलांगे च धूजटिम् .. 24 ..
16.139.m: Pārvatya in Dvārāvatī, Himāpaha in Himavant, / Mahātejas in Lauhitya, and Dhūrjaṭi in Amalāṅga, 24

16.139.s:
rohike tu kumārākhyaṃ padmāyāṃ padmasaṃbhavam..
dharmādityaṃ tu lāṭāyāṃ marddake sthaviraṃ viduḥ .. 25 ..
16.139.d:
रोहिके तु कुमाराख्यं पद्मायां पद्मसंभवम्..
धर्मादित्यं तु लाटायां मर्द्दके स्थविरं विदुः .. 25 ..
16.139.m: the one named Kumāra in Rohika, Padmasambhava in Padmā, / Dharmāditya in Lāṭā; and in Mardaka they know Sthavira, 25

16.139.s:
sukhapradaṃ tu kauberyāṃ kosale gopatiṃ tathā ..
kauṃkaṇe tu padmadevaṃ tāpanaṃ vindhyaparvate .. 26 ..
16.139.d:
सुखप्रदं तु कौबेर्यां कोसले गोपतिं तथा ..
कौंकणे तु पद्मदेवं तापनं विन्ध्यपर्वते .. 26 ..
16.139.m: Sukhaprada in Kauberī, Gopati in Kosala, / Padmadeva in Kauṅkaṇa, and Tāpana on Mount Vindhya, 26

16.139.s:
tvaṣṭāraṃ caiva kāśmīre caritre ratnasaṃbhavam ..
puṣkare hemagarbhasthaṃ vidyātsūryaṃ gabhastike .. 27 ..
16.139.d:
त्वष्टारं चैव काश्मीरे चरित्रे रत्नसंभवम् ..
पुष्करे हेमगर्भस्थं विद्यात्सूर्यं गभस्तिके .. 27 ..
16.139.m: Tvaṣṭṛ in Kāśmīra, Ratnasambhava in Caritra, / Hemagarbhastha in Puṣkara, and one should know Sūrya in Gabhastika, 27

16.139.s:
prakāśāyāṃ tu mujjhālaṃ tīrthagrāme prabhākaram ..
kāṃpilye rillakādityaṃ dhanake dhanavāsinam ..28..
16.139.d:
प्रकाशायां तु मुज्झालं तीर्थग्रामे प्रभाकरम् ..
कांपिल्ये रिल्लकादित्यं धनके धनवासिनम् ..28..
16.139.m: Muddhāla in Prakāśā, Prabhākara in Tīrthagrāma, / Rillakāditya in Kāmpilya, and Dhanavāsin in Dhanaka, 28

16.139.s:
analaṃ narmadātīre sarvatra gamanādhikam..
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṃ tu devasya bhāskarasyāmitadyuteḥ .. 29 ..
16.139.d:
अनलं नर्मदातीरे सर्वत्र गमनाधिकम्..
अष्टषष्टिं तु देवस्य भास्करस्यामितद्युतेः .. 29 ..
16.139.m: Anala on the bank of the Narmadā, whose movement everywhere is supreme; / [these are] the sixty-eight [forms] of the god Bhāskara of boundless splendor. 29

16.139.s:
prātarutthāya vai nityaṃ śaktimāñchucimānnaraḥ ..
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 7.1.139.30 ..
16.139.d:
प्रातरुत्थाय वै नित्यं शक्तिमाञ्छुचिमान्नरः ..
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 7.1.139.30 ..
16.139.m: A capable, pure man who rises early in the morning and constantly / recites or hears this is freed from all sins. 30

16.139.s:
rājyārthī labhate rājyaṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam ..
putrārthī labhate putrānsaukhyārthī labhate sukham .. 31 ..
16.139.d:
राज्यार्थी लभते राज्यं धनार्थी लभते धनम् ..
पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रान्सौख्यार्थी लभते सुखम् .. 31 ..
16.139.m: One seeking a kingdom obtains a kingdom; one seeking wealth obtains wealth; / one seeking sons obtains sons; one seeking happiness obtains happiness. 31

16.139.s:
rogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt ..
yānyānprārthayate kāmāṃstāṃstānprāpnoti mānavaḥ ..32.. ..
16.139.d:
रोगार्तो मुच्यते रोगाद्बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात् ..
यान्यान्प्रार्थयते कामांस्तांस्तान्प्राप्नोति मानवः ..32.. ..
16.139.m: One afflicted with disease is freed from disease; one bound is freed from bondage; / whatever desires a mortal prays for, those very desires he obtains. 32

16.139.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evaṃ ca stuvatastasya citrasya vimalātmanaḥ ..
tatastuṣṭaḥ sahasrāṃśuḥ kālena mahatā vibhuḥ .. 33 ..
16.139.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवं च स्तुवतस्तस्य चित्रस्य विमलात्मनः ..
ततस्तुष्टः सहस्रांशुः कालेन महता विभुः .. 33 ..
16.139.m: Īśvara said: / As Citra of pure soul was thus praising him, / the lord of a thousand rays, the all-pervading one, was pleased after a long time. 33

16.139.s: abravīdvatsa bhadraṃ te varaṃ varaya suvrata .. 34 ..
16.139.d: अब्रवीद्वत्स भद्रं ते वरं वरय सुव्रत .. 34 ..
16.139.m: He said: “Child, may good fortune be yours! Choose a boon, O you of noble vows.” 34

16.139.s:
so'bravīdyadi me tuṣṭo bhagavaṃstīkṣṇadīdhiteḥ ..
prauḍhatvaṃ sarvakāryeṣu naya māṃ jñānitāṃ tathā .. 35 ..
16.139.d:
सोऽब्रवीद्यदि मे तुष्टो भगवंस्तीक्ष्णदीधितेः ..
प्रौढत्वं सर्वकार्येषु नय मां ज्ञानितां तथा .. 35 ..
16.139.m: He said: “If, O lord of sharp rays, you are pleased with me, / lead me to proficiency in all tasks and likewise to wisdom.” 35
