16.139.s:
tattatheti prati jñātaṃ sūryeṇa varavarṇini ..
tataḥ sarvajñatāṃ prāptaścitro mitrakulodbhavaḥ ..36..
16.139.d:
तत्तथेति प्रति ज्ञातं सूर्येण वरवर्णिनि ..
ततः सर्वज्ञतां प्राप्तश्चित्रो मित्रकुलोद्भवः ..36..
16.139.m: “So be it, so be it,” the sun promised, O fair-complexioned lady. / Then Citra, born of the solar line, attained omniscience. 36

16.139.s:
taṃ jñātvā dharmarājastu buddhyā paramayā yutam..
ciṃtayāmāsa medhāvī lekha ko'yaṃ bhavedyadi .. 37 ..
16.139.d:
तं ज्ञात्वा धर्मराजस्तु बुद्ध्या परमया युतम्..
चिंतयामास मेधावी लेख कोऽयं भवेद्यदि .. 37 ..
16.139.m: Knowing him to be endowed with supreme intellect, Dharmarāja, / being wise, thought: “If this one were to become my scribe, 37

16.139.s:
tato me sarvasiddhiḥ syānnirvṛtiśca parā bhavet ..
evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya dharmarājasya bhāmini..38..
16.139.d:
ततो मे सर्वसिद्धिः स्यान्निर्वृतिश्च परा भवेत् ..
एवं चिंतयतस्तस्य धर्मराजस्य भामिनि..38..
16.139.m: then all success would be mine, and my satisfaction would be supreme.” / As Dharmarāja was thus contemplating, O passionate woman, 38

16.139.s:
agnitīrthe gate citre snā nārthaṃ lavaṇāmbhasi ..
sa tatra praviśanneva nītastu yamakiṃkaraiḥ ..39..
16.139.d:
अग्नितीर्थे गते चित्रे स्ना नार्थं लवणाम्भसि ..
स तत्र प्रविशन्नेव नीतस्तु यमकिंकरैः ..39..
16.139.m: Citra went to the Agnitīrtha to bathe in the salt water; / as he was entering there, he was carried off by the servants of Yama, 39

16.139.s:
saśarīro mahādevi yamādeśaparāyaṇaiḥ ..
sa citraguptanāmā'bhūdviśvacāritralekhakaḥ .. 7.1.139.40 ..
16.139.d:
सशरीरो महादेवि यमादेशपरायणैः ..
स चित्रगुप्तनामाऽभूद्विश्वचारित्रलेखकः .. 7.1.139.40 ..
16.139.m: bodily, O great goddess, by those devoted to Yama’s command. / He became the recorder of the deeds of the universe named Citragupta. 40

16.139.s: citrādityetināmā'bhūttato loke varānane .. 41 ..
16.139.d: चित्रादित्येतिनामाऽभूत्ततो लोके वरानने .. 41 ..
16.139.m: Then, O fair-faced lady, he became known in the world by the name Citrāditya. 41

16.139.s:
saptamyāṃ niyatāhāro yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ ..
sapta janmāni dāridryaṃ na duḥkhaṃ tasya jāyate ..42..
16.139.d:
सप्तम्यां नियताहारो यस्तं पूजयते नरः ..
सप्त जन्मानि दारिद्र्यं न दुःखं तस्य जायते ..42..
16.139.m: The man who worships him on the seventh day with regulated food, / for seven births poverty does not arise for him, nor sorrow. 42

16.139.s:
tatraiva cāśvo dātavyaḥ sakoṣaṃ khaḍgameva ca ..
hiraṇyaṃ caiva viprāya evaṃ yātrāphalaṃ labhet ..43..
16.139.d:
तत्रैव चाश्वो दातव्यः सकोषं खड्गमेव च ..
हिरण्यं चैव विप्राय एवं यात्राफलं लभेत् ..43..
16.139.m: Right there a horse should be given, as well as a sword with its sheath, / and gold to a brahmin; thus one obtains the fruit of the pilgrimage. 43

16.139.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye citrādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..139...
16.139.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये चित्रादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनचत्वारिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..139...
16.139.m: Thus ends the one hundred and thirty-ninth chapter, entitled “Description of the Greatness of Citrāditya,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 139

16.140.s:
tato gacchenmahādevi nadīṃ citrapathāṃ tataḥ ..
brahmakuṇḍasamīpasthāṃ citrādityasya madhyataḥ .. 1 ..
16.140.d:
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि नदीं चित्रपथां ततः ..
ब्रह्मकुण्डसमीपस्थां चित्रादित्यस्य मध्यतः .. 1 ..
16.140.m: Then, O great goddess, one should go to the river Citrapathā, / situated near the Brahmakuṇḍa, amidst Citrāditya. 1

16.140.s:
yadā ca citraḥ saṃnīto yamadūtaiḥ surapriye ..
saśarīro mahāprājño yamādeśaparāyaṇaiḥ .. 2 ..
16.140.d:
यदा च चित्रः संनीतो यमदूतैः सुरप्रिये ..
सशरीरो महाप्राज्ञो यमादेशपरायणैः .. 2 ..
16.140.m: And when Citra, the very wise, was carried away in his body / by Yama's messengers devoted to Yama's command, O beloved of the gods, 2

16.140.s:
evaṃ jñātvā tu tatrasthā bhaginī tasya duḥkhitā ..
citrā nadī tato bhūtvā svasā tasya mahātmanaḥ .. 3 ..
16.140.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा तु तत्रस्था भगिनी तस्य दुःखिता ..
चित्रा नदी ततो भूत्वा स्वसा तस्य महात्मनः .. 3 ..
16.140.m: his sister, who was there, learning of this and grieving, / that sister of the noble-souled one, having then become the river Citrā, 3

16.140.s:
praviṣṭā sāgare devi anveṣantī ca bāṃdhavam ..
tataścitrapathānāma tasyāścakrurdvijātayaḥ .. 4 ..
16.140.d:
प्रविष्टा सागरे देवि अन्वेषन्ती च बांधवम् ..
ततश्चित्रपथानाम तस्याश्चक्रुर्द्विजातयः .. 4 ..
16.140.m: entered the ocean, O goddess, searching for her brother. / Then the twice-born named her Citrapathā. 4

16.140.s: evaṃ tatra samutpannā sā nadī varavarṇini .. 5 ..
16.140.d: एवं तत्र समुत्पन्ना सा नदी वरवर्णिनि .. 5 ..
16.140.m: Thus that river was born there, O fair-complexioned lady. 5

16.140.s:
tasyāṃ snātvā naro yastu citrādityaṃ prapaśyati ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ .. 6 ..
16.140.d:
तस्यां स्नात्वा नरो यस्तु चित्रादित्यं प्रपश्यति ..
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो दिवाकरः .. 6 ..
16.140.m: A man who bathes in it and beholds Citrāditya / goes to the supreme abode where the divine sun resides. 6

16.140.s:
asminkaliyuge devi aṃtardhānaṃ gatā nadī ..
prāvṛṭkāle ca dṛśyeta durlabhaṃ tatra darśanam .. 7 ..
16.140.d:
अस्मिन्कलियुगे देवि अंतर्धानं गता नदी ..
प्रावृट्काले च दृश्येत दुर्लभं तत्र दर्शनम् .. 7 ..
16.140.m: In this Kali age, O goddess, the river has disappeared; / it can be seen in the rainy season, and its darśana is difficult to obtain. 7
Bathing and giving especially destroy all sins. 8

16.140.s:
bhukto vāpyathavā'bhukto rātrau vā yadi vā divā ..
parvakāle'thavā'kāle pavitro'pyathavā'śuciḥ .. 9 ..
16.140.d:
भुक्तो वाप्यथवाऽभुक्तो रात्रौ वा यदि वा दिवा ..
पर्वकालेऽथवाऽकाले पवित्रोऽप्यथवाऽशुचिः .. 9 ..
16.140.m: Whether one has eaten or not eaten, by night or by day, / on a festival day or at an improper time, whether pure or impure, 9

16.140.s:
yadaiva dṛśyate tatra nadī citrapathā priye ..
pramāṇaṃ darśanaṃ tasyā na kālastatra kāraṇam .. 7.1.140.10 ..
16.140.d:
यदैव दृश्यते तत्र नदी चित्रपथा प्रिये ..
प्रमाणं दर्शनं तस्या न कालस्तत्र कारणम् .. 7.1.140.10 ..
16.140.m: whenever the river Citrapathā is seen there, O dear one, / its darśana is the authority; time is of no consequence there. 10

16.140.s:
dṛṣṭvā nadīṃ mahādevi pitaraḥ svargasaṃsthitāḥ ..
gāyaṃti tatra sāmāni nṛtyanti ca hasaṃti ca .. 11 ..
16.140.d:
दृष्ट्वा नदीं महादेवि पितरः स्वर्गसंस्थिताः ..
गायंति तत्र सामानि नृत्यन्ति च हसंति च .. 11 ..
16.140.m: Beholding the river, O great goddess, the ancestors residing in heaven / sing Sāman hymns there, dance, and laugh: 11

16.140.s:
asmākaṃ vaṃśajaḥ kaścicchrāddhamatra kariṣyati ..
yāvatkalpaṃ tathā'smākaṃ prītimutpādayiṣyati .. 12 ..
16.140.d:
अस्माकं वंशजः कश्चिच्छ्राद्धमत्र करिष्यति ..
यावत्कल्पं तथाऽस्माकं प्रीतिमुत्पादयिष्यति .. 12 ..
16.140.m: “Someone born of our lineage will perform a śrāddha here / and bring us joy for as long as a kalpa!” 12

16.140.s:
evaṃ jñātvā narastatra snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ ca kārayet ..
sarvapāpavināśārthaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītaye tathā .. .. 13 ..
16.140.d:
एवं ज्ञात्वा नरस्तत्र स्नानं श्राद्धं च कारयेत् ..
सर्वपापविनाशार्थं पितॄणां प्रीतये तथा .. .. 13 ..
16.140.m: Knowing this, a man should perform bathing and a śrāddha there / for the destruction of all sins and for the pleasure of the ancestors. 13

16.140.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ devi yathā citrapathā nadī ..
prabhāsakṣetramāsādya saṃsthitā pāpanāśinī .. 14 ..
16.140.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं देवि यथा चित्रपथा नदी ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रमासाद्य संस्थिता पापनाशिनी .. 14 ..
16.140.m: Thus has this been told, O goddess, how the river Citrapathā, / having reached the Prabhāsa sacred field, remains destroying sins. 14

16.140.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye citrapathānadīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ... .. 140 ..
16.140.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एका शीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये चित्रपथानदीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चत्वारिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ... .. 140 ..
16.140.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fortieth chapter, entitled “Description of the Greatness of the River Citrapathā,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 140

16.141.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kapardī yatra saṃsthitaḥ ..
tasyaiva uttare bhāge nātidūre vyavasthitaḥ ..
ciṃtitārthaprado devi cintāmaṇirivāparaḥ .. 1 ..
16.141.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि कपर्दी यत्र संस्थितः ..
तस्यैव उत्तरे भागे नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितः ..
चिंतितार्थप्रदो देवि चिन्तामणिरिवापरः .. 1 ..
16.141.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to where Kapardin is situated; / stationed not very far to the north of him, / granting the desired objects, O goddess, like a second wish-fulfilling jewel. 1

16.141.s:
caturthyāṃ taṃ tu deveśi aṃgārakadine punaḥ ..
snāpayitvā tu saṃpūjya naivedyairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
santarpya vighnarājeśaṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 2 ..
16.141.d:
चतुर्थ्यां तं तु देवेशि अंगारकदिने पुनः ..
स्नापयित्वा तु संपूज्य नैवेद्यैर्विविधैः शुभैः ..
सन्तर्प्य विघ्नराजेशं सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् .. 2 ..
16.141.m: On the fourth lunar day, O ruler of the gods, especially on a Tuesday, / having bathed and worshipped him with various auspicious food offerings / and propitiated the lord of obstacles, one attains all desires. 2

16.141.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kapardicintāmaṇimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 141 ..
16.141.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कपर्दिचिन्तामणिमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नामैकचत्वारिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 141 ..
16.141.m: Thus ends the one hundred and forty-first chapter, entitled “Description of the Greatness of Kapardicintāmaṇi,” in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. 141

16.142.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi citreśvara manuttamam..
dhanuṣāṃ saptake tasya sthitamāgneyadakṣiṇe .. 1 ..
16.142.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि चित्रेश्वर मनुत्तमम्..
धनुषां सप्तके तस्य स्थितमाग्नेयदक्षिणे .. 1 ..
16.142.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the unsurpassed Citreśvara, / situated at a distance of seven bows to the southeast of it. // 1

16.142.s:
liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi sarvapātakanāśanam ..
tatra citreśvaraṃ pūjya narakānna bhavedbhayam .. 2 ..
16.142.d:
लिंगं महाप्रभावं हि सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
तत्र चित्रेश्वरं पूज्य नरकान्न भवेद्भयम् .. 2 ..
16.142.m: Indeed, it is a liṅga of great power, destroying all sins. / Having worshipped Citreśvara there, one has no fear of hell. // 2

16.142.s:
paṭasthitaṃ tasya pāpaṃ citro mārjayati priye ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena citreśaṃ pūjayetsadā ..
yaḥ syātpāpayuto vāpi narakaṃ naiva paśyati .. 3 ..
16.142.d:
पटस्थितं तस्य पापं चित्रो मार्जयति प्रिये ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन चित्रेशं पूजयेत्सदा ..
यः स्यात्पापयुतो वापि नरकं नैव पश्यति .. 3 ..
16.142.m: O dear one, Citra wipes away his sin recorded on the cloth. / Therefore, with all effort one should always worship Citreśa. / Even one who is endowed with sins never sees hell. // 3

16.142.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye citreśvara māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 142 ..
16.142.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये चित्रेश्वर माहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विचत्वारिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 142 ..
16.142.m: Thus ends the one hundred and forty-second chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Citreśvara,' in the first [part], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. // 142

16.143.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi vicitreśvaramuttamam ..
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge kiñcidāgneyagocare ..
dhanuṣāṃ daśake tatra sthitaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam .. 1 ..
16.143.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि विचित्रेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
तस्यैव पूर्वदिग्भागे किञ्चिदाग्नेयगोचरे ..
धनुषां दशके तत्र स्थितं पापप्रणाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.143.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the excellent Vicitreśvara, / located in the eastern direction from it, slightly within the range of the southeast, / standing at a distance of ten bows there, destroying sins. // 1

16.143.s:
vicitreṇa mahādevi lekha kena yamasya ca ..
sthāpitaṃ tanmahāliṃgaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā suduścaram .. 2 ..
16.143.d:
विचित्रेण महादेवि लेख केन यमस्य च ..
स्थापितं तन्महालिंगं तपः कृत्वा सुदुश्चरम् .. 2 ..
16.143.m: O great goddess, by Vicitra, the scribe of Yama, / that great liṅga was established after performing very severe austerity. // 2

16.143.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjitaṃ caiva muktaḥ syātsarvapātakaiḥ ..
saṃpūjya ca vidhānena na duḥkhī jāyate naraḥ .. 3 ..
16.143.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा पूजितं चैव मुक्तः स्यात्सर्वपातकैः ..
संपूज्य च विधानेन न दुःखी जायते नरः .. 3 ..
16.143.m: Having seen and worshipped it, one becomes freed from all sins; / and having worshipped it according to the rule, a person does not become miserable. // 3

16.143.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye vicitreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 143 ..
16.143.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये विचित्रेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिचत्वारिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 143 ..
16.143.m: Thus ends the one hundred and forty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Vicitreśvara,' in the first [part], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. // 143

16.144.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tṛtīyaṃ puṣkaraṃ mahat ..
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge kiñcidīśānagocare ..
kanīyaḥ saṃsmṛtaṃ kuṃḍaṃ puṣkaraṃnāma nāmataḥ .. 1 ..
16.144.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तृतीयं पुष्करं महत् ..
तस्यैव पूर्वदिग्भागे किञ्चिदीशानगोचरे ..
कनीयः संस्मृतं कुंडं पुष्करंनाम नामतः .. 1 ..
16.144.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the great third Puṣkara, / in the eastern direction from it, slightly within the range of the northeast, / a small pool traditionally known by the name Puṣkara. // 1

16.144.s:
yatra madhyāhnasamaye brahmaṇā samupāsitā ..
sandhyā trailokyajananī pratiṣṭhārthaṃ gatena ca .. 2 ..
16.144.d:
यत्र मध्याह्नसमये ब्रह्मणा समुपासिता ..
सन्ध्या त्रैलोक्यजननी प्रतिष्ठार्थं गतेन च .. 2 ..
16.144.m: Where, at midday, the Sandhyā, the mother of the three worlds, / was worshipped by Brahmā who had gone there for the sake of the consecration. // 2

16.144.s:
tatra yaḥ kurute snānaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ samāhitaḥ ..
samyakkṛtaṃ bhavettena snānaṃ tatrādipuṣkare .. 3 ..
16.144.d:
तत्र यः कुरुते स्नानं पौर्णमास्यां समाहितः ..
सम्यक्कृतं भवेत्तेन स्नानं तत्रादिपुष्करे .. 3 ..
16.144.m: Whoever, composed in mind, takes a bath there on the full moon day, / by him a bath is truly performed as if in the primal Puṣkara there. // 3
Gold should be gifted there for the destruction of all sins. // 4

16.144.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ tava pauṣkaram ..
śrutaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ tathā .. 5 ..
16.144.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं माहात्म्यं तव पौष्करम् ..
श्रुतं पापहरं नॄणां सर्वकामप्रदं तथा .. 5 ..
16.144.m: Thus has the māhātmya of Puṣkara been told to you in brief; / when heard, it removes people's sins and likewise grants all desires. // 5

16.144.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye puṣkarakuṇḍamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 144 ..
16.144.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पुष्करकुण्डमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 144 ..
16.144.m: Thus ends the one hundred and forty-fourth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Puṣkarakuṇḍa,' in the first [part], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. // 144

16.145.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyedvighneśaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
gajakuṃbhodaraṃ nāma sarvasiddhipradāyakam .. 1 ..
16.145.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव संस्थितं पश्येद्विघ्नेशं पापनाशनम् ..
गजकुंभोदरं नाम सर्वसिद्धिप्रदायकम् .. 1 ..
16.145.m: Īśvara said: / Residing right there, one should see the Lord of Obstacles, destroyer of sin, / named Gajakumbhodara, who bestows all perfections. // 1

16.145.s:
tatra kuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā caturthyāṃ prayatātmavān ..
pūjayedyastu taṃ bhaktyā vighneśastasya tuṣyati .. 2 ..
16.145.d:
तत्र कुंडे नरः स्नात्वा चतुर्थ्यां प्रयतात्मवान् ..
पूजयेद्यस्तु तं भक्त्या विघ्नेशस्तस्य तुष्यति .. 2 ..
16.145.m: Having bathed in that pool on the fourth day, self-restrained, / whoever worships him with devotion, the Lord of Obstacles is pleased with him. // 2

16.145.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gajakuṃbhodaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcacatvā riṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 145 ..
16.145.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गजकुंभोदरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चचत्वा रिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 145 ..
16.145.m: Thus ends the one hundred and forty-fifth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Gajakumbhodara,' in the first [part], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. // 145

16.146.s:
. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi dharmarājapratiṣṭhitam ..
yameśvaraṃ mahādevaṃ tasyai vottarataḥ sthitam .. 1 ..
16.146.d:
. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि धर्मराजप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
यमेश्वरं महादेवं तस्यै वोत्तरतः स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.146.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the great deity Yameśvara / established by the King of Dharma, situated directly to the north of it. // 1

16.146.s:
yadā śapto dharmarājaśchāyayā varavarṇini ..
tadā tasyāpatatpādaḥ sa ca duḥkhānvito'bhavat .. 2 ..
16.146.d:
यदा शप्तो धर्मराजश्छायया वरवर्णिनि ..
तदा तस्यापतत्पादः स च दुःखान्वितोऽभवत् .. 2 ..
16.146.m: When the King of Dharma was cursed by Chāyā, O fair-complexioned one, / then his foot fell off, and he was filled with sorrow. // 2

16.146.s:
tataḥ prābhāsike kṣetre tapastepe mahātapāḥ ..
sthāpayāmāsa liṃgaṃ tu tatra devasya śūlinaḥ .. 3 ..
16.146.d:
ततः प्राभासिके क्षेत्रे तपस्तेपे महातपाः ..
स्थापयामास लिंगं तु तत्र देवस्य शूलिनः .. 3 ..
16.146.m: Then, in the sacred field of Prabhāsa, of great austerity, he practiced austerity; / and there he established a liṅga of the trident-bearing god. // 3

16.146.s:
tasya tuṣṭo mahādevastataḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ..
abravīddharma bhadraṃ te varaṃ varaya cepsitam .. 4 ..
16.146.d:
तस्य तुष्टो महादेवस्ततः प्रत्यक्षतां गतः ..
अब्रवीद्धर्म भद्रं ते वरं वरय चेप्सितम् .. 4 ..
16.146.m: Mahādeva, pleased with him, then became manifest to his eyes / and said: 'O Dharma, may it be well with you! Choose the boon you desire.' // 4

16.146.s:
tadā'bravīddharmarājaḥ pādaḥ prapatito mama ..
prasādāttava deveśa jāyatāṃ punareva hi .. 5 ..
16.146.d:
तदाऽब्रवीद्धर्मराजः पादः प्रपतितो मम ..
प्रसादात्तव देवेश जायतां पुनरेव हि .. 5 ..
16.146.m: Then the King of Dharma said: 'My foot has fallen off; / by your grace, O Lord of gods, let it indeed grow back again. // 5

16.146.s:
etalliṃgaṃ suraśreṣṭha yanmayā nirmitaṃ tava ..
etadye bhaktisaṃyuktāḥ paśyaṃti prāṇino bhuvi .. 6 ..
16.146.d:
एतल्लिंगं सुरश्रेष्ठ यन्मया निर्मितं तव ..
एतद्ये भक्तिसंयुक्ताः पश्यंति प्राणिनो भुवि .. 6 ..
16.146.m: O best of gods, this liṅga which was made by me for you— / whichever living beings on earth see this with devotion, // 6
for them may there be deliverance from sin by your grace!' // 7

16.146.s:
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktā hyantardhānaṃ gato haraḥ ..
yamo'pi labdhapādastu punareva divaṃ yayau .. 8 ..
16.146.d:
एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्ता ह्यन्तर्धानं गतो हरः ..
यमोऽपि लब्धपादस्तु पुनरेव दिवं ययौ .. 8 ..
16.146.m: Saying 'So it shall be,' Hara disappeared; / and Yama, having recovered his foot, went back to heaven again. // 8

16.146.s:
tasmindṛṣṭe suraśreṣṭha yamalokasamudbhavam ..
na bhayaṃ vidyate nṛṇāmapi duṣkṛtakāriṇām .. .. 9 ..
16.146.d:
तस्मिन्दृष्टे सुरश्रेष्ठ यमलोकसमुद्भवम् ..
न भयं विद्यते नृणामपि दुष्कृतकारिणाम् .. .. 9 ..
16.146.m: When that is seen, O best of gods, no fear arising from the world of Yama / exists for men, even those who have committed evil deeds. // 9
Having bathed in the water of the pool on the occasion of Bhrātṛdvitīyā, / standing near Yameśvara, one should gaze upon Yameśa. // 10

16.146.s:
tilapātraṃ pradātavyaṃ dīpaṃ gāḥ kāṃcanā dikam ..
yamadevaṃ samuddiśya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 11 ..
16.146.d:
तिलपात्रं प्रदातव्यं दीपं गाः कांचना दिकम् ..
यमदेवं समुद्दिश्य मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 11 ..
16.146.m: A vessel of sesame, a lamp, cows, gold and the like should be given, / dedicating them to the god Yama; one is freed from all sins. // 11

16.146.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye yameśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 146 .. .. cha ..
16.146.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये यमेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्चत्वारिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 146 .. .. छ ..
16.146.m: Thus ends the one hundred and forty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Yameśvara,' in the first [part], Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses]. // 146

16.147.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi brahmakuṇḍamanuttamam ..
tasyaiva nairṛte bhāge brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā .. 1 ..
16.147.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि ब्रह्मकुण्डमनुत्तमम् ..
तस्यैव नैरृते भागे ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं पुरा .. 1 ..
16.147.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the unsurpassed Brahmakuṇḍa, / to the southwest of it, fashioned by Brahmā in ancient times. // 1

16.147.s:
yadā tu ṛkṣarājena somanāthaḥ prati ṣṭhitaḥ ..
tadā brahmādayo devāḥ sarve tatra samāgatāḥ ..
pratiṣṭhārthaṃ hi devasya śaśāṃkena nimantritāḥ .. 2 ..
16.147.d:
यदा तु ऋक्षराजेन सोमनाथः प्रति ष्ठितः ..
तदा ब्रह्मादयो देवाः सर्वे तत्र समागताः ..
प्रतिष्ठार्थं हि देवस्य शशांकेन निमन्त्रिताः .. 2 ..
16.147.m: When Somanātha was consecrated by the King of the Constellations, / then all the gods, beginning with Brahmā, assembled there, / invited by the Moon for the consecration of the god. // 2

16.147.s: athā'bravīnniśānātho brahmāṇaṃ vinayānvitaḥ .. 3 ..
16.147.d: अथाऽब्रवीन्निशानाथो ब्रह्माणं विनयान्वितः .. 3 ..
16.147.m: Then the Lord of Night, full of humility, spoke to Brahmā: // 3

16.147.s:
kṛtaṃ bhavadbhirjānāti sthāpanaṃ vai yathā janaḥ ..
tathā kuru suraśreṣṭha cihnamātmasamudbhavam .. 4 ..
16.147.d:
कृतं भवद्भिर्जानाति स्थापनं वै यथा जनः ..
तथा कुरु सुरश्रेष्ठ चिह्नमात्मसमुद्भवम् .. 4 ..
16.147.m: 'So that people know that the installation was made by you, / make an insignia born of yourself, O best among the gods.' // 4

16.147.s:
evaṃ śrutvā tadā brahmā dhyānaṃ kṛtvā tu niścalam ..
āhvayatsarvatīrthāni puṣkarādīni sarvaśaḥ .. 5 ..
16.147.d:
एवं श्रुत्वा तदा ब्रह्मा ध्यानं कृत्वा तु निश्चलम् ..
आह्वयत्सर्वतीर्थानि पुष्करादीनि सर्वशः .. 5 ..
16.147.m: Hearing this, Brahmā, having entered motionless meditation, / summoned all sacred fords from all around, beginning with Puṣkara. // 5

16.147.s:
svarge vai yāni tīrthāni tathaiva ca rasātale ..
tapaḥsāmarthyayogena brahmaṇā ''karṣitāni ca ..
atastasyaiva nāmnā tu brahmakuṇḍaṃ tu gīyate .. 6 ..
16.147.d:
स्वर्गे वै यानि तीर्थानि तथैव च रसातले ..
तपःसामर्थ्ययोगेन ब्रह्मणा 'ऽकर्षितानि च ..
अतस्तस्यैव नाम्ना तु ब्रह्मकुण्डं तु गीयते .. 6 ..
16.147.m: Whatever sacred fords were in heaven, and likewise in the netherworld, / were drawn together by Brahmā through the power of his austerity; / therefore, by his name it is called Brahmakuṇḍa. // 6

16.147.s:
gaṇānāṃ ca sahasraistu caturdaśabhirīkṣyate ..
ataścābhaktiyuktānāṃ duṣprāpyaṃ tīrthamuttamam .. 7 ..
16.147.d:
गणानां च सहस्रैस्तु चतुर्दशभिरीक्ष्यते ..
अतश्चाभक्तियुक्तानां दुष्प्राप्यं तीर्थमुत्तमम् .. 7 ..
16.147.m: And it is guarded by fourteen thousand Gaṇas; / hence this excellent sacred ford is hard to attain for those devoid of devotion. // 7

16.147.s: athābravītsarvadevānbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ .. 8 ..
16.147.d: अथाब्रवीत्सर्वदेवान्ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः .. 8 ..
16.147.m: Then Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, spoke to all the gods: // 8

16.147.s:
atra kuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā yaḥ pitṝṃstarpayiṣyati ..
agniṣṭomaphalaṃ sava lapsyate sa ca mānavaḥ ..
tatprasādātsvargaloke vimānena cariṣyati .. 9 ..
16.147.d:
अत्र कुण्डे नरः स्नात्वा यः पितॄंस्तर्पयिष्यति ..
अग्निष्टोमफलं सव लप्स्यते स च मानवः ..
तत्प्रसादात्स्वर्गलोके विमानेन चरिष्यति .. 9 ..
16.147.m: 'Having bathed in this pool, whichever person offers water to the ancestors, / that man will obtain the entire fruit of an Agniṣṭoma [sacrifice]; / by its grace, he will travel in an aerial chariot in heaven.' // 9

16.147.s:
godānaṃ cāśvadānaṃ ca tathā svarṇakamaṇḍalum ..
dadyādviprāya viduṣe sarvapāpāpanuttaye .. 7.1.147.10 ..
16.147.d:
गोदानं चाश्वदानं च तथा स्वर्णकमण्डलुम् ..
दद्याद्विप्राय विदुषे सर्वपापापनुत्तये .. 7.1.147.10 ..
16.147.m: One should give the gift of a cow, the gift of a horse, and likewise a golden water pot / to a learned brahmin for the eradication of all sins. // 7.1.147.10

16.147.s:
paurṇamāsyāṃ mahādevi tathā ca pratipaddine ..
sarvapāpavināśārthaṃ tatra snāti sarasvatī .. 11 ..
16.147.d:
पौर्णमास्यां महादेवि तथा च प्रतिपद्दिने ..
सर्वपापविनाशार्थं तत्र स्नाति सरस्वती .. 11 ..
16.147.m: On the full-moon day, O great goddess, and likewise on the first day of the fortnight, / Sarasvatī bathes there for the destruction of all sins. // 11

16.147.s:
siddhaṃ rasāyanaṃ devi tatra vai hyudakaṃ priye ..
nānāvarṇasamāyuktamupadeśena siddhyati .. 12 ..
16.147.d:
सिद्धं रसायनं देवि तत्र वै ह्युदकं प्रिये ..
नानावर्णसमायुक्तमुपदेशेन सिद्ध्यति .. 12 ..
16.147.m: The water there is indeed an accomplished elixir, O goddess, O dear one; / endowed with various colors, it is perfected through instruction. // 12

16.147.s:
dāridryaduḥkharukchokānmānavaḥ sevate katham ..
brahmakuṇḍamanuprāpya kalpavṛkṣamivāparam .. .. 13 ..
16.147.d:
दारिद्र्यदुःखरुक्छोकान्मानवः सेवते कथम् ..
ब्रह्मकुण्डमनुप्राप्य कल्पवृक्षमिवापरम् .. .. 13 ..
16.147.m: How can a man suffer from poverty, misery, disease, and grief, / having reached Brahmakuṇḍa, which is like another wishing tree? // 13

16.147.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
bhagavanvistarādbrūhi brahmakuṇḍamahodayam ..
sarvaprāṇihitārthāya vistarādvada me prabho .. 14 ..
16.147.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
भगवन्विस्तराद्ब्रूहि ब्रह्मकुण्डमहोदयम् ..
सर्वप्राणिहितार्थाय विस्तराद्वद मे प्रभो .. 14 ..
16.147.m: The goddess said: / O Lord, tell in detail the great glory of Brahmakuṇḍa; / tell me in detail for the benefit of all living beings, O Lord. // 14

16.147.s:
brahmakuṃḍasya māhātmyaṃ śrotuṃ me kautukaṃ mahat..
lokānāṃ duḥkhanāśāya dāridyakṣayahetave .. 15 ..
16.147.d:
ब्रह्मकुंडस्य माहात्म्यं श्रोतुं मे कौतुकं महत्..
लोकानां दुःखनाशाय दारिद्यक्षयहेतवे .. 15 ..
16.147.m: Great is my curiosity to hear the māhātmya of Brahmakuṇḍa, / which serves to destroy the misery of the worlds and cause the cessation of poverty. // 15

16.147.s:
bhagavanmānuṣāḥ sarve duḥkhaśokanipīḍitāḥ ..
bhramaṃti sakalaṃ janma rasāyanavimohitāḥ .. 16 ..
16.147.d:
भगवन्मानुषाः सर्वे दुःखशोकनिपीडिताः ..
भ्रमंति सकलं जन्म रसायनविमोहिताः .. 16 ..
16.147.m: O Lord, all human beings are afflicted by misery and grief; / they wander through their whole lives, deluded by [false] elixirs. // 16

16.147.s:
teṣāṃ hitāya me brūhi nirvāṇaṃ rasamuttamam ..
ādāviha śarīraṃ tu akṣayyaṃ tu yathā bhavet .. 17 ..
16.147.d:
तेषां हिताय मे ब्रूहि निर्वाणं रसमुत्तमम् ..
आदाविह शरीरं तु अक्षय्यं तु यथा भवेत् .. 17 ..
16.147.m: Tell me, for their benefit, of the supreme elixir that brings liberation, / so that the body here may first become imperishable, // 17

16.147.s:
aṣṭasiddhisamā yuktaṃ sarvavidyāsamanvitam ..
kāmarūpaṃ kriyāyuktaṃ sarvavyādhivivarjitam .. 18 ..
16.147.d:
अष्टसिद्धिसमा युक्तं सर्वविद्यासमन्वितम् ..
कामरूपं क्रियायुक्तं सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितम् .. 18 ..
16.147.m: endowed with the eight perfections, equipped with all sciences, / capable of assuming any form at will, fit for ritual action, and free from all diseases. // 18

16.147.s:
tatastu paramaṃ deva nirvāṇaṃ yena vai labhet ..
mānavaḥ kṛtakṛtyaśca jāyate ca yathā prabho .. 19 ..
16.147.d:
ततस्तु परमं देव निर्वाणं येन वै लभेत् ..
मानवः कृतकृत्यश्च जायते च यथा प्रभो .. 19 ..
16.147.m: Then [tell me], O God, that whereby one may obtain supreme liberation, / and how a human being becomes one who has accomplished his duty, O Lord. // 19

16.147.s:
tathā kathaya me deva dayāṃ kṛtvā jagatprabho ..
nirvāṇaparamaṃ kalpaṃ sarvabhrāṃtivivarjitam ..
prasiddhaṃ sukhadaṃ divyaṃ samā cakṣva maheśvara .. 7.1.147.20 ..
16.147.d:
तथा कथय मे देव दयां कृत्वा जगत्प्रभो ..
निर्वाणपरमं कल्पं सर्वभ्रांतिविवर्जितम् ..
प्रसिद्धं सुखदं दिव्यं समा चक्ष्व महेश्वर .. 7.1.147.20 ..
16.147.m: Speak to me thus, O God, taking pity, O Lord of the universe: / declare the supreme procedure for liberation, free from all confusion, / renowned, bestowing happiness, and divine, O Maheśvara. // 7.1.147.20

16.147.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
sādhusādhu mahādevi lokānāṃ hitakāriṇi ..
martyaloke mahādevi tīrthaṃ(?) tīrthavaraṃ śubham .. .. 21 ..
16.147.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
साधुसाधु महादेवि लोकानां हितकारिणि ..
मर्त्यलोके महादेवि तीर्थं(?) तीर्थवरं शुभम् .. .. 21 ..
16.147.m: Īśvara said: / Excellent, excellent, O great goddess, benefactress of the worlds! / In the mortal world, O great goddess, is an auspicious, excellent sacred ford among sacred fords: // 21

16.147.s:
prabhāsaṃ paramaṃ khyātaṃ tacca dvādaśayojanam ..
tatra someśvaro devastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ .. 22 ..
16.147.d:
प्रभासं परमं ख्यातं तच्च द्वादशयोजनम् ..
तत्र सोमेश्वरो देवस्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः .. 22 ..
16.147.m: the exceedingly renowned Prabhāsa, measuring twelve yojanas. / There dwells the god Someśvara, famous throughout the three worlds. // 22

16.147.s:
tasya pūrve samākhyātaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo daityasūdanaḥ ..
caṇḍikā yoginī tatra sakhībhiḥ parivāritā .. 23 ..
16.147.d:
तस्य पूर्वे समाख्यातः श्रीकृष्णो दैत्यसूदनः ..
चण्डिका योगिनी तत्र सखीभिः परिवारिता .. 23 ..
16.147.m: To its east is proclaimed Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the slayer of Daityas; / Caṇḍikā Yoginī is there, surrounded by her female companions. // 23

16.147.s:
tataḥ pūrve diśāṃ bhāge caturvaktreṇa nirmitam ..
tīrthāttīrthaṃ varaṃ divyaṃ sarvāścaryamayaṃ śubham .. 24 ..
16.147.d:
ततः पूर्वे दिशां भागे चतुर्वक्त्रेण निर्मितम् ..
तीर्थात्तीर्थं वरं दिव्यं सर्वाश्चर्यमयं शुभम् .. 24 ..
16.147.m: To the east of that is [the sacred ford] fashioned by the Four-faced One [Brahmā], / a divine, auspicious, excellent sacred ford among sacred fords, full of all wonders, // 24

16.147.s:
sevitaṃ sarvadevaistu siddhaiḥ sādhyairgrahaistathā ..
apsaromunibhirdivyairyakṣaiśca pannagaiḥ sadā .. 25 ..
16.147.d:
सेवितं सर्वदेवैस्तु सिद्धैः साध्यैर्ग्रहैस्तथा ..
अप्सरोमुनिभिर्दिव्यैर्यक्षैश्च पन्नगैः सदा .. 25 ..
16.147.m: frequented by all the gods, by siddhas, sādhyas, and planets, / and constantly by divine apsarases, sages, yakṣas, and serpents. // 25

16.147.s:
siddhyarthaṃ sarvakāmārthaṃ divyabhogāvahaṃ śubham ..
brahmakuṇḍamiti khyātaṃ brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ yataḥ .. 26 ..
16.147.d:
सिद्ध्यर्थं सर्वकामार्थं दिव्यभोगावहं शुभम् ..
ब्रह्मकुण्डमिति ख्यातं ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं यतः .. 26 ..
16.147.m: Bestowing divine enjoyment, auspicious, for the attainment of perfection and all desires, / it is known as Brahmakuṇḍa, since it was fashioned by Brahmā. // 26

16.147.s:
tasya vāyavyakoṇe tu hira ṇyeśaḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ ..
tamārādhya mahādevaṃ hiraṇyeśvaramuttamam .. 27 ..
16.147.d:
तस्य वायव्यकोणे तु हिर ण्येशः स्वयं स्थितः ..
तमाराध्य महादेवं हिरण्येश्वरमुत्तमम् .. 27 ..
16.147.m: In its northwestern corner Hiraṇyeśa himself resides. / Having worshipped that great god, the excellent Hiraṇyeśvara, // 27

16.147.s:
mahāmantraṃ japetkṣipraṃ daśāṃśaṃ homayetsudhīḥ ..
homena siddhyate mantraḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ varānane .. 28 ..
16.147.d:
महामन्त्रं जपेत्क्षिप्रं दशांशं होमयेत्सुधीः ..
होमेन सिद्ध्यते मन्त्रः सत्यं सत्यं वरानने .. 28 ..
16.147.m: the wise one should swiftly mutter the great mantra and offer a tenth part in fire. / The mantra is perfected through the fire offering; truly, truly, O lovely-faced one! // 28

16.147.s:
tasyottare tu digbhāge kiñcidīśānamāśritaḥ ..
caturvaktro mahādevi kṣetrapo liṃgarūpadhṛk .. 29 ..
16.147.d:
तस्योत्तरे तु दिग्भागे किञ्चिदीशानमाश्रितः ..
चतुर्वक्त्रो महादेवि क्षेत्रपो लिंगरूपधृक् .. 29 ..
16.147.m: In its northern direction, situated somewhat towards the northeast, / is the four-faced guardian of the field, O great goddess, bearing the form of a liṅga. // 29

16.147.s:
tatsthānaṃ rakṣate devi liṃgarūpeṇa śaṃkaraḥ ..
tamārādhya prayatnena tataḥ kuṇḍaṃ samāśrayet .. 7.1.147.30 ..
16.147.d:
तत्स्थानं रक्षते देवि लिंगरूपेण शंकरः ..
तमाराध्य प्रयत्नेन ततः कुण्डं समाश्रयेत् .. 7.1.147.30 ..
16.147.m: Śaṃkara protects that site in the form of a liṅga, O goddess. / Having worshipped him with effort, one should then resort to the kuṇḍa. // 7.1.147.30

16.147.s:
sarvaiśvaryamayaṃ devi nānāvarṇavicitritam ..
kuṇḍasyāsyeśadigbhāge bhairaveśvaramuttamam .. 31 ..
16.147.d:
सर्वैश्वर्यमयं देवि नानावर्णविचित्रितम् ..
कुण्डस्यास्येशदिग्भागे भैरवेश्वरमुत्तमम् .. 31 ..
16.147.m: It contains all sovereign powers, O goddess, and is variegated with various colors. / In the northeastern quarter of the mouth of the pool is the excellent Bhairaveśvara. // 31

16.147.s:
durgandhā bhāsurā devi vahate rasarūpiṇī ..
tasyā rasena saṃyuktaṃ pṛthagvarṇaṃ hi karburam .. 32 ..
16.147.d:
दुर्गन्धा भासुरा देवि वहते रसरूपिणी ..
तस्या रसेन संयुक्तं पृथग्वर्णं हि कर्बुरम् .. 32 ..
16.147.m: A foul-smelling, radiant [stream], O goddess, flows in the form of an elixir; / mingled with its juice, it is of distinct colors and variegated. // 32

16.147.s:
meghavarṇaṃ mahādivyaṃ rājataṃ ca punaḥ śubham ..
kapilaṃ dugdhavarṇaṃ ca karpūrābhaṃ suśobhanam .. 33 ..
16.147.d:
मेघवर्णं महादिव्यं राजतं च पुनः शुभम् ..
कपिलं दुग्धवर्णं च कर्पूराभं सुशोभनम् .. 33 ..
16.147.m: Cloud-colored, greatly divine, and again an auspicious silvery hue, / tawny, milk-colored, and having the beautiful appearance of camphor; // 33

16.147.s:
kadā kastūrikābhāsaṃ kuṃkumacchavikāvaham ..
saugandhaṃ caṃdanopetaṃ kadācidraudhi rodakam .. 34 ..
16.147.d:
कदा कस्तूरिकाभासं कुंकुमच्छविकावहम् ..
सौगन्धं चंदनोपेतं कदाचिद्रौधि रोदकम् .. 34 ..
16.147.m: sometimes resembling musk, bestowing the luster of saffron, / fragrant, endowed with sandalwood, and sometimes having blood-red water. // 34

16.147.s:
ete rasāśca vividhā dṛśyaṃte tatra sarvadā ..
yasya tuṣṭo mahādevaḥ siddhyate tasya tatkṣaṇāt .. 35 ..
16.147.d:
एते रसाश्च विविधा दृश्यंते तत्र सर्वदा ..
यस्य तुष्टो महादेवः सिद्ध्यते तस्य तत्क्षणात् .. 35 ..
16.147.m: These various essences are seen there at all times; / to one with whom the Great God is pleased, it is perfected in an instant. // 35

16.147.s:
rajataṃ kṣipyate tatra suvarṇa miva jāyate ..
pratyakṣameva tatraiva rasāyanamanuttamam .. 36 ..
16.147.d:
रजतं क्षिप्यते तत्र सुवर्ण मिव जायते ..
प्रत्यक्षमेव तत्रैव रसायनमनुत्तमम् .. 36 ..
16.147.m: Silver is cast therein, and it becomes like gold. / Directly visible right there is the unexcelled elixir. // 36

16.147.s:
paśyaṃti mānavā devi kautukaṃ tatkṣaṇādbhṛśam ..
rasaṃ hi paramaṃ divyaṃ tatrasthaṃ ca kalau yuge .. 37 ..
16.147.d:
पश्यंति मानवा देवि कौतुकं तत्क्षणाद्भृशम् ..
रसं हि परमं दिव्यं तत्रस्थं च कलौ युगे .. 37 ..
16.147.m: Men behold the wonder instantly and intensely, O goddess: / the supreme, divine elixir situated there in the Kali age, // 37

16.147.s:
siddhaṃ siddharasaṃ puṃsāṃ vyādhīnāṃ kṣayakārakam ..
hemabījamayaṃ divyaṃ brahmakuṇḍodbhavaṃ mahat .. 38 ..
16.147.d:
सिद्धं सिद्धरसं पुंसां व्याधीनां क्षयकारकम् ..
हेमबीजमयं दिव्यं ब्रह्मकुण्डोद्भवं महत् .. 38 ..
16.147.m: an accomplished, proven elixir that destroys diseases in men, / consisting of golden seed, divine, great, born of Brahmakuṇḍa. // 38

16.147.s:
idānīṃ te pravakṣyāmi manuṣyāṇāṃ hitāya vai ..
dāridryaṃ kṣayamāpnoti tatkṣaṇācca yaśasvini .. 39 ..
16.147.d:
इदानीं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि मनुष्याणां हिताय वै ..
दारिद्र्यं क्षयमाप्नोति तत्क्षणाच्च यशस्विनि .. 39 ..
16.147.m: Now I will declare to you [the method] for the benefit of human beings, / by which poverty meets its destruction in an instant, O glorious one. // 39

16.147.s:
ādāveva prakurvanti tāmrakumbhaṃ dṛḍhaṃ śubham ..
tīrthodakaṃ kṣipettatra patraistāmrastathā yutam .. 7.1.147.40 ..
16.147.d:
आदावेव प्रकुर्वन्ति ताम्रकुम्भं दृढं शुभम् ..
तीर्थोदकं क्षिपेत्तत्र पत्रैस्ताम्रस्तथा युतम् .. 7.1.147.40 ..
16.147.m: First of all, they prepare a strong, auspicious copper vessel; / one should pour the sacred water therein, together with copper leaves. // 7.1.147.40

16.147.s:
nikṣipya bhūmau tatkumbhaṃ jvālayedanalaṃ tataḥ ..
cuhlīrūpeṇa ṣaṇmāsaṃ pācayettaṃ śanaiḥśanaiḥ .. 41 ..
16.147.d:
निक्षिप्य भूमौ तत्कुम्भं ज्वालयेदनलं ततः ..
चुह्लीरूपेण षण्मासं पाचयेत्तं शनैःशनैः .. 41 ..
16.147.m: Placing that pot on the ground, one should then kindle a fire; / by means of an oven one should cook it slowly for six months. // 41

16.147.s:
paścāduddhṛtya taṃ kumbhaṃ punareva jalaṃ kṣipet ..
māsamekaṃ punaḥ kuryānmāsamekaṃ punarbhṛśam ..42..
16.147.d:
पश्चादुद्धृत्य तं कुम्भं पुनरेव जलं क्षिपेत् ..
मासमेकं पुनः कुर्यान्मासमेकं पुनर्भृशम् ..42..
16.147.m: Afterwards, lifting that pot, one should pour water once again; / one should do it again for one month, and repeatedly for another month. // 42

16.147.s:
tataḥ sarvāṇi khaṇḍāni ekīkṛtya prayatnataḥ ..
punarevodakenaiva plāvya cāvartayetpunaḥ .. ..43..
16.147.d:
ततः सर्वाणि खण्डानि एकीकृत्य प्रयत्नतः ..
पुनरेवोदकेनैव प्लाव्य चावर्तयेत्पुनः .. ..43..
16.147.m: Then, having gathered all the pieces together with effort, / inundating them again with water, one should stir them once more. // 43

16.147.s: kāṃcanaṃ jāyate tatra yadi tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ..44..
16.147.d: कांचनं जायते तत्र यदि तुष्टो महेश्वरः ..44..
16.147.m: Gold is produced there if Maheśvara is pleased. // 44

16.147.s:
siddhiṃ śarīrajāṃ devi yadīcchenmānavottamaḥ ..
sa snānamāditaḥ kṛtvā saṃvatsaratrayaṃ punaḥ .. .. 45 ..
16.147.d:
सिद्धिं शरीरजां देवि यदीच्छेन्मानवोत्तमः ..
स स्नानमादितः कृत्वा संवत्सरत्रयं पुनः .. .. 45 ..
16.147.m: If the best of men desires bodily perfection, O goddess, / he should first perform ritual ablution, and then for three years, // 45

16.147.s:
maunena niyamenaiva mahāmaṃtrajapānvitaḥ ..
pūjayecca hiraṇyeśaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ prayatnataḥ ..46..
16.147.d:
मौनेन नियमेनैव महामंत्रजपान्वितः ..
पूजयेच्च हिरण्येशं क्षेत्रपालं प्रयत्नतः ..46..
16.147.m: observing silence and restraint, engaged in muttering the great mantra, / he should diligently worship Hiraṇyeśa, the guardian of the field, // 46

16.147.s:
paṃcopacārasaṃyuktaṃ dhyānadhāraṇasaṃyutam ..
tīrthodakena pākaṃ vai peyaṃ tadvadudumbare ..47..
16.147.d:
पंचोपचारसंयुक्तं ध्यानधारणसंयुतम् ..
तीर्थोदकेन पाकं वै पेयं तद्वदुदुम्बरे ..47..
16.147.m: with the five forms of worship, accompanied by meditation and concentration. / Cooking [his food] with the water of the sacred ford, his drink likewise [taken] in an udumbara vessel, // 47

16.147.s:
evaṃ varṣatrayeṇaiva divyadehaḥ prajāyate ..
tejasvī valavānprājñaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ ..48 ..
16.147.d:
एवं वर्षत्रयेणैव दिव्यदेहः प्रजायते ..
तेजस्वी वलवान्प्राज्ञः सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः ..48 ..
16.147.m: in this way, within just three years a divine body is produced: / radiant, strong, wise, and free from all diseases. // 48

16.147.s:
jīvedvarṣeśatānyeva trīṇi duḥkhavivarjitaḥ ..
varṣatrayamavicchinnaṃ yastatra snānamācaret ..49..
16.147.d:
जीवेद्वर्षेशतान्येव त्रीणि दुःखविवर्जितः ..
वर्षत्रयमविच्छिन्नं यस्तत्र स्नानमाचरेत् ..49..
16.147.m: He lives for three hundred years free from sorrow, / whoever performs ritual ablution there continuously for three years. // 49

16.147.s:
vāgīśvarīṃ japennityaṃ pūjāhomasamanvitaḥ ..
tasya pravartate vāṇī siddhiḥ sārasvatī bhavet ..7.1.147.50..
16.147.d:
वागीश्वरीं जपेन्नित्यं पूजाहोमसमन्वितः ..
तस्य प्रवर्तते वाणी सिद्धिः सारस्वती भवेत् ..7.1.147.50..
16.147.m: He should constantly mutter [the mantra of] Vāgīśvarī, accompanied by worship and fire offering; / his speech flows forth, and his perfection becomes sārasvata. // 7.1.147.50

16.147.s:
saṃskṛtaṃ prākṛtaṃ caivāpabhraṃśaṃ bhūtabhāṣitam ..
gāṃgasrotaḥpravāheṇa udgiredgiramātmavān ..
aśrāntāṃ ca varārohe hyavicchinnāṃ ca saṃtatam ..51..
16.147.d:
संस्कृतं प्राकृतं चैवापभ्रंशं भूतभाषितम् ..
गांगस्रोतःप्रवाहेण उद्गिरेद्गिरमात्मवान् ..
अश्रान्तां च वरारोहे ह्यविच्छिन्नां च संततम् ..51..
16.147.m: Sanskrit, Prākrit, Apabhraṃśa, and the dialect of spirits— / like the torrent of the Gaṅgā's stream, the self-controlled man pours forth speech / that is untiring, O woman of beautiful hips, uninterrupted and continuous. // 51

16.147.s:
vadedvādisahasraistu na śramastasya jāyate ..
tīrthasyāsya prabhāveṇa sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ .. 52 ..
16.147.d:
वदेद्वादिसहस्रैस्तु न श्रमस्तस्य जायते ..
तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावेण सर्वशास्त्रविशारदाः .. 52 ..
16.147.m: He may debate with a thousand disputants and no fatigue arises in him; / by the power of this sacred ford, [men become] skilled in all the scriptures. // 52

16.147.s:
paṃḍitā garvitāḥ sarve tarkaśāstraviśāradāḥ ..
āgacchanti samaṃ tāta vidyayoddhatakandharāḥ ..
na śaknuvaṃti te vaktuṃ draṣṭuṃ vaktramapi priye .. 53 ..
16.147.d:
पंडिता गर्विताः सर्वे तर्कशास्त्रविशारदाः ..
आगच्छन्ति समं तात विद्ययोद्धतकन्धराः ..
न शक्नुवंति ते वक्तुं द्रष्टुं वक्त्रमपि प्रिये .. 53 ..
16.147.m: Scholars, all proud, experts in the science of logic, / arrive together, dear one, their necks held high with learning; / [yet] they are not able to speak, nor even to look upon his face, beloved.

16.147.s: vādināṃ ca sahasrāṇi bhanaktyevaṃ nirīkṣaṇāt .. 54 ..
16.147.d: वादिनां च सहस्राणि भनक्त्येवं निरीक्षणात् .. 54 ..
16.147.m: And he breaks thousands of disputants merely with a glance.

16.147.s:
udvāhayati śāstrāṇi vibuddhārthāni satvaram ..
vimalaṃ pāñcarātraṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ śaivameva ca .. 55 ..
16.147.d:
उद्वाहयति शास्त्राणि विबुद्धार्थानि सत्वरम् ..
विमलं पाञ्चरात्रं च वैष्णवं शैवमेव च .. 55 ..
16.147.m: He readily explains the scriptures with their meanings fully awakened— / the spotless Pāñcarātra, the Vaiṣṇava, and the Śaiva,

16.147.s:
itihāsapurāṇaṃ ca bhūtataṃtraṃ ca gāruḍam ..
bhairavaṃ ca mahātaṃtraṃ kulamārgaṃ dvidhā priye .. 56 ..
16.147.d:
इतिहासपुराणं च भूततंत्रं च गारुडम् ..
भैरवं च महातंत्रं कुलमार्गं द्विधा प्रिये .. 56 ..
16.147.m: the epics and Purāṇas, the Bhūtatantra, the Gāruḍa, / the Bhairava, the Mahātantra, and the two branches of the Kula path, beloved.

16.147.s:
rathapravaravegena vāṇī cāskhalitā bhavet ..
naśyaṃti vādinaḥ sarve garuḍasyeva pannagāḥ .. 57 ..
16.147.d:
रथप्रवरवेगेन वाणी चास्खलिता भवेत् ..
नश्यंति वादिनः सर्वे गरुडस्येव पन्नगाः .. 57 ..
16.147.m: His speech flows unhindered with the speed of an excellent chariot; / all disputants perish like serpents before Garuḍa.

16.147.s:
na dāridryaṃ na rogaśca na duḥkhaṃ mānasaṃ punaḥ ..
rājamānyo mahāmānī bhavedbrahmaprasādataḥ .. 58 ..
16.147.d:
न दारिद्र्यं न रोगश्च न दुःखं मानसं पुनः ..
राजमान्यो महामानी भवेद्ब्रह्मप्रसादतः .. 58 ..
16.147.m: There is no poverty, no disease, nor mental sorrow for him; / honoured by kings, highly respected, he becomes [so] by the grace of Brahmā.

16.147.s:
utsāhabalasaṃyukto devavajjīvate sudhīḥ ..
dātā bhoktā ca vāggmī ca tīrthasyāsya prasādataḥ .. 59 ..
16.147.d:
उत्साहबलसंयुक्तो देववज्जीवते सुधीः ..
दाता भोक्ता च वाग्ग्मी च तीर्थस्यास्य प्रसादतः .. 59 ..
16.147.m: Endowed with enthusiasm and strength, the wise man lives like a god, / a generous giver, an enjoyer, and eloquent, through the grace of this sacred ford.

16.147.s:
tailābhyaktasya yattejo jāyate manujeṣu ca ..
snātamātre tathā tejastīrthasyaiva prasādataḥ .. 7.1.147.60 ..
16.147.d:
तैलाभ्यक्तस्य यत्तेजो जायते मनुजेषु च ..
स्नातमात्रे तथा तेजस्तीर्थस्यैव प्रसादतः .. 7.1.147.60 ..
16.147.m: Whatever splendour appears in men who are anointed with oil, / just so does splendour arise merely upon bathing, through the grace of this very sacred ford.

16.147.s:
yatpāpaṃ kurute jaṃtuḥ paiśunyaṃ ca kṛtaghnatām ..
mitradrohe ca yatpāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ pāradārikam ..
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti kuṃḍasnānaratasya ca .. 61 ..
16.147.d:
यत्पापं कुरुते जंतुः पैशुन्यं च कृतघ्नताम् ..
मित्रद्रोहे च यत्पापं यत्पापं पारदारिकम् ..
तत्सर्वं विलयं याति कुंडस्नानरतस्य च .. 61 ..
16.147.m: Whatever sin a creature commits—slander and ungratefulness, / whatever sin is in betraying a friend, and whatever sin in adultery— / all of that is dissolved for one devoted to bathing in the pool.

16.147.s:
muśalaṃ laṅghayed yastu yo gāstyajati vai dvijaḥ ..
tatpāpaṃ kṣayamāpnoti brahmakuṇḍasya darśanāt .. 62 ..
16.147.d:
मुशलं लङ्घयेद् यस्तु यो गास्त्यजति वै द्विजः ..
तत्पापं क्षयमाप्नोति ब्रह्मकुण्डस्य दर्शनात् .. 62 ..
16.147.m: Whoever steps over a pestle, or whichsoever twice-born abandons cows— / that sin meets destruction from the darśana of Brahmakuṇḍa.

16.147.s:
pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni daivatāni tathā punaḥ ..
pūjitāni ca sarvāṇi kuṇḍasnānaprabhāvataḥ .. 63 ..
16.147.d:
पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि दैवतानि तथा पुनः ..
पूजितानि च सर्वाणि कुण्डस्नानप्रभावतः .. 63 ..
16.147.m: Whatever sacred fords there are on earth, and likewise all the deities— / all of them are worshipped through the power of bathing in the pool.

16.147.s: saptajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ darśanātkṣayamāvrajet .. 64 ..
16.147.d: सप्तजन्मार्जितं पापं दर्शनात्क्षयमाव्रजेत् .. 64 ..
16.147.m: The sin acquired across seven lifetimes departs into destruction from its darśana.

16.147.s:
yatpāpaṃ gurugoghne ca parasvaharaṇeṣu ca ..
tatpāpaṃ kṣayamāpnoti brahmakuṇḍaniṣevaṇāt .. 65 ..
16.147.d:
यत्पापं गुरुगोघ्ने च परस्वहरणेषु च ..
तत्पापं क्षयमाप्नोति ब्रह्मकुण्डनिषेवणात् .. 65 ..
16.147.m: Whatever sin is incurred in killing a guru or a cow, and in seizing the property of others— / that sin meets destruction from serving Brahmakuṇḍa.

16.147.s:
pradakṣiṇaṃ ca yaḥ kuryātsnātvā kuṇḍasya nāmataḥ ..
saṃkhyayā paṃcadaśa vai śṛṇu tasyāpi yatphalam .. 66 ..
16.147.d:
प्रदक्षिणं च यः कुर्यात्स्नात्वा कुण्डस्य नामतः ..
संख्यया पंचदश वै शृणु तस्यापि यत्फलम् .. 66 ..
16.147.m: And whoever, having bathed, circumambulates the pool by name / fifteen in number—hear the fruit of that too!

16.147.s:
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasundharā ..
saptapātālasahitā tīrthakoṭibhirāvṛtā .. 67 ..
16.147.d:
प्रदक्षिणीकृता तेन सप्तद्वीपा वसुन्धरा ..
सप्तपातालसहिता तीर्थकोटिभिरावृता .. 67 ..
16.147.m: By him has been circumambulated the earth with its seven continents, / together with the seven netherworlds, surrounded by millions of sacred fords.

16.147.s:
āhāramātraṃ yo dadyāttatra vedavidāṃ vare ..
lakṣabhojyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ .. 68 ..
16.147.d:
आहारमात्रं यो दद्यात्तत्र वेदविदां वरे ..
लक्षभोज्यं कृतं तेन तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः .. 68 ..
16.147.m: Whoever gives mere food there to the best among the knowers of the Veda— / feeding a hundred thousand has been accomplished by him through the power of this sacred ford.

16.147.s:
brahmeśvaraṃ ca saṃpūjya hiraṇyeśvaramuttamam ..
kṣetrapālaṃ caturvaktraṃ pūjayeccintitaṃ labhet .. 69 ..
16.147.d:
ब्रह्मेश्वरं च संपूज्य हिरण्येश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
क्षेत्रपालं चतुर्वक्त्रं पूजयेच्चिन्तितं लभेत् .. 69 ..
16.147.m: And having worshipped Brahmeśvara, and the supreme Hiraṇyeśvara, / one should worship the four-faced guardian of the sacred field; one obtains what is desired.

16.147.s:
ekaviṃśatkulai ryuktaḥ sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ ..
brahmalokaṃ sa vai yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 7.1.147.70 ..
16.147.d:
एकविंशत्कुलै र्युक्तः सर्वपापविवर्जितः ..
ब्रह्मलोकं स वै याति नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 7.1.147.70 ..
16.147.m: Accompanied by twenty-one generations of his family, freed from all sin, / he indeed goes to the realm of Brahmā; no doubt should be entertained here.

16.147.s:
viraṃcikuṇḍe snātvā vā yo japedvedamātaram ..
lakṣajāpyavidhānena sa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet .. 71 ..
16.147.d:
विरंचिकुण्डे स्नात्वा वा यो जपेद्वेदमातरम् ..
लक्षजाप्यविधानेन स मुक्तः पातकैर्भवेत् .. 71 ..
16.147.m: Or having bathed in Virañcikuṇḍa, whoever mutters the Mother of the Vedas / according to the ritual of muttering it a hundred thousand times, becomes freed from sins.

16.147.s:
sa eva puṇyakarttā ca sa eva puruṣottamaḥ ..
yātrā tatra kṛtā yena brahmakuṇḍe varānane .. 72 ..
16.147.d:
स एव पुण्यकर्त्ता च स एव पुरुषोत्तमः ..
यात्रा तत्र कृता येन ब्रह्मकुण्डे वरानने .. 72 ..
16.147.m: He alone is the performer of meritorious deeds, he alone is the best of men, / by whom a pilgrimage has been made there to Brahmakuṇḍa, O fair-faced one.

16.147.s:
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasām ..
brahmakuṇḍaṃ samāśritya brahmadevamupāsate .. 73 ..
16.147.d:
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि ऋषीणामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् ..
ब्रह्मकुण्डं समाश्रित्य ब्रह्मदेवमुपासते .. 73 ..
16.147.m: Eighty-eight thousand seers with sublimated vital seed, / having resorted to Brahmakuṇḍa, worship the god Brahmā.

16.147.s:
tāvadgarjaṃti tīrthāni trailokye sacarācare ..
yāvadbrahmeśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ na paśyanti narāḥ priye .. 74 ..
16.147.d:
तावद्गर्जंति तीर्थानि त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ..
यावद्ब्रह्मेश्वरं तीर्थं न पश्यन्ति नराः प्रिये .. 74 ..
16.147.m: The sacred fords in the three worlds, with moving and unmoving beings, roar only so long / as men do not see the sacred ford Brahmeśvara, beloved.

16.147.s:
brahmakuṇḍe ca pānīyaṃ ye pibanti narāḥ sakṛt ..
na teṣāṃ saṃkrametpāpaṃ vācikaṃ mānasaṃ tanau .. 75 ..
16.147.d:
ब्रह्मकुण्डे च पानीयं ये पिबन्ति नराः सकृत् ..
न तेषां संक्रमेत्पापं वाचिकं मानसं तनौ .. 75 ..
16.147.m: And the men who drink water at Brahmakuṇḍa even once— / sin of speech or mind does not enter into their body.

16.147.s:
brahmāṃḍottaramadhye tu yāni tīrthāni saṃti vai ..
teṣāṃ puṇyamavāpnoti brahmakuṇḍe pradakṣiṇāt .. 76 ..
16.147.d:
ब्रह्मांडोत्तरमध्ये तु यानि तीर्थानि संति वै ..
तेषां पुण्यमवाप्नोति ब्रह्मकुण्डे प्रदक्षिणात् .. 76 ..
16.147.m: Whatever sacred fords exist in the northern center of the cosmic egg— / one attains their merit from circumambulating Brahmakuṇḍa.

16.147.s:
yājñavalkyo mahātmā ca parabrahmasvarūpavān ..
so'pi kuṃḍaṃ na muṃceta nikuṃ bhastu gaṇastathā .. 77 ..
16.147.d:
याज्ञवल्क्यो महात्मा च परब्रह्मस्वरूपवान् ..
सोऽपि कुंडं न मुंचेत निकुं भस्तु गणस्तथा .. 77 ..
16.147.m: Even the great-souled Yājñavalkya, embodying the Supreme Brahman, / does not leave the pool, nor does the gaṇa Nikuṃbha.

16.147.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ brahmakuṇḍajam ..
tava snehena deveśi kimanyatparipṛcchasi .. 78 ..
16.147.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं माहात्म्यं ब्रह्मकुण्डजम् ..
तव स्नेहेन देवेशि किमन्यत्परिपृच्छसि .. 78 ..
16.147.m: Thus the māhātmya originating from Brahmakuṇḍa has been spoken in brief. / Out of affection for you, O queen of gods, what else do you ask?

16.147.s:
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānmartyaḥ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairbrahmalokaṃ ca gacchati .. 79 ..
16.147.d:
य इदं शृणुयान्मर्त्यः सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
स मुक्तः पातकैः सर्वैर्ब्रह्मलोकं च गच्छति .. 79 ..
16.147.m: Whichsoever mortal hears this, fully endowed with faith, / freed from all sins, he goes to the realm of Brahmā.

16.147.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmakuṇḍamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 147 .. .. cha ..
16.147.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ब्रह्मकुण्डमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तचत्वारिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 147 .. .. छ ..
16.147.m: Thus ends the one hundred forty-seventh chapter, named the Description of the Māhātmya of Brahmakuṇḍa, in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [book], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.148.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kūpaṃ kuṃḍalasaṃbhavam ..
tasyaiva cottare bhāge brahmakuṇḍasamīpataḥ .. 1 ..
16.148.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि कूपं कुंडलसंभवम् ..
तस्यैव चोत्तरे भागे ब्रह्मकुण्डसमीपतः .. 1 ..
16.148.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the well arisen from the earring, / on the northern side of that very [place], near Brahmakuṇḍa,

16.148.s:
yatra siddho mahādevi rūpakuṃḍalahārakaḥ ..
tatra snātvā naro devi mucyetsteyakṛtādaghāt .. 2 ..
16.148.d:
यत्र सिद्धो महादेवि रूपकुंडलहारकः ..
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो देवि मुच्येत्स्तेयकृतादघात् .. 2 ..
16.148.m: where the stealer of the beautiful earring attained perfection, O great goddess. / Having bathed there, O goddess, a man is freed from the sin committed by theft.

16.148.s:
sapta janmāni deveśi na tasyānvayasaṃbhavaḥ ..
cauraḥ kaścidbhavetkrūrastatra snānaprabhāvataḥ .. 3 ..
16.148.d:
सप्त जन्मानि देवेशि न तस्यान्वयसंभवः ..
चौरः कश्चिद्भवेत्क्रूरस्तत्र स्नानप्रभावतः .. 3 ..
16.148.m: For seven births, O queen of gods, there is no arising in his lineage / of any cruel thief, through the power of bathing there.

16.148.s:
śivarātryāṃ viśeṣeṇa piṃḍadānādikāṃ kriyām ..
kuryācchastrahatānāṃ ca pāpināṃ tatra muktaye .. 4 ..
16.148.d:
शिवरात्र्यां विशेषेण पिंडदानादिकां क्रियाम् ..
कुर्याच्छस्त्रहतानां च पापिनां तत्र मुक्तये .. 4 ..
16.148.m: Especially on Śivarātri, one should perform the rite of offering funeral cakes and the like / there for the liberation of sinners and those slain by weapons.

16.148.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kathaṃ kuṇḍalarūpaṃ tu pṛthivyāṃ khyātimāgatam ..
etatkathaya me deva vistarādvadatāṃ vara .. 5 ..
16.148.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कथं कुण्डलरूपं तु पृथिव्यां ख्यातिमागतम् ..
एतत्कथय मे देव विस्तराद्वदतां वर .. 5 ..
16.148.m: The goddess said: / How did the form of the earring come to fame on earth? / Tell me this in detail, O god, best of speakers!

16.148.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi mahāpuṇyāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm ..
yāṃ śrutvā mucyate pāpānnaro janmaśatārjitāt .. 6 ..
16.148.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि महापुण्यां कथां पापप्रणाशनीम् ..
यां श्रुत्वा मुच्यते पापान्नरो जन्मशतार्जितात् .. 6 ..
16.148.m: Īśvara said: / Hear, O goddess, the highly meritorious story that destroys sin, / hearing which a man is freed from sin acquired across a hundred births.

16.148.s:
prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyācchivarātryāmupoṣitaḥ ..
āsītsudarśano rājā pṛthivyāmekarāṭ sudhīḥ . .. 7 ..
16.148.d:
प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्याच्छिवरात्र्यामुपोषितः ..
आसीत्सुदर्शनो राजा पृथिव्यामेकराट् सुधीः . .. 7 ..
16.148.m: On account of the māhātmya of Prabhāsa-kṣetra, having fasted on Śivarātri, / there was a wise king, Sudarśana, the sole monarch on earth.

16.148.s:
dhanyo hi sa dhanāḍhyaśca prajāṃ yatnairapālayat ..
rājyaṃ tasya susaṃpannaṃ brāhmaṇairupaśobhitam ..
samṛddhamṛddhisaṃyuktaṃ viṭataskaravarjitam .. 8 ..
16.148.d:
धन्यो हि स धनाढ्यश्च प्रजां यत्नैरपालयत् ..
राज्यं तस्य सुसंपन्नं ब्राह्मणैरुपशोभितम् ..
समृद्धमृद्धिसंयुक्तं विटतस्करवर्जितम् .. 8 ..
16.148.m: He was indeed fortunate and wealthy, and he protected the subjects with care. / His kingdom was highly prosperous, adorned with brahmins, / opulent, endowed with prosperity, free from scoundrels and thieves.

16.148.s:
tasmiñjanapade ramye purī bhagavatī śubhā ..
cāturvarṇyasamāyuktā puraprākāramaṃḍitā .. 9 ..
16.148.d:
तस्मिञ्जनपदे रम्ये पुरी भगवती शुभा ..
चातुर्वर्ण्यसमायुक्ता पुरप्राकारमंडिता .. 9 ..
16.148.m: In that delightful country was the auspicious, blessed city, / furnished with the four castes and adorned with city walls.

16.148.s:
tasminpuravare ramye rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam ..
karoti bāndhavaiḥ sārddhamṛddhiyuktaḥ sudarśanaḥ ..
hiraṇyadattasya suto jāto gāṃdhārakanyayā .. 7.1.148.10 ..
16.148.d:
तस्मिन्पुरवरे रम्ये राज्यं निहतकण्टकम् ..
करोति बान्धवैः सार्द्धमृद्धियुक्तः सुदर्शनः ..
हिरण्यदत्तस्य सुतो जातो गांधारकन्यया .. 7.1.148.10 ..
16.148.m: In that delightful, excellent city, Sudarśana, endowed with prosperity, / together with his kinsmen, ruled the kingdom free of thorns, / he who was the son of Hiraṇyadatta, born of a Gāndhāra girl.

16.148.s:
tasya bhāryā priyā sādhvī bhartṛvrataparāyaṇā ..
sunaṃdā nāmavikhyātā kāśirājasutā śubhā .. 11 ..
16.148.d:
तस्य भार्या प्रिया साध्वी भर्तृव्रतपरायणा ..
सुनंदा नामविख्याता काशिराजसुता शुभा .. 11 ..
16.148.m: His beloved wife was virtuous, devoted to her husband's vows, / the auspicious daughter of the king of Kāśi, renowned by the name Sunandā.

16.148.s:
tayā sārdhaṃ hi rājendro bhogānsa bubhuje sadā ..
bhuṃjamānasya bhogānvai cirakālo gatastadā ..12..
16.148.d:
तया सार्धं हि राजेन्द्रो भोगान्स बुभुजे सदा ..
भुंजमानस्य भोगान्वै चिरकालो गतस्तदा ..12..
16.148.m: With her indeed the king of kings constantly enjoyed pleasures. / While he was enjoying pleasures, a long time passed then.

16.148.s:
akarotsa mahāyajñāndadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ ..
evaṃ kālo gatastasya bhāryayā saha suvrate .. 13 ..
16.148.d:
अकरोत्स महायज्ञान्ददौ दानानि भूरिशः ..
एवं कालो गतस्तस्य भार्यया सह सुव्रते .. 13 ..
16.148.m: He performed great sacrifices and gave abundant gifts. / In this way his time passed along with his wife, O lady of good vows.

16.148.s:
kadācinmāghamāse tu śivarātryāṃ varānane ..
sasmāra pūrvajātiṃ sa bhāryāmāhūya cābravīt .. 14 ..
16.148.d:
कदाचिन्माघमासे तु शिवरात्र्यां वरानने ..
सस्मार पूर्वजातिं स भार्यामाहूय चाब्रवीत् .. 14 ..
16.148.m: Once, during the month of Māgha, on Śivarātri, O fair-faced one, / he remembered his previous birth, and having summoned his wife, he spoke:

16.148.s:
.. sudarśana uvāca .. ..
śivarātrivrataṃ devi mayā kāryaṃ varānane ..
vratasyāsya prabhāvena prāptaṃ rājyaṃ mayā kila .. 15 ..
16.148.d:
.. सुदर्शन उवाच .. ..
शिवरात्रिव्रतं देवि मया कार्यं वरानने ..
व्रतस्यास्य प्रभावेन प्राप्तं राज्यं मया किल .. 15 ..
16.148.m:
Sudarśana said:
O goddess, O fair-faced lady, the Śivarātri vow must be performed by me. / Truly, through the power of this vow, kingdom was obtained by me.

16.148.s:
..rājñyuvāca .. ..
mahānprabhāvo rājendra evamuktaṃ tvayā mama ..
etanme kāraṇaṃ brūhi āścaryaṃ hṛdi vartate .. 16.. ..
16.148.d:
..राज्ञ्युवाच .. ..
महान्प्रभावो राजेन्द्र एवमुक्तं त्वया मम ..
एतन्मे कारणं ब्रूहि आश्चर्यं हृदि वर्तते .. 16.. ..
16.148.m:
The queen said:
Great is its power, O lord of kings! Thus it has been spoken to me by you. / Tell me the reason for this; wonder dwells in my heart.

16.148.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
śṛṇu tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ śivarātrimupoṣaṇāt ..
tasmiñchivapure ramye svargadvāre suśobhane..17..
16.148.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
शृणु तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं शिवरात्रिमुपोषणात् ..
तस्मिञ्छिवपुरे रम्ये स्वर्गद्वारे सुशोभने..17..
16.148.m:
The king said:
Hear the māhātmya of the sacred ford, from fasting on Śivarātri, / in that delightful Śivapura, the exceedingly beautiful gateway to heaven,

16.148.s: āditīrthe prabhāse tu kāmike tīrtha uttame .. 18..
16.148.d: आदितीर्थे प्रभासे तु कामिके तीर्थ उत्तमे .. 18..
16.148.m: in Prabhāsa, the primeval sacred ford, the supreme, wish-granting sacred ford.

16.148.s:
ṛddhiyukte pure tasminnityaṃ dharmānusevite ..
śivarātryāṃ gato rājñi tithīnāmuttamā tithiḥ .. 19..
16.148.d:
ऋद्धियुक्ते पुरे तस्मिन्नित्यं धर्मानुसेविते ..
शिवरात्र्यां गतो राज्ञि तिथीनामुत्तमा तिथिः .. 19..
16.148.m: In that prosperous city constantly attended by dharma, / [I] went on Śivarātri, O queen, the highest lunar day among lunar days.

16.148.s:
mānavāstatra ye kecitpurarāṣṭrani vāsinaḥ..
tatrāgatā varārohe śivarātryāmupoṣitum .. 7.1.148.20 ..
16.148.d:
मानवास्तत्र ये केचित्पुरराष्ट्रनि वासिनः..
तत्रागता वरारोहे शिवरात्र्यामुपोषितुम् .. 7.1.148.20 ..
16.148.m: Whatever mortals dwelt in the city and realm there, / they came there, O lady of fair hips, to fast on Śivarātri.

16.148.s:
dhananāmā vaṇikkaścittatraiva vasate sadā ..
dhanāḍhyaḥ sa tu dharmātmā sadā dharmaparāyaṇaḥ .. ..21 ..
16.148.d:
धननामा वणिक्कश्चित्तत्रैव वसते सदा ..
धनाढ्यः स तु धर्मात्मा सदा धर्मपरायणः .. ..21 ..
16.148.m: A certain merchant named Dhana always lived right there; / rich in wealth, he was righteous-minded, always devoted to dharma.

16.148.s:
sa bhāryāsahitastatra śivarātrimupoṣitaḥ ..
tasya bhāryā'bhavatsādhvī rūpayauvanasaṃvṛtā .. 22 ..
16.148.d:
स भार्यासहितस्तत्र शिवरात्रिमुपोषितः ..
तस्य भार्याऽभवत्साध्वी रूपयौवनसंवृता .. 22 ..
16.148.m: Together with his wife, he fasted there on Śivarātri. / His wife was a virtuous woman, endowed with beauty and youth,

16.148.s:
pracalanmekhalāhārā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā ..
sa tayā bhāryayā sārdhaṃ kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ ..23..
16.148.d:
प्रचलन्मेखलाहारा सर्वाभरणभूषिता ..
स तया भार्यया सार्धं कामक्रोधविवर्जितः ..23..
16.148.m: with a trembling girdle and necklace, adorned with all ornaments. / Together with that wife, free from passion and wrath,

16.148.s:
prabhāsasyāgrato bhūtvā snātaḥ śuklāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ ..
yathoktena vidhānena bhaktyā nidrāvivarjitaḥ ..24..
16.148.d:
प्रभासस्याग्रतो भूत्वा स्नातः शुक्लांबरः शुचिः ..
यथोक्तेन विधानेन भक्त्या निद्राविवर्जितः ..24..
16.148.m: having stepped before Prabhāsa, bathed, clad in white, purified, / according to the prescribed rule, he remained devoid of sleep through devotion.

16.148.s:
tatrāhaṃ caurarūpeṇa pāpaḥ stainyaṃ samāśritaḥ ..
sacchūdrāṇāṃ kule jāto devabrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ .. 25 ..
16.148.d:
तत्राहं चौररूपेण पापः स्तैन्यं समाश्रितः ..
सच्छूद्राणां कुले जातो देवब्राह्मणपूजकः .. 25 ..
16.148.m: There was I, in the form of a thief, a sinner addicted to theft; / born into a family of good Śūdras, a worshipper of gods and brahmins,

16.148.s:
pūrvakarmānusaṃyogādvikarmaṇi rataḥ sadā ..
tasyāṃ rātryāmahaṃ tatra janamadhye tu saṃsthitaḥ .. 26 ..
16.148.d:
पूर्वकर्मानुसंयोगाद्विकर्मणि रतः सदा ..
तस्यां रात्र्यामहं तत्र जनमध्ये तु संस्थितः .. 26 ..
16.148.m: yet always attached to unlawful action owing to the connection of past karma. / On that night, I was stationed there in the midst of the crowd,

16.148.s:
kuṇḍalīnaḥ sthitastatra raṃdhrāpekṣī varānane ..
vaṇijastasya bhāryāyāśchidrānveṣaṇatatparaḥ .. 27 ..
16.148.d:
कुण्डलीनः स्थितस्तत्र रंध्रापेक्षी वरानने ..
वणिजस्तस्य भार्यायाश्छिद्रान्वेषणतत्परः .. 27 ..
16.148.m: lying coiled up there, watching for an opening, O fair-faced lady, / intent on seeking a weak moment in that merchant's wife.

16.148.s:
sā rātrirjāgratastasya gatā me vijane tathā ..
gītanṛtyādinirghoṣairvedamaṃgalapāṭakaiḥ .. 28 ..
16.148.d:
सा रात्रिर्जाग्रतस्तस्य गता मे विजने तथा ..
गीतनृत्यादिनिर्घोषैर्वेदमंगलपाटकैः .. 28 ..
16.148.m: While he remained awake, that night passed for me in that lonely spot, / amidst the sounds of song, dance, and other arts, and reciters of Vedic blessings,

16.148.s:
tālaśabdaistathā bandhaiḥ pustakānāṃ ca vācakaiḥ ..
evaṃ rātryāṃ tu śeṣāyāṃ yāvattiṣṭhati tatra vai .. 29 ..
16.148.d:
तालशब्दैस्तथा बन्धैः पुस्तकानां च वाचकैः ..
एवं रात्र्यां तु शेषायां यावत्तिष्ठति तत्र वै .. 29 ..
16.148.m: with the clapping of hands, poetic compositions, and readers of sacred texts. / As the remainder of the night lingered thus,

16.148.s:
nirodhena samāyuktā pīḍyamānā śucismitā ..
dhanibhāryā nirodhārtā devāgārādbahirgatā .. 7.1.148.30 ..
16.148.d:
निरोधेन समायुक्ता पीड्यमाना शुचिस्मिता ..
धनिभार्या निरोधार्ता देवागाराद्बहिर्गता .. 7.1.148.30 ..
16.148.m: afflicted by the urge [to relieve herself], distressed, that sweet-smiling woman, / the wealthy man's wife, tormented by the urge, went outside the temple.

16.148.s:
tasyāḥ karṇau troṭayitvā pupluve'haṃ jale sthitaḥ ..
tataḥ kolāhalastatra kṛtastatpuravāsibhiḥ .. 31 ..
16.148.d:
तस्याः कर्णौ त्रोटयित्वा पुप्लुवेऽहं जले स्थितः ..
ततः कोलाहलस्तत्र कृतस्तत्पुरवासिभिः .. 31 ..
16.148.m: Tearing off her two earrings, I leapt and stood in the water. / Thereupon, a great clamour was raised by the inhabitants of the city.

16.148.s:
śrutvā kolāhalaṃ śabdaṃ karṇatroṭanajaṃ tadā ..
dhāvitā rakṣakāstatra rājaśāsanakārakāḥ .. 32 ..
16.148.d:
श्रुत्वा कोलाहलं शब्दं कर्णत्रोटनजं तदा ..
धाविता रक्षकास्तत्र राजशासनकारकाः .. 32 ..
16.148.m: Hearing the clamorous sound caused by the tearing of the ear[rings], / the guards, enforcing the king's command, ran there at once.

16.148.s:
tairahaṃ śastrahastaiśca ulkāhastaiḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
nirīkṣito'tha na prāptaṃ suvarṇaṃ manmukhe sthitam .. .. 33 ..
16.148.d:
तैरहं शस्त्रहस्तैश्च उल्काहस्तैः समंततः ..
निरीक्षितोऽथ न प्राप्तं सुवर्णं मन्मुखे स्थितम् .. .. 33 ..
16.148.m: By them, weapons in hand and torches in hand all around, / I was watched closely, but the gold kept in my mouth was not recovered.

16.148.s:
khaḍgena tīkṣṇadhāreṇa chittvā śīrṣaṃ tadā mama ..
ulkāhastā nirīkṣanto nāpaśyansvarṇamaṇvapi .. 34 ..
16.148.d:
खड्गेन तीक्ष्णधारेण छित्त्वा शीर्षं तदा मम ..
उल्काहस्ता निरीक्षन्तो नापश्यन्स्वर्णमण्वपि .. 34 ..
16.148.m: Having then severed my head with a sharp-edged sword, / looking with torches in hand, they could not see even a particle of gold.

16.148.s:
hitvā māṃ te gatāḥ sarve gatvā rājñe nyavedayan ..
na kiñcittatra saṃprāptaṃ hato'smābhiśca tatkṣaṇāt .. 35 ..
16.148.d:
हित्वा मां ते गताः सर्वे गत्वा राज्ञे न्यवेदयन् ..
न किञ्चित्तत्र संप्राप्तं हतोऽस्माभिश्च तत्क्षणात् .. 35 ..
16.148.m: Leaving me, they all departed, and having gone, they reported to the king: / 'Nothing was found there, and he was slain by us instantly.'

16.148.s:
kathayitvā tu te sarve yathādeśaṃ gatāḥ punaḥ ..
tato vai bandhunā tatra bhayabhītena cetasā .. 36 ..
16.148.d:
कथयित्वा तु ते सर्वे यथादेशं गताः पुनः ..
ततो वै बन्धुना तत्र भयभीतेन चेतसा .. 36 ..
16.148.m: Having reported [this], they all went back to their respective places. / Then indeed, by a relative there, with a mind stricken with fear,

16.148.s:
nikhātaṃ mama tatraiva śiraḥ kāyena saṃyutam ..
khātaṃ kṛtvā priye tatra brahmatīrthasya cottare .. 37 ..
16.148.d:
निखातं मम तत्रैव शिरः कायेन संयुतम् ..
खातं कृत्वा प्रिये तत्र ब्रह्मतीर्थस्य चोत्तरे .. 37 ..
16.148.m: my head, together with my body, was buried right there; / having made a pit there, my dear, to the north of Brahmatīrtha,

16.148.s:
pihito'haṃ tu tatraiva prabhāse tīrtha uttame ..
śivarātriprabhāvena tajjātismaratāṃ gataḥ .. 38 ..
16.148.d:
पिहितोऽहं तु तत्रैव प्रभासे तीर्थ उत्तमे ..
शिवरात्रिप्रभावेन तज्जातिस्मरतां गतः .. 38 ..
16.148.m: I was concealed right there in Prabhāsa, the supreme sacred ford. / By the power of Śivarātri, I attained remembrance of that [past] birth.

16.148.s:
rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ prāptaṃ samṛddhaṃ varavarṇini ..
etatprabhāsamāhātmyaṃ śivarātrerupoṣaṇāt ..
etatphalaṃ mayā labdhaṃ gatvā tasmādupoṣaye .. 39 ..
16.148.d:
राज्यं निष्कण्टकं प्राप्तं समृद्धं वरवर्णिनि ..
एतत्प्रभासमाहात्म्यं शिवरात्रेरुपोषणात् ..
एतत्फलं मया लब्धं गत्वा तस्मादुपोषये .. 39 ..
16.148.m: A kingdom free of thorns, prosperous, has been obtained, O lady of fair complexion. / This is the māhātmya of Prabhāsa from the fasting on Śivarātri; / this fruit was obtained by me; therefore, having gone, I shall fast [there].

16.148.s:
.. rājñyuvāca .. ..
gacchāvastatra yatraiva kapālaṃ patitaṃ tava ..
sphoṭite ca kapāle ca hiraṇyaṃ dṛśyate yadi ..
pratyayo me bhavetpaścāttava vākyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 7.1.148.40 ..
16.148.d:
.. राज्ञ्युवाच .. ..
गच्छावस्तत्र यत्रैव कपालं पतितं तव ..
स्फोटिते च कपाले च हिरण्यं दृश्यते यदि ..
प्रत्ययो मे भवेत्पश्चात्तव वाक्यं न संशयः .. 7.1.148.40 ..
16.148.m:
The queen said:
Let the two of us go right to that place where your skull fell. / And if gold is seen when the skull is broken open, / then I shall have firm conviction; your statement [will be] beyond doubt.

16.148.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
kalpaṃ hi tiṣṭhate cāsthi yāvadbhūmiviparyayaḥ ..
uttiṣṭha vraja bhadraṃ te prabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam .. 41 ..
16.148.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
कल्पं हि तिष्ठते चास्थि यावद्भूमिविपर्ययः ..
उत्तिष्ठ व्रज भद्रं ते प्रभासं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् .. 41 ..
16.148.m:
The king said:
For a bone endures for an aeon, until the dissolution of the earth. / Arise, go! May good befall you, to Prabhāsa, the supreme sacred field.

16.148.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā yadrājñā samudīritam ..
gamanāya matiṃ cakre śivarātryā upoṣaṇe .. 42 ..
16.148.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा यद्राज्ञा समुदीरितम् ..
गमनाय मतिं चक्रे शिवरात्र्या उपोषणे .. 42 ..
16.148.m: Hearing that speech of his which was uttered by the king, / she set her mind upon going, for the fasting on Śivarātri.

16.148.s:
tato'śvairjavanaiyurktaṃ rathaṃ hemavibhūṣitam ..
āsthāya saha patnyā ca prabhāsaṃ kṣetrameyivān .. 43 ..
16.148.d:
ततोऽश्वैर्जवनैयुर्क्तं रथं हेमविभूषितम् ..
आस्थाय सह पत्न्या च प्रभासं क्षेत्रमेयिवान् .. 43 ..
16.148.m: Then, having mounted a chariot adorned with gold and yoked with swift horses, / along with his wife he went to the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.148.s:
vrataṃ kṛtvā prabhāse tu yathoktaṃ varavarṇini ..
brahmatīrthe samāgatya uddhṛtya sakalaṃ tataḥ ..44..
16.148.d:
व्रतं कृत्वा प्रभासे तु यथोक्तं वरवर्णिनि ..
ब्रह्मतीर्थे समागत्य उद्धृत्य सकलं ततः ..44..
16.148.m: Having observed the vow in Prabhāsa according to rule, O lady of fair complexion, / having arrived at Brahmatīrtha and then raised up the whole [corpse],

16.148.s: hiraṇyaṃ darśayāmāsa sphoṭayitvā śavaṃ svayam .. 45 ..
16.148.d: हिरण्यं दर्शयामास स्फोटयित्वा शवं स्वयम् .. 45 ..
16.148.m: having broken open the corpse himself, he showed her the gold.

16.148.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
jātasaṃpratyayā bhāryā tasya rājño babhūva ha ..
jagāma paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra kalyāṇamuttamam .. 46 ..
16.148.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
जातसंप्रत्यया भार्या तस्य राज्ञो बभूव ह ..
जगाम परमं स्थानं यत्र कल्याणमुत्तमम् .. 46 ..
16.148.m:
Īśvara said:
Full conviction arose in the wife of that king. / She went to the supreme abode where the highest auspiciousness resides.

16.148.s: jano'pi vismitaḥ sarvo dṛṣṭvā citraṃ tadadbhutam .. .. 47 ..
16.148.d: जनोऽपि विस्मितः सर्वो दृष्ट्वा चित्रं तदद्भुतम् .. .. 47 ..
16.148.m: All the people also were astonished, having seen that wondrous marvel.

16.148.s:
nadī citrapathānāma tatrotpannā varānane ..
citrādityasya pūrveṇa brahmatīrthasya cottare .. 48 ..
16.148.d:
नदी चित्रपथानाम तत्रोत्पन्ना वरानने ..
चित्रादित्यस्य पूर्वेण ब्रह्मतीर्थस्य चोत्तरे .. 48 ..
16.148.m: A river named Citrapathā arose there, O fair-faced lady, / to the east of Citrāditya and to the north of Brahmatīrtha.

16.148.s: tasyāṃ tattiṣṭhate tatra sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. .. 49 ..
16.148.d: तस्यां तत्तिष्ठते तत्र सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. .. 49 ..
16.148.m: In it [that well] remains there, destroying all sins.

16.148.s:
śrāvaṇe māsi saṃprāpte tasminkūpe vidhānataḥ ..
yaḥ snānaṃ kurute devi śrāddhaṃ tatra viśeṣataḥ .. 7.1.148.50 ..
16.148.d:
श्रावणे मासि संप्राप्ते तस्मिन्कूपे विधानतः ..
यः स्नानं कुरुते देवि श्राद्धं तत्र विशेषतः .. 7.1.148.50 ..
16.148.m: When the month of Śrāvaṇa has arrived, in that well, according to the rule, / whoever performs a bath, O goddess, and especially a śrāddha there,

16.148.s: citrādityaṃ tu saṃpūjya śivaloke mahīyate .. 51 ..
16.148.d: चित्रादित्यं तु संपूज्य शिवलोके महीयते .. 51 ..
16.148.m: having worshipped Citrāditya, is honoured in the world of Śiva.

16.148.s:
etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śivarātryā mahatphalam ..
bhuktimuktipradaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 52 ..
16.148.d:
एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं शिवरात्र्या महत्फलम् ..
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं पुण्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 52 ..
16.148.m: All this has been told to you: the great fruit of Śivarātri, / bestowing enjoyment and liberation, meritorious, destroying all sins.

16.148.s:
ya idaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ śṛṇuyādvāpi mānavaḥ ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto rudraloke mahīyate .. 53 ..
16.148.d:
य इदं पठते नित्यं शृणुयाद्वापि मानवः ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो रुद्रलोके महीयते .. 53 ..
16.148.m: Whatever mortal recites this daily or even hears it, / completely freed from all sins, is honoured in the world of Rudra.

16.148.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye kuṇḍalakūpamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭācatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 148 .. .. cha ..
16.148.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभास क्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कुण्डलकूपमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टाचत्वारिंशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 148 .. .. छ ..
16.148.m: Thus ends the one hundred and forty-eighth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Kuṇḍalakūpa', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.149.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi bhairaveśvaramuttamam ..
brahmakuṇḍasya īśāne sthitaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ..
caturvaktraṃ mahādevaṃ saṃsthitaṃ tīrtharakṣaṇe .. 1 ..
16.149.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि भैरवेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
ब्रह्मकुण्डस्य ईशाने स्थितं पापप्रणाशनम् ..
चतुर्वक्त्रं महादेवं संस्थितं तीर्थरक्षणे .. 1 ..
16.149.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to the supreme Bhairaveśvara, / located to the northeast of Brahmakuṇḍa, destroying sin, / the four-faced Mahādeva standing in protection of the sacred ford.

16.149.s:
tatra snātvā mahākuṇḍe yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ ..
paṃcopacāravidhinā bhaktiyukto yatendriyaḥ .. 2 ..
16.149.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा महाकुण्डे यस्तं पूजयते नरः ..
पंचोपचारविधिना भक्तियुक्तो यतेन्द्रियः .. 2 ..
16.149.m: Having bathed there in the great pool, whatever man worships him / by the rite of five offerings, endowed with devotion, having restrained his senses,

16.149.s:
kulāni yānyatītāni bhaviṣyāṇi ca yāni vai ..
tārayetsa naro devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 3 ..
16.149.d:
कुलानि यान्यतीतानि भविष्याणि च यानि वै ..
तारयेत्स नरो देवि नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 3 ..
16.149.m: Whatever families are past, and whatever are yet to come, / that man liberates them, O goddess; no doubt should be had in this matter.

16.149.s:
na cātra saṃbhavastasya vināśo naiva jāyate ..
vimānaiścarate nityaṃ divākarasamaprabhaiḥ .. 4 ..
16.149.d:
न चात्र संभवस्तस्य विनाशो नैव जायते ..
विमानैश्चरते नित्यं दिवाकरसमप्रभैः .. 4 ..
16.149.m: And for him there is no rebirth here, nor does destruction ever occur; / he travels constantly in aerial chariots possessing the brilliance of the sun.
Surrounded constantly by thousands of women, he sports in heaven like a god.

16.149.s:
etalliṃgaṃ mahādevi caturvaktraṃ mahāprabham ..
dṛṣṭvāpi tadvimucyeta sarvapāpaistu mānavaḥ ..6..
16.149.d:
एतल्लिंगं महादेवि चतुर्वक्त्रं महाप्रभम् ..
दृष्ट्वापि तद्विमुच्येत सर्वपापैस्तु मानवः ..6..
16.149.m: Even upon merely seeing this four-faced, splendid liṅga, O great goddess, / a human being is freed from all sins.

16.149.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bhairaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonapaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 149 .. .. cha .. ..
16.149.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये भैरवेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनपंचाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 149 .. .. छ .. ..
16.149.m: Thus ends the one hundred forty-ninth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Māhātmya of Bhairaveśvara," in the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, the first [part] in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

16.150.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato brahmeśvaraṃ gacchettasya dakṣiṇataḥ sthitam ..
brahmaṇā sthāpitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmakuṇḍasamīpataḥ ..
triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ rakṣyamāṇaṃ gaṇairmama .. 1 ..
16.150.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो ब्रह्मेश्वरं गच्छेत्तस्य दक्षिणतः स्थितम् ..
ब्रह्मणा स्थापितं पूर्वं ब्रह्मकुण्डसमीपतः ..
त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्यातं रक्ष्यमाणं गणैर्मम .. 1 ..
16.150.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go to Brahmeśvara, situated to the south of it, / established formerly by Brahmā near the Brahmakuṇḍa, / renowned in the three worlds and guarded by my gaṇas.

16.150.s:
tatra snātvā caturdaśyāmamāvāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
śrāddhaṃ ca vidhivatkṛtvā brahmeśaṃ pūjayettataḥ .. 2 ..
16.150.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा चतुर्दश्याममावास्यां विशेषतः ..
श्राद्धं च विधिवत्कृत्वा ब्रह्मेशं पूजयेत्ततः .. 2 ..
16.150.m: Having bathed there on the fourteenth day, especially on the new moon day, / and having performed the ancestral rites according to rule, one should then worship Brahmeśa.
One should give gold to the brahmins for the gratification of Śaṃkara.

16.150.s:
evaṃ kṛtvā naro devi labhate janmanaḥ phalam ..
vipulāṃ kīrtimāyāti modate brahmaṇā priye .. 4 ..
16.150.d:
एवं कृत्वा नरो देवि लभते जन्मनः फलम् ..
विपुलां कीर्तिमायाति मोदते ब्रह्मणा प्रिये .. 4 ..
16.150.m: Having done this, O goddess, a man obtains the fruit of his life; / he attains extensive renown and rejoices with Brahmā, O beloved.

16.150.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmakuṃḍamāhātmye brahmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcāśadu ttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 150 ..
16.150.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ब्रह्मकुंडमाहात्म्ये ब्रह्मेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पंचाशदु त्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 150 ..
16.150.m: Thus ends the one hundred fiftieth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Māhātmya of Brahmeśvara" in the Māhātmya of Brahmakuṇḍa, in the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, the first [part] in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

16.151.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge tṛtīyo bhairavaḥ sthita ..
brahmakuṇḍasamīpe tu sāvitryā saṃpratiṣṭhitaḥ .. 1 ..
16.151.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्यैव दक्षिणे भागे तृतीयो भैरवः स्थित ..
ब्रह्मकुण्डसमीपे तु सावित्र्या संप्रतिष्ठितः .. 1 ..
16.151.m: Īśvara said: / In the southern part of that very place stands the third Bhairava, / established by Sāvitrī near the Brahmakuṇḍa.

16.151.s:
ārādhya tatra deveśaṃ devānāṃ prapitāmaham ..
vāyubhakṣā nirāhārā toṣayāmāsa śaṃkaram .. 2 ..
16.151.d:
आराध्य तत्र देवेशं देवानां प्रपितामहम् ..
वायुभक्षा निराहारा तोषयामास शंकरम् .. 2 ..
16.151.m: Worshipping the lord of the gods there, the great-grandfather of the gods, / consuming only wind and taking no food, she gratified Śaṃkara.
Pleased, the lord Śaṃkara, O goddess, said to that fair-faced lady:

16.151.s:
yo'sminkuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā malliṃgaṃ pūjayiṣyati ..
paurṇamāsyāṃ vidhānena gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt .. 4 ..
16.151.d:
योऽस्मिन्कुंडे नरः स्नात्वा मल्लिंगं पूजयिष्यति ..
पौर्णमास्यां विधानेन गन्धपुष्पादिभिः क्रमात् .. 4 ..
16.151.m: The man who, having bathed in this kuṇḍa, shall worship my liṅga / on the full moon day according to rule, with perfumes, flowers, and the rest in order,
I shall give him the auspicious boons he desires, firmly fixed in his mind.

16.151.s:
mahāpātakayukto'pi mukto bhavati pātakaiḥ ..
sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā sa bhūyādvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ .. 6 ..
16.151.d:
महापातकयुक्तोऽपि मुक्तो भवति पातकैः ..
सर्वकामसमृद्धात्मा स भूयाद्वृषभध्वजः .. 6 ..
16.151.m: Even though joined with great sins, he becomes liberated from sins; / with his soul abounding in all desires, he shall become the bull-bannered [Śiva].

16.151.s:
ityevamuktvā deveśi tato'ntardhānamāgataḥ ..
sāvitrī brahmaloke tu gatā saṃsthāpya śaṃkaram .. 7 ..
16.151.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा देवेशि ततोऽन्तर्धानमागतः ..
सावित्री ब्रह्मलोके तु गता संस्थाप्य शंकरम् .. 7 ..
16.151.m: Having spoken thus, O ruler of gods, he then vanished; / and Sāvitrī, having established Śaṃkara, went to the world of Brahmā.

16.151.s:
iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ sāvitrīśamahodayam ..
śṛṇuyādyastu matimānsa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet .. 8 ..
16.151.d:
इति संक्षेपतः प्रोक्तं सावित्रीशमहोदयम् ..
शृणुयाद्यस्तु मतिमान्स मुक्तः पातकैर्भवेत् .. 8 ..
16.151.m: Thus has been declared briefly the great rise of Sāvitrīśa; / the wise man who hears it becomes liberated from sins.
