16.151.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmakuṇḍamāhātmye sāvitrīśvarabhairavamāhātmya- varṇanaṃnāmaikapaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 151 ..
16.151.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ब्रह्मकुण्डमाहात्म्ये सावित्रीश्वरभैरवमाहात्म्य- वर्णनंनामैकपंचाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 151 ..
16.151.m: Thus ends the one hundred fifty-first chapter, entitled "The Description of the Māhātmya of Sāvitrīśvara-bhairava" in the Māhātmya of Brahmakuṇḍa, in the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, the first [part] in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

16.152.s:
.. .. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tṛtīyo bhairavaḥ proktaścaturthaṃ bhairavaṃ śṛṇu ..
brahmeśātpaścime bhāge dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam .. 1 ..
16.152.d:
.. .. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तृतीयो भैरवः प्रोक्तश्चतुर्थं भैरवं शृणु ..
ब्रह्मेशात्पश्चिमे भागे धनुषां त्रितये स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.152.m: Īśvara said: / The third Bhairava has been declared; hear about the fourth Bhairava, / situated three bow-lengths to the western side of Brahmeśa,

16.152.s:
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarva kāmapradaṃ nṛṇām ..
nāradeśvaranāmānaṃ sthāpitaṃ nāradena vai .. 2 ..
16.152.d:
सर्वपापप्रशमनं सर्व कामप्रदं नृणाम् ..
नारदेश्वरनामानं स्थापितं नारदेन वै .. 2 ..
16.152.m: which pacifies all sins and grants all desires to human beings, / named Nāradeśvara, established indeed by Nārada.

16.152.s:
brahmaloke sthitaḥ pūrvaṃ nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ ..
tatra dṛṣṭvā mahāvīṇāṃ divyāṃ taṃtryayutai ryutām .. 3 ..
16.152.d:
ब्रह्मलोके स्थितः पूर्वं नारदो भगवानृषिः ..
तत्र दृष्ट्वा महावीणां दिव्यां तंत्र्ययुतै र्युताम् .. 3 ..
16.152.m: Formerly, the venerable seer Nārada stayed in the world of Brahmā; / seeing there a great, divine lute provided with ten thousand strings,

16.152.s:
sarasvatyā vinirmuktāṃ brahmaloke mahāprabhām ..
tenāsau kautukāviṣṭo vādayāmāsa tāṃ tadā .. 4 ..
16.152.d:
सरस्वत्या विनिर्मुक्तां ब्रह्मलोके महाप्रभाम् ..
तेनासौ कौतुकाविष्टो वादयामास तां तदा .. 4 ..
16.152.m: left behind by Sarasvatī in the world of Brahmā, possessing great brilliance, / he, seized by curiosity, played it then.

16.152.s:
taṃtrībhyo vādyamānābhyo brāhmaṇāḥ patitā bhuvi ..
sapta svarāste vikhyātā mūrcchitāḥ ṣaḍjakādayaḥ .. 5 ..
16.152.d:
तंत्रीभ्यो वाद्यमानाभ्यो ब्राह्मणाः पतिता भुवि ..
सप्त स्वरास्ते विख्याता मूर्च्छिताः षड्जकादयः .. 5 ..
16.152.m: As the strings were being played, brahmins fell to the earth; / they were the seven renowned musical notes beginning with ṣaḍja, fallen unconscious.

16.152.s:
tāndṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭo muktvā vīṇāṃ prayatnataḥ ..
papraccha devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ kimidaṃ kautukaṃ vibho .. 6 ..
16.152.d:
तान्दृष्ट्वा विस्मयाविष्टो मुक्त्वा वीणां प्रयत्नतः ..
पप्रच्छ देवं ब्रह्माणं किमिदं कौतुकं विभो .. 6 ..
16.152.m: Filled with astonishment upon seeing them, carefully releasing the lute, / he asked the god Brahmā: "O lord, what is this strange event?

16.152.s:
vādyamānāsu tantrīṣu patitā brāhmaṇā bhuvi ..
ka ete brāhmaṇā deva kiṃ mṛtā iva śerate .. 7 ..
16.152.d:
वाद्यमानासु तन्त्रीषु पतिता ब्राह्मणा भुवि ..
क एते ब्राह्मणा देव किं मृता इव शेरते .. 7 ..
16.152.m: When the strings were being played, brahmins fell to the earth. / Who are these brahmins, O god, and why do they lie as if dead?"

16.152.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
ete svarā mahābhāga mūrcchitāḥ patitā bhuvi ..
ajñānavādanenaiva pāpaṃ jātaṃ tavādhunā .. 8 ..
16.152.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
एते स्वरा महाभाग मूर्च्छिताः पतिता भुवि ..
अज्ञानवादनेनैव पापं जातं तवाधुना .. 8 ..
16.152.m: Brahmā said: / These musical notes, O fortunate one, have fallen unconscious to the earth; / on account of playing in ignorance, sin has now been incurred by you.

16.152.s:
saptabrāhmaṇavidhvaṃsapātakaṃ te samā gatam ..
tasmācchīghraṃ vraja mune prabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam .. 9 ..
16.152.d:
सप्तब्राह्मणविध्वंसपातकं ते समा गतम् ..
तस्माच्छीघ्रं व्रज मुने प्रभासं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् .. 9 ..
16.152.m: The sin of ruining seven brahmins has overtaken you; / therefore, go quickly, O sage, to the excellent sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.152.s:
samārādhaya deveśaṃ sarvapāpaviśuddhaye ..
ityukto nāradastatra saṃtapya ca muhurmuhuḥ .. 7.1.152.10 ..
16.152.d:
समाराधय देवेशं सर्वपापविशुद्धये ..
इत्युक्तो नारदस्तत्र संतप्य च मुहुर्मुहुः .. 7.1.152.10 ..
16.152.m: Worship the lord of the gods for the purification from all sins. / Addressed thus, Nārada, grieving there again and again,

16.152.s:
kṛtvā viṣādaṃ bahuśaḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ ..
tatraiva brahmakuṇḍaṃ tu samāsādya prayatnataḥ .. 11 ..
16.152.d:
कृत्वा विषादं बहुशः प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागतः ..
तत्रैव ब्रह्मकुण्डं तु समासाद्य प्रयत्नतः .. 11 ..
16.152.m: lamenting intensely, came to the sacred field of Prabhāsa; / and diligently approaching the Brahmakuṇḍa right there,

16.152.s:
bhairavaṃ pūjayāmāsa divyābdānāṃ śataṃ priye ..
tato niṣkalmaṣo bhūtvā gītajñaścābhavattathā .. 12 ..
16.152.d:
भैरवं पूजयामास दिव्याब्दानां शतं प्रिये ..
ततो निष्कल्मषो भूत्वा गीतज्ञश्चाभवत्तथा .. 12 ..
16.152.m: he worshipped Bhairava for a hundred divine years, O beloved; / then he became free of taint, and likewise an expert in song.

16.152.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti talliṃgaṃ nāradeśvarabhairavam ..
khyātaṃ loke mahādevi sarvapātakanāśanam .. 13 ..
16.152.d:
ततः प्रभृति तल्लिंगं नारदेश्वरभैरवम् ..
ख्यातं लोके महादेवि सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 13 ..
16.152.m: From that time forth, that liṅga became known in the world, O great goddess, / as Nāradeśvarabhairava, the destroyer of all sins.

16.152.s:
ajñānādvādayedyastu vīṇāṃ caiva tathā svarān ..
sa tatpātakaśuddhyarthaṃ tatra gacchenmaheśvari .. 14 ..
16.152.d:
अज्ञानाद्वादयेद्यस्तु वीणां चैव तथा स्वरान् ..
स तत्पातकशुद्ध्यर्थं तत्र गच्छेन्महेश्वरि .. 14 ..
16.152.m: He who out of ignorance plays the lute and the musical notes, / should go there for purification from that sin, O great goddess.

16.152.s:
māghe māsi jitāhārastrikālaṃ yo'rcayettataḥ ..
nāradeśaṃ bhairavaṃ sa svargarāmāmanoharaḥ .. 15 ..
16.152.d:
माघे मासि जिताहारस्त्रिकालं योऽर्चयेत्ततः ..
नारदेशं भैरवं स स्वर्गरामामनोहरः .. 15 ..
16.152.m: He who, having conquered his food, worships Nāradeśa-bhairava / at the three times of day in the month of Māgha, captivates the women of heaven.

16.152.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye brahmakuṇḍamāhātmye nāradeśvarabhairavamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvipaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 152 .. .. cha ..
16.152.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये ब्रह्मकुण्डमाहात्म्ये नारदेश्वरभैरवमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विपंचाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 152 .. .. छ ..
16.152.m: Thus ends the one hundred fifty-second chapter, entitled "The Description of the Māhātmya of Nāradeśvarabhairava" in the Māhātmya of Brahmakuṇḍa, in the Māhātmya of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, the first [part] in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

16.153.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi hiraṇyeśvaramuttamam ..
brahmakuṇḍasya vāyavye dhanuṣāṃ dvitaye sthitam .. 1 ..
16.153.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि हिरण्येश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
ब्रह्मकुण्डस्य वायव्ये धनुषां द्वितये स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.153.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the excellent Hiraṇyeśvara, / situated two bow-lengths to the north-west of Brahmakuṇḍa,

16.153.s:
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ dāridryaughavināśanam ..
kṛtasmarācca parato hyagnitīrthācca pūrvataḥ .. 2 ..
16.153.d:
सर्वपापप्रशमनं दारिद्र्यौघविनाशनम् ..
कृतस्मराच्च परतो ह्यग्नितीर्थाच्च पूर्वतः .. 2 ..
16.153.m: which pacifies all sins and destroys the floods of poverty, / beyond Kṛtasmara and to the east of Agnitīrtha,

16.153.s:
yameśvarācca nairṛtye samudrasyottare tathā ..
tasya liṃgasya prāgbhāge brahmā tepe mahattapaḥ ..
ārādhayāmāsa tadā devadevaṃ trilocanam .. 3 ..
16.153.d:
यमेश्वराच्च नैरृत्ये समुद्रस्योत्तरे तथा ..
तस्य लिंगस्य प्राग्भागे ब्रह्मा तेपे महत्तपः ..
आराधयामास तदा देवदेवं त्रिलोचनम् .. 3 ..
16.153.m: and south-west of Yameśvara, as well as north of the sea. / To the east of that liṅga, Brahmā performed great austerity / and worshipped the three-eyed god of gods.

16.153.s: tatastuṣṭo mahādevo brahmanbrūhi varo mama .. 4 ..
16.153.d: ततस्तुष्टो महादेवो ब्रह्मन्ब्रूहि वरो मम .. 4 ..
16.153.m: Then Mahādeva, being pleased, [said]: "O Brahmā, choose a boon of me."

16.153.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yāja yāmīti me matiḥ ..
sthānaṃ ca yanmahāpuṇyaṃ tanmamākhyātumarhasi .. 5 ..
16.153.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव याज यामीति मे मतिः ..
स्थानं च यन्महापुण्यं तन्ममाख्यातुमर्हसि .. 5 ..
16.153.m: Brahmā said: / If you are pleased with me, O god, my desire is to perform a sacrifice; / you ought to tell me what place is exceedingly sacred.

16.153.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
kṛtasmarādbrahmakuṃḍaṃ yameśātsāgarāvadhi ..
etadaṃtaramāsādya pāpī cāpi vimucyate .. 6 ..
16.153.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
कृतस्मराद्ब्रह्मकुंडं यमेशात्सागरावधि ..
एतदंतरमासाद्य पापी चापि विमुच्यते .. 6 ..
16.153.m: Īśvara said: / From Kṛtasmarā to Brahmakuṇḍa, and from Yameśa up to the ocean, / even a sinner who reaches this area is liberated. // 6

16.153.s:
vahedviṣuvatī tatra sadā puṇyātmanāṃ nṛṇām ..
yatra tatra kuru vibho manasā te yathepsitam .. 7 ..
16.153.d:
वहेद्विषुवती तत्र सदा पुण्यात्मनां नृणाम् ..
यत्र तत्र कुरु विभो मनसा ते यथेप्सितम् .. 7 ..
16.153.m: There the Viṣuvatī ever flows for meritorious men. / O Lord, perform [the sacrifice] wherever you wish in your mind. // 7

16.153.s: ityuktaḥ sa tadā brahmā prārebhe yajñamuttamam .. 8 ..
16.153.d: इत्युक्तः स तदा ब्रह्मा प्रारेभे यज्ञमुत्तमम् .. 8 ..
16.153.m: Thus spoken to, Brahmā then began the supreme sacrifice. // 8

16.153.s:
tato bhāgārthino devā indrādyāstatra cāgatāḥ..
ṛṣayo bhāgakāmāstu sarve tatra samāgatāḥ ..9..
16.153.d:
ततो भागार्थिनो देवा इन्द्राद्यास्तत्र चागताः..
ऋषयो भागकामास्तु सर्वे तत्र समागताः ..9..
16.153.m: Then the gods, Indra and others, came there seeking their share, / and all the seers, desiring their share, assembled there. // 9

16.153.s:
tato yajñāgatebhyaḥ sa dakṣiṇāmadadātpunaḥ ..
tato'tha dakṣiṇā kṣīṇā dīyamānā yaśasvini .. 7.1.153.10 ..
16.153.d:
ततो यज्ञागतेभ्यः स दक्षिणामददात्पुनः ..
ततोऽथ दक्षिणा क्षीणा दीयमाना यशस्विनि .. 7.1.153.10 ..
16.153.m: Then he gave priestly fees again to those who had arrived at the sacrifice. / But then, O renowned lady, as they were being distributed, the priestly fees were exhausted. // 10

16.153.s:
tatobrahmā bahūdvigno dadhyau vai manasā tadā ..
baddhāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 11 ..
16.153.d:
ततोब्रह्मा बहूद्विग्नो दध्यौ वै मनसा तदा ..
बद्धाञ्जलिपुटो भूत्वा इदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 11 ..
16.153.m: Then Brahmā, deeply troubled, meditated in his mind at that time. / Having joined his palms in reverent salutation, he spoke this word: // 11

16.153.s:
bhagavanvai virūpākṣa kraturnaiva samāpyate ..
dakṣiṇāhai(dai?)nyato deva na yāti paripūrṇatām .. 12 ..
16.153.d:
भगवन्वै विरूपाक्ष क्रतुर्नैव समाप्यते ..
दक्षिणाहै(दै?)न्यतो देव न याति परिपूर्णताम् .. 12 ..
16.153.m: “O Lord, Virūpākṣa, the sacrifice is not being concluded; / O God, due to the lack of priestly fees, it does not reach completion. // 12

16.153.s:
dakṣiṇāsahitāḥ sarve yathā yāṃti tathā kuru ..
pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā kṛtvā dhyānaṃ tadā mayā .. 13 ..
16.153.d:
दक्षिणासहिताः सर्वे यथा यांति तथा कुरु ..
पितामहवचः श्रुत्वा कृत्वा ध्यानं तदा मया .. 13 ..
16.153.m: Act in such a way that all depart endowed with priestly fees.” / Having heard the Grandfather’s words and then meditated, / by me, // 13

16.153.s:
smṛtā sarasvatī devī devānāṃ hitakāmyayā ..
āgatā sā mahāpuṇyā uktā devī mayā tadā .. 14 ..
16.153.d:
स्मृता सरस्वती देवी देवानां हितकाम्यया ..
आगता सा महापुण्या उक्ता देवी मया तदा .. 14 ..
16.153.m: goddess Sarasvatī was remembered out of desire for the welfare of the gods. / That most holy goddess arrived, and she was spoken to by me then: // 14

16.153.s:
padmayonerdhanaṃ kṣīṇaṃ kraturvai na samāpyate ..
tasmānmama prasādena bhava kāñcanavāhinī .. 15 ..
16.153.d:
पद्मयोनेर्धनं क्षीणं क्रतुर्वै न समाप्यते ..
तस्मान्मम प्रसादेन भव काञ्चनवाहिनी .. 15 ..
16.153.m: “The lotus-born [Brahmā's] wealth is exhausted, and the sacrifice is not completed; / therefore, by my favor, become a stream carrying gold.” // 15

16.153.s:
sarasvatyāstataḥ srota utthitaṃ paścimāmukham ..
kāñcanānāṃ tu padmāni ucchritāni sahasraśaḥ .. 16 ..
16.153.d:
सरस्वत्यास्ततः स्रोत उत्थितं पश्चिमामुखम् ..
काञ्चनानां तु पद्मानि उच्छ्रितानि सहस्रशः .. 16 ..
16.153.m: Then Sarasvatī's current surged forth flowing westward, / and thousands of golden lotuses arose. // 16

16.153.s:
kāñcanena pravāheṇa toyaṃ sārasvataṃ śubham ..
daityasūdanamāsādya agnitīrthāvadhi priye ..
pūrayāmāsa padmaiśca koṭiśaśca samaṃtataḥ .. 17 ..
16.153.d:
काञ्चनेन प्रवाहेण तोयं सारस्वतं शुभम् ..
दैत्यसूदनमासाद्य अग्नितीर्थावधि प्रिये ..
पूरयामास पद्मैश्च कोटिशश्च समंततः .. 17 ..
16.153.m: Reaching Daityasūdana up to Agnitīrtha, O beloved, / with that golden current the auspicious water of Sarasvatī / filled [the place] on all sides with tens of millions of lotuses. // 17

16.153.s:
kāñcanāni tu tānyeva dattvā vipreṣu dakṣiṇām ..
yajñaṃ nirvartayāmāsa hṛṣṭo brahmā dvijaiḥ saha .. 18 ..
16.153.d:
काञ्चनानि तु तान्येव दत्त्वा विप्रेषु दक्षिणाम् ..
यज्ञं निर्वर्तयामास हृष्टो ब्रह्मा द्विजैः सह .. 18 ..
16.153.m: Having given those very golden [lotuses] as priestly fees to the brahmins, / Brahmā, delighted, completed the sacrifice along with the twice-born. // 18

16.153.s:
śeṣāṇi yāni padmāni tāni niḥkṣipya bhūtale ..
tadūrdhvaṃ sthāpayāmāsa ligaṃ tu kanake śvaram.. 19 ..
16.153.d:
शेषाणि यानि पद्मानि तानि निःक्षिप्य भूतले ..
तदूर्ध्वं स्थापयामास लिगं तु कनके श्वरम्.. 19 ..
16.153.m: Throwing down upon the earth the lotuses that were left over, / he installed the liṅga Kanakeśvara on top of them. // 19

16.153.s:
tatra liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sarvadevanamaskṛtam ..
ṛṣibhyo dakṣiṇāṃ prādādekaikasya yathākramam ..
kāñcanānāṃ ca padmānāṃ pratyekamayutaṃ dadau ..7.1.153.20..
16.153.d:
तत्र लिंगं प्रतिष्ठाप्य सर्वदेवनमस्कृतम् ..
ऋषिभ्यो दक्षिणां प्रादादेकैकस्य यथाक्रमम् ..
काञ्चनानां च पद्मानां प्रत्येकमयुतं ददौ ..7.1.153.20..
16.153.m: Having established there that liṅga bowed to by all the gods, / he gave priestly fees to each of the seers in due order; / to each one he gave ten thousand golden lotuses. // 20

16.153.s:
tataḥ śeṣāṇi padmāni nihitāni dharātale ..
brahmakuṇḍasya madhye tu nāpuṇyo labhate naraḥ ..21..
16.153.d:
ततः शेषाणि पद्मानि निहितानि धरातले ..
ब्रह्मकुण्डस्य मध्ये तु नापुण्यो लभते नरः ..21..
16.153.m: Then the remaining lotuses were placed upon the earth / inside the Brahmakuṇḍa; no unmeritorious man finds them. // 21

16.153.s:
tatkuṇḍatoyamadyāpi nānāvarṇaṃ pradṛśyate ..
tatrādhaḥ padmasaṃyogānnīraṃ svarṇāyate kṣaṇāt .. 22 ..
16.153.d:
तत्कुण्डतोयमद्यापि नानावर्णं प्रदृश्यते ..
तत्राधः पद्मसंयोगान्नीरं स्वर्णायते क्षणात् .. 22 ..
16.153.m: The water of that pool is seen to be multicolored even today. / Through contact with the lotuses below it, the water turns golden in an instant. // 22

16.153.s:
hiraṇmayāni padmāni adhaḥ kṛtvā prajāpatiḥ ..
liṃgamūrdhvaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya svayaṃ pūjitavāṃstadā ..
hiraṇyakamalairdivyairhiraṇyeśastato'bhavat .. 23 ..
16.153.d:
हिरण्मयानि पद्मानि अधः कृत्वा प्रजापतिः ..
लिंगमूर्ध्वं प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्वयं पूजितवांस्तदा ..
हिरण्यकमलैर्दिव्यैर्हिरण्येशस्ततोऽभवत् .. 23 ..
16.153.m: Prajāpati, having placed the golden lotuses beneath / and established the liṅga above, then worshipped it himself. / Because of the divine golden lotuses, it became Hiraṇyeśa. // 23

16.153.s:
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ tathā dāridryanāśanam ..
dṛṣṭvā hiraṇmayeśānaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 24 ..
16.153.d:
सर्वपापप्रशमनं तथा दारिद्र्यनाशनम् ..
दृष्ट्वा हिरण्मयेशानं सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 24 ..
16.153.m: It pacifies all sins and destroys poverty. / Having seen Hiraṇmayeśāna, one is freed from all sins. // 24

16.153.s:
māgha māse caturdaśyāṃ yastalliṃgaṃ prapūjayet ..
pūjitaṃ tena sakalaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaram .. 25 ..
16.153.d:
माघ मासे चतुर्दश्यां यस्तल्लिंगं प्रपूजयेत् ..
पूजितं तेन सकलं ब्रह्माण्डं सचराचरम् .. 25 ..
16.153.m: Whoever worships that liṅga on the fourteenth day of the month of Māgha / has worshipped the entire universe with its moving and unmoving beings. // 25

16.153.s:
sarvadānāni dattāni sarve devāśca toṣitāḥ ..
brahmāṇḍaṃ tena dattaṃ syādyena talliṃgamarcitam .. 26 ..
16.153.d:
सर्वदानानि दत्तानि सर्वे देवाश्च तोषिताः ..
ब्रह्माण्डं तेन दत्तं स्याद्येन तल्लिंगमर्चितम् .. 26 ..
16.153.m: All gifts are given, and all the gods are pleased; / the universe is as good as given by him who has worshipped that liṅga. // 26

16.153.s:
etanmayā te kathitaṃ snehena varavarṇini ..
na kasyacinmayā''khyātaṃ mahāgopyaṃ varānane . 27 ..
16.153.d:
एतन्मया ते कथितं स्नेहेन वरवर्णिनि ..
न कस्यचिन्मया'ऽख्यातं महागोप्यं वरानने . 27 ..
16.153.m: This has been told to you by me out of affection, O fair-complexioned lady; / it has not been told to anyone by me, being a great secret, O beautiful-faced lady. // 27

16.153.s:
ya idaṃ śṛyuyādbhaktyā paṭhedvā bhaktisaṃyutaḥ ..
sa gaccheddevalokaṃ tu muktaḥ sarvaistu pātakaiḥ .. 28 ..
16.153.d:
य इदं शृयुयाद्भक्त्या पठेद्वा भक्तिसंयुतः ..
स गच्छेद्देवलोकं तु मुक्तः सर्वैस्तु पातकैः .. 28 ..
16.153.m: Whoever hears this with devotion, or reads it endowed with devotion, / freed from all sins, goes to the world of the gods. // 28

16.153.s:
iti te cātivikhyātāḥ pavitrāḥ pañca bhairavāḥ ..
brahmakuṇḍasamīpasthāḥ kathitāstava sundari .. 29 ..
16.153.d:
इति ते चातिविख्याताः पवित्राः पञ्च भैरवाः ..
ब्रह्मकुण्डसमीपस्थाः कथितास्तव सुन्दरि .. 29 ..
16.153.m: Thus the five pure, exceedingly renowned Bhairavas / situated near Brahmakuṇḍa have been described to you, O beautiful woman. // 29

16.153.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmakuṇḍamāhātmye hiraṇyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tripañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 153 .. ..
16.153.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ब्रह्मकुण्डमाहात्म्ये हिरण्येश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिपञ्चाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 153 .. ..
16.153.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fifty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Hiraṇyeśvara' in the Glory of Brahmakuṇḍa, in the Glory of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, the first [part] in the Prabhāsa Section, the seventh [book] in the Śrī Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse collection. // 153

16.154.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ pāpavimocanam ..
hiraṇyeśvaravāyavye dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam .. 1 ..
16.154.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं पापविमोचनम् ..
हिरण्येश्वरवायव्ये धनुषां त्रितये स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.154.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the sin-releasing liṅga / situated three bow-lengths to the northwest of Hiraṇyeśvara. // 1

16.154.s:
pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi ..
ādyaṃ liṃgaṃ mahādevi gāyatryā saṃpratiṣṭhitam .. 2 ..
16.154.d:
पापघ्नं सर्वजंतूनां दर्शनात्स्पर्शनादपि ..
आद्यं लिंगं महादेवि गायत्र्या संप्रतिष्ठितम् .. 2 ..
16.154.m: It destroys the sins of all creatures by its sight and even by its touch, / the primordial liṅga established by Gāyatrī, O great goddess. // 2

16.154.s:
talliṃgaṃ samanuprāpya gāyatrīṃ japate tu yaḥ ..
brāhmaṇastu śucirbhūtvā mucyate duṣpratigrahāt .. 3 ..
16.154.d:
तल्लिंगं समनुप्राप्य गायत्रीं जपते तु यः ..
ब्राह्मणस्तु शुचिर्भूत्वा मुच्यते दुष्प्रतिग्रहात् .. 3 ..
16.154.m: Having approached that liṅga, whoever mutters the Gāyatrī, / having become pure, a brahmin is freed from [the sin of] improper acceptance [of gifts]. // 3

16.154.s:
jyeṣṭhasya pūrṇimāyāṃ tu daṃpatī yastu bhojayet ..
paridhāpya yathāśaktyā daurbhāgyairmucyate naraḥ .. 4 ..
16.154.d:
ज्येष्ठस्य पूर्णिमायां तु दंपती यस्तु भोजयेत् ..
परिधाप्य यथाशक्त्या दौर्भाग्यैर्मुच्यते नरः .. 4 ..
16.154.m: Whoever feeds a married couple on the full moon of Jyeṣṭha, / clothing them according to his capacity, that man is freed from misfortunes. // 4

16.154.s:
gaṃdhapuṣpopahāraiśca paurṇamāsyāṃ tu yo'rcayet ..
brāhmaṇyaṃ jāyate tasya sapta janmāni suṃdari .. 5 ..
16.154.d:
गंधपुष्पोपहारैश्च पौर्णमास्यां तु योऽर्चयेत् ..
ब्राह्मण्यं जायते तस्य सप्त जन्मानि सुंदरि .. 5 ..
16.154.m: And whoever worships on the full moon day with offerings of scents and flowers, / brahminhood is attained by him for seven births, O beautiful lady. // 5

16.154.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
brahmakuṇḍaprasādena sārātsārataraṃ priye .. 6 ..
16.154.d:
इत्येवं कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं पापनाशनम् ..
ब्रह्मकुण्डप्रसादेन सारात्सारतरं प्रिये .. 6 ..
16.154.m: Thus the sin-destroying glory has been told, O goddess, / through the grace of Brahmakuṇḍa, more essential than the essential, O beloved. // 6

16.154.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmakuṇḍamāhātmye gāyatrīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥpañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 154 ..
16.154.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ब्रह्मकुण्डमाहात्म्ये गायत्रीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुःपञ्चाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 154 ..
16.154.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fifty-fourth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Gāyatrīśvara' in the Glory of Brahmakuṇḍa, in the Glory of Prabhāsa Sacred Field, the first [part] in the Prabhāsa Section, the seventh [book] in the Śrī Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, an eighty-one-thousand-verse collection. // 154

16.155.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi ratneśvaramanuttamam ..
tatra taptvā tapo devi viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ..
sthāpitaṃ tatra talliṃgaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ priye .. 1 ..
16.155.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि रत्नेश्वरमनुत्तमम् ..
तत्र तप्त्वा तपो देवि विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ..
स्थापितं तत्र तल्लिंगं सर्वकामप्रदं प्रिये .. 1 ..
16.155.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the unsurpassed Ratneśvara. / Having performed austerity there, O goddess, by the all-powerful Viṣṇu / that liṅga granting all desires was established there, O beloved. // 1

16.155.s:
ratnakuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā yastaṃ pūjayate sadā ..
sarvopacārairbhaktyā sa prāpnuyādīpsitaṃ phalam .. 2 ..
16.155.d:
रत्नकुंडे नरः स्नात्वा यस्तं पूजयते सदा ..
सर्वोपचारैर्भक्त्या स प्राप्नुयादीप्सितं फलम् .. 2 ..
16.155.m: A man who bathes in Ratnakuṇḍa and constantly worships it / with all services and devotion, obtains his desired reward. // 2

16.155.s:
atra kṛtvā tapo ghoraṃ kṛṣṇenāmitatejasā ..
prāptaṃ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ sarvadaityāntakārakam .. 3 ..
16.155.d:
अत्र कृत्वा तपो घोरं कृष्णेनामिततेजसा ..
प्राप्तं सुदर्शनं चक्रं सर्वदैत्यान्तकारकम् .. 3 ..
16.155.m: Having performed severe austerity here, by Kṛṣṇa of boundless splendor / was obtained the Sudarśana discus that brings an end to all daityas. // 3

16.155.s:
etatsthānaṃ mahādevi sadā priyataraṃ mama ..
vasāmi tatra deveśi pralaye'pi na saṃtyaje .. 4 ..
16.155.d:
एतत्स्थानं महादेवि सदा प्रियतरं मम ..
वसामि तत्र देवेशि प्रलयेऽपि न संत्यजे .. 4 ..
16.155.m: This place, O great goddess, is ever very dear to me; / I dwell there, O ruler of the gods, and even at universal dissolution I do not abandon it. // 4

16.155.s:
smṛtaṃ tadvaiṣṇavaṃ kṣetraṃ nāmnā devi sudarśanam ..
dhanvaṃtarāṇi ṣaṭtriṃśatsamaṃtātparimaṇḍalam .. 5 ..
16.155.d:
स्मृतं तद्वैष्णवं क्षेत्रं नाम्ना देवि सुदर्शनम् ..
धन्वंतराणि षट्त्रिंशत्समंतात्परिमण्डलम् .. 5 ..
16.155.m: That Vaiṣṇava sacred field is known by the name Sudarśana, O goddess; / its circumference on all sides is thirty-six bow-lengths. // 5

16.155.s:
etadantaramāsādya ye kecitprāṇino'dhamāḥ ..
mṛtāḥ kālavaśāddevi te yāsyaṃti paraṃ padam .. 6 ..
16.155.d:
एतदन्तरमासाद्य ये केचित्प्राणिनोऽधमाः ..
मृताः कालवशाद्देवि ते यास्यंति परं पदम् .. 6 ..
16.155.m: Whosoever the base living beings that reach this space / and die under the power of Time, O goddess, they shall go to the supreme state. // 6

16.155.s:
kāṃcanaṃ tatra garuḍaṃ pītāni vasanāni ca ..
viṣṇumuddiśya yo dadyātsa tu yātrāphalaṃ labhet .. 7 ..
16.155.d:
कांचनं तत्र गरुडं पीतानि वसनानि च ..
विष्णुमुद्दिश्य यो दद्यात्स तु यात्राफलं लभेत् .. 7 ..
16.155.m: Whoever offers there a golden Garuḍa and yellow garments / dedicated to Viṣṇu, he obtains the fruit of the pilgrimage. // 7

16.155.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye ratneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcapaṃcāśadu ttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 155 ..
16.155.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये रत्नेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पंचपंचाशदु त्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 155 ..
16.155.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fifty-fifth chapter, named "Description of the Greatness of Ratneśvara", in the first [part], the "Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya", in the seventh section, the "Prabhāsakhaṇḍa", of the glorious Skandamahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.156.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi vainateyapratiṣṭhitam ..
ratneśvarāduttarato dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam .. 1 ..
16.156.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि वैनतेयप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
रत्नेश्वरादुत्तरतो धनुषां त्रितये स्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.156.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to [the liṅga] consecrated by the son of Vinatā, / situated three bows to the north of Ratneśvara.

16.156.s:
vainateyaśca deveśi jñātvā kṣetraṃ tu vaiṣṇavam ..
liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 2 ..
16.156.d:
वैनतेयश्च देवेशि ज्ञात्वा क्षेत्रं तु वैष्णवम् ..
लिंगं प्रतिष्ठयामास सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 2 ..
16.156.m: And the son of Vinatā, O ruler of the gods, knowing it to be a Vaiṣṇava sacred field, / consecrated a liṅga that destroys all sins.

16.156.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā paṃcamyāṃ tu vidhānataḥ ..
na viṣaṃ kramate tasya sapta janmāni sarpajam .. 3 ..
16.156.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या पंचम्यां तु विधानतः ..
न विषं क्रमते तस्य सप्त जन्मानि सर्पजम् .. 3 ..
16.156.m: Whoever worships it with devotion on the fifth lunar day according to rule, / snake poison will not affect him for seven births.

16.156.s:
paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ..
prāpnuyātsakalaṃ puṇyaṃ modate divi devavat .. 4 ..
16.156.d:
पंचामृतेन संस्नाप्य पूजयित्वा विधानतः ..
प्राप्नुयात्सकलं पुण्यं मोदते दिवि देववत् .. 4 ..
16.156.m: Having bathed it with the five nectars and worshiped it according to rule, / one attains all religious merit and rejoices like a god in heaven.

16.156.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye ratneśvaramāhātmye garuḍeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 156 ..
16.156.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये रत्नेश्वरमाहात्म्ये गरुडेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्पंचाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 156 ..
16.156.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fifty-sixth chapter, named "Description of the Greatness of Garuḍeśvara within the Greatness of Ratneśvara", in the first [part], the "Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya", in the seventh section, the "Prabhāsakhaṇḍa", of the glorious Skandamahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.157.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi satyabhāmeśvaraṃ śubham ..
ratneśvarāddakṣiṇe tu dhanuṣāṃtaramāsthitam .. 1 ..
16.157.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि सत्यभामेश्वरं शुभम् ..
रत्नेश्वराद्दक्षिणे तु धनुषांतरमास्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.157.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the auspicious Satyabhāmeśvara, / situated at a distance of one bow to the south of Ratneśvara,

16.157.s:
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sthāpitaṃ satyabhāmayā ..
kṛṣṇasya kāntayā devi rūpaudāryasametayā .. 2 ..
16.157.d:
सर्वपापप्रशमनं स्थापितं सत्यभामया ..
कृष्णस्य कान्तया देवि रूपौदार्यसमेतया .. 2 ..
16.157.m: which relieves all sins and was installed by Satyabhāmā, / Kṛṣṇa's beloved wife, O goddess, endowed with beauty and nobility.
Having bathed there, that Vaiṣṇava place destroys the sins of men.

16.157.s:
māghe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā ..
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā sa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet .. 4 ..
16.157.d:
माघे मासि तृतीयायां नारी वा पुरुषोऽपि वा ..
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या स मुक्तः पातकैर्भवेत् .. 4 ..
16.157.m: In the month of Māgha on the third lunar day, whether a woman or a man, / whoever worships it with devotion becomes freed from sins.

16.157.s:
daurbhāgyaduḥkhaśokebhyastathā vighnaiśca duḥkhitaḥ ..
mucyate nātra saṃdehaḥ satyabhāmānvito bhavet .. 5 ..
16.157.d:
दौर्भाग्यदुःखशोकेभ्यस्तथा विघ्नैश्च दुःखितः ..
मुच्यते नात्र संदेहः सत्यभामान्वितो भवेत् .. 5 ..
16.157.m: One who is distressed by misfortune, sorrow, and grief, as well as by obstacles, / is freed—of this there is no doubt—and will be endowed with true splendour.

16.157.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye satyabhāmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptapañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 157 ..
16.157.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सत्यभामेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तपञ्चाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 157 ..
16.157.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fifty-seventh chapter, named "Description of the Greatness of Satyabhāmeśvara", in the first [part], the "Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya", in the seventh section, the "Prabhāsakhaṇḍa", of the glorious Skandamahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.158.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi anaṃgeśvaramuttamam ..
ratneśvarādagrataḥsthaṃ dhanuṣāntaramāsthitam .. 1 ..
16.158.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि अनंगेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
रत्नेश्वरादग्रतःस्थं धनुषान्तरमास्थितम् .. 1 ..
16.158.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the supreme Anaṅgeśvara, / situated in front of Ratneśvara at a distance of one bow.

16.158.s:
sthāpitaṃ kāmadevena talliṃgaṃ viṣṇusūnunā ..
jñātvā tadvaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ kalau pātakanāśanam .. 2 ..
16.158.d:
स्थापितं कामदेवेन तल्लिंगं विष्णुसूनुना ..
ज्ञात्वा तद्वैष्णवं स्थानं कलौ पातकनाशनम् .. 2 ..
16.158.m: That liṅga was established by Kāmadeva, the son of Viṣṇu, / knowing it to be a Vaiṣṇava place that destroys sins in the Kali age.

16.158.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā tu kāmadevasamo bhavet ..
svargavidyādharīṇāṃ ca jāyate cittamohakaḥ .. 3 ..
16.158.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा पूजयित्वा तु कामदेवसमो भवेत् ..
स्वर्गविद्याधरीणां च जायते चित्तमोहकः .. 3 ..
16.158.m: Having seen and worshiped it, one becomes equal to Kāmadeva, / and becomes one who captivates the minds of the heavenly Vidyādharīs.
In his lineage, moreover, no one will be ugly or unfortunate.

16.158.s:
tatrānaṃgatrayodaśyāṃ vratena varavarṇini ..
viśeṣārādhanaṃ tatra janmasāphalyakāraṇam .. 5 ..
16.158.d:
तत्रानंगत्रयोदश्यां व्रतेन वरवर्णिनि ..
विशेषाराधनं तत्र जन्मसाफल्यकारणम् .. 5 ..
16.158.m: There, on the thirteenth lunar day sacred to Anaṅga, by observance of the vow, O fair-complexioned one, / special worship is the cause of making one's birth fruitful.

16.158.s:
śayyādānaṃ tu dātavyaṃ tatra viprāya śīline ..
viśeṣādviṣṇubhaktāya samyagyātrāphalaṃ labhet .. 6 ..
16.158.d:
शय्यादानं तु दातव्यं तत्र विप्राय शीलिने ..
विशेषाद्विष्णुभक्ताय सम्यग्यात्राफलं लभेत् .. 6 ..
16.158.m: A gift of a bed should be given there to a virtuous brahmin, / especially to a devotee of Viṣṇu; one thereby obtains the full fruit of the pilgrimage.

16.158.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye ratneśvaramāhātmye'naṃgeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭapaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 158 ..
16.158.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये रत्नेश्वरमाहात्म्येऽनंगेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टपंचाशदुत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 158 ..
16.158.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fifty-eighth chapter, named "Description of the Greatness of Anaṅgeśvara within the Greatness of Ratneśvara", in the first [part], the "Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya", in the seventh section, the "Prabhāsakhaṇḍa", of the glorious Skandamahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.159.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi ratnakuṇḍamanuttamam ..
ratneśāddakṣiṇe bhāge dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam ..
mahāpāpopaśamanaṃ viṣṇunā nirmitaṃ svayam .. 1 ..
16.159.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि रत्नकुण्डमनुत्तमम् ..
रत्नेशाद्दक्षिणे भागे धनुषां सप्तके स्थितम् ..
महापापोपशमनं विष्णुना निर्मितं स्वयम् .. 1 ..
16.159.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the unsurpassed Ratnakuṇḍa, / situated on the southern side of Ratneśa at a distance of seven bows, / which alleviates great sins and was fashioned by Viṣṇu himself.

16.159.s:
aṣṭakoṭīstu tīrthāni bhūdyo'ntarikṣagāṇi tu ..
samānīya tu kṛṣṇena tatra kṣiptāni bhūriśaḥ .. 2 ..
16.159.d:
अष्टकोटीस्तु तीर्थानि भूद्योऽन्तरिक्षगाणि तु ..
समानीय तु कृष्णेन तत्र क्षिप्तानि भूरिशः .. 2 ..
16.159.m: Eighty million sacred fords moving on earth, in heaven, and in the atmosphere / were brought together by Kṛṣṇa and cast there in abundance.

16.159.s:
gaṇānāṃ koṭirekā tu tatkuṇḍaṃ rakṣati priye ..
kalau yuge tu saṃprāpte duṣprāpyamakṛtātmabhiḥ .. 3 ..
16.159.d:
गणानां कोटिरेका तु तत्कुण्डं रक्षति प्रिये ..
कलौ युगे तु संप्राप्ते दुष्प्राप्यमकृतात्मभिः .. 3 ..
16.159.m: A crore of Gaṇas protects that kuṇḍa, O beloved; / when the Kali age has arrived, it is hard to attain for those whose minds are undisciplined.

16.159.s:
tatra snātvā mahādevi vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā ..
prāpnuyādaśvamedhasya phalaṃ śataguṇottaram .. 4 ..
16.159.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा महादेवि विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा ..
प्राप्नुयादश्वमेधस्य फलं शतगुणोत्तरम् .. 4 ..
16.159.m: Having bathed there, O great goddess, by an act observed according to rule, / one attains a hundredfold the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

16.159.s:
ekādaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa piṃḍaṃ tatra pradāpayet ..
akṣayyāṃ tṛptimāyāṃti pitarastasya bhāmini .. 5 ..
16.159.d:
एकादश्यां विशेषेण पिंडं तत्र प्रदापयेत् ..
अक्षय्यां तृप्तिमायांति पितरस्तस्य भामिनि .. 5 ..
16.159.m: Especially on the eleventh lunar day, one should offer the piṇḍa there; / his ancestors attain imperishable satisfaction, O passionate woman.

16.159.s:
kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ tatra ekādaśyāṃ vidhānataḥ ..
vāñchitaṃ labhate devi yadi śraddhā dṛḍhā bhavet .. 6 ..
16.159.d:
कुर्याज्जागरणं तत्र एकादश्यां विधानतः ..
वाञ्छितं लभते देवि यदि श्रद्धा दृढा भवेत् .. 6 ..
16.159.m: One should keep a night-vigil there on the eleventh lunar day according to rule; / one obtains what is desired, O goddess, if one's faith is firm.

16.159.s:
deyāni pītavastrāṇi tathā dhenuḥ payasvinī ..
tatra viṣṇuṃ samuddiśya samyagyātrāphalāptaye .. 7 ..
16.159.d:
देयानि पीतवस्त्राणि तथा धेनुः पयस्विनी ..
तत्र विष्णुं समुद्दिश्य सम्यग्यात्राफलाप्तये .. 7 ..
16.159.m: Yellow clothes should be given, as well as a milch cow, / there in honour of Viṣṇu, for attaining the full fruit of the pilgrimage.

16.159.s:
hemakuṇḍaṃ kṛte proktaṃ tretāyāṃ raupyanāmakam ..
dvāpare cakrakuṃḍaṃ tu ratnakuṃḍaṃ kalau smṛtam .. 8 ..
16.159.d:
हेमकुण्डं कृते प्रोक्तं त्रेतायां रौप्यनामकम् ..
द्वापरे चक्रकुंडं तु रत्नकुंडं कलौ स्मृतम् .. 8 ..
16.159.m: In the Kṛta age it is called Hemakuṇḍa, in the Tretā age named Raupya; / in the Dvāpara age it is Cakrakuṇḍa, and in the Kali age it is remembered as Ratnakuṇḍa.

16.159.s:
pātālavāhinīgaṃgā srotāṃsi tatra bhūriśaḥ ..
samānītāni hariṇā tatra tiṣṭhaṃti bhāmini .. 9 ..
16.159.d:
पातालवाहिनीगंगा स्रोतांसि तत्र भूरिशः ..
समानीतानि हरिणा तत्र तिष्ठंति भामिनि .. 9 ..
16.159.m: Numerous streams of the Gaṅgā flowing in Pātāla / were brought there by Hari and remain there, O passionate woman.
By bathing there, O ruler of the gods, there is ablution in all sacred fords.

16.159.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye ratneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ- nāmaikonaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..159..
16.159.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये रत्नेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनं- नामैकोनषष्ट्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ..159..
16.159.m: Thus ends the one hundred and fifty-ninth chapter, named "Description of the Greatness of Ratneśvara", in the first [part], the "Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya", in the seventh section, the "Prabhāsakhaṇḍa", of the glorious Skandamahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.160.s:
.. .. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi rājabhaṭṭārakaṃ param ..
raivantakaṃ sūryaputramaśvārūḍhaṃ mahābalam .. 1 ..
16.160.d:
.. .. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि राजभट्टारकं परम् ..
रैवन्तकं सूर्यपुत्रमश्वारूढं महाबलम् .. 1 ..
16.160.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the supreme Rājabhaṭṭāraka, / Raivantaka, the son of the Sun, mounted on a horse, endowed with great strength,

16.160.s:
saṃsthitaṃ kṣetramadhye tu sāvitryā nairṛte priye ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi sarvāpadbhyo vimucyate ..2..
16.160.d:
संस्थितं क्षेत्रमध्ये तु सावित्र्या नैरृते प्रिये ..
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि सर्वापद्भ्यो विमुच्यते ..2..
16.160.m: situated in the middle of the sacred field to the south-west of Sāvitrī, O beloved; / having seen him, O goddess, a human being is delivered from all distress.

16.160.s:
ravivāreṇa saptamyāṃ yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ ..
tasyā'nvaye'pi no devi daridrī jāyate naraḥ..3..
16.160.d:
रविवारेण सप्तम्यां यस्तं पूजयते नरः ..
तस्याऽन्वयेऽपि नो देवि दरिद्री जायते नरः..3..
16.160.m: The person who worships him on a Sunday on the seventh lunar day— / even in his lineage, O goddess, no person becomes impoverished.

16.160.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tamevārādhayenmanāk ..
nirvighnaṃ kṣetravāsārthaṃ rājā vā'śvavivṛddhaye .. 4 ..
16.160.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तमेवाराधयेन्मनाक् ..
निर्विघ्नं क्षेत्रवासार्थं राजा वाऽश्वविवृद्धये .. 4 ..
16.160.m: Therefore, with every effort, one should worship only him for a while, / for dwelling in the sacred field without obstacles, or a king [should worship him] for the increase of horses.

16.160.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye raivaṃtakarājabhaṭṭārakamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 160 ..
16.160.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये रैवंतकराजभट्टारकमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षष्ट्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 160 ..
16.160.m: Thus ends the one hundred and sixtieth chapter, named "Description of the Greatness of Raivantaka-Rājabhaṭṭāraka", in the first [part], the "Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya", in the seventh section, the "Prabhāsakhaṇḍa", of the glorious Skandamahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.161.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tasya dakṣiṇataḥ sthitam ..
īśāne lakṣmaṇeśācca dhanuṣāṃ ṣoḍaśe priye ..1..
16.161.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तस्य दक्षिणतः स्थितम् ..
ईशाने लक्ष्मणेशाच्च धनुषां षोडशे प्रिये ..1..
16.161.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to [the liṅga] situated to its south, / and sixteen bows northeast of Lakṣmaṇeśa, O beloved,

16.161.s:
ananteśvaranāmānamanantena pratiṣṭhitam ..
nāgarājena deveśi jñātvā kṣetraṃ tu pāvanam .. 2 ..
16.161.d:
अनन्तेश्वरनामानमनन्तेन प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
नागराजेन देवेशि ज्ञात्वा क्षेत्रं तु पावनम् .. 2 ..
16.161.m: named Ananteśvara, consecrated by Ananta, / the king of serpents, O ruler of the gods, knowing it to be a purifying sacred field.

16.161.s:
yastu taṃ pūjayeddevi paṃcamyāṃ phālgune site ..
pañcopacāravidhinā jitāhāro jitendriyaḥ .. 3 ..
16.161.d:
यस्तु तं पूजयेद्देवि पंचम्यां फाल्गुने सिते ..
पञ्चोपचारविधिना जिताहारो जितेन्द्रियः .. 3 ..
16.161.m: Whoever worships it, O goddess, on the fifth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Phālguna / by the ritual of five offerings, having conquered his food and mastered his senses,

16.161.s:
na taṃ daśaṃti phaṇino daśa varṣāṇi paṃca ca ..
viṣaṃ na kramate devi dehe tvacarameva vā .. 4 ..
16.161.d:
न तं दशंति फणिनो दश वर्षाणि पंच च ..
विषं न क्रमते देवि देहे त्वचरमेव वा .. 4 ..
16.161.m: hooded serpents do not bite him for fifteen years; / poison does not penetrate, O goddess, his body or his very skin.
Therefore, one should worship it with effort, and especially on the fifth [lunar day].

16.161.s:
tatrānaṃtavrataṃ kāryaṃ madhupāyasasaṃyutam ..
pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ deyaṃ viprāya bhojanam .. 6 ..
16.161.d:
तत्रानंतव्रतं कार्यं मधुपायससंयुतम् ..
पायसं मधुसंयुक्तं देयं विप्राय भोजनम् .. 6 ..
16.161.m: There, the Ananta-observance should be performed, accompanied by honey and milk-rice. / Milk-rice mixed with honey should be given as food to a brahmin.

16.161.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'nanteśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 161 ..
16.161.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽनन्तेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकषष्ट्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 161 ..
16.161.m: Thus ends the one hundred sixty-first chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Ananteśvara', in the first [section,] the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [book,] the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.162.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tasmāddakṣiṇataḥ sthitam ..
lakṣmaṇeśācca pūrvasmim̐lliṃgamaṣṭakuleśvaram .. 1 ..
16.162.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तस्माद्दक्षिणतः स्थितम् ..
लक्ष्मणेशाच्च पूर्वस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगमष्टकुलेश्वरम् .. 1 ..
16.162.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the liṅga Aṣṭakuleśvara, situated to the south of that / and to the east of Lakṣmaṇeśa.
It dispels all sins and completely destroys great poisons; / worshipped by siddhas and gandharvas, it bestows desired objects.

16.162.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate martyaḥ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ vidhānataḥ ..
sa muktaḥ pātakairghorairnāgaloke mahīyate .. 3 ..
16.162.d:
यस्तं पूजयते मर्त्यः कृष्णाष्टम्यां विधानतः ..
स मुक्तः पातकैर्घोरैर्नागलोके महीयते .. 3 ..
16.162.m: Whatever mortal worships it according to the injunctions on the dark eighth [lunar day], / freed from terrible sins, is glorified in the world of nāgas.

16.162.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'ṣṭakuleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviṣaṣṭyuttara śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 162 ..
16.162.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽष्टकुलेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विषष्ट्युत्तर शततमोऽध्यायः .. 162 ..
16.162.m: Thus ends the one hundred sixty-second chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Aṣṭakuleśvara', in the first [section,] the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [book,] the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.163.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tasmātpūrveṇa saṃsthitam ..
nāsatyeśvaranāmānaṃ mahā kalmaṣanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.163.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तस्मात्पूर्वेण संस्थितम् ..
नासत्येश्वरनामानं महा कल्मषनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.163.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the [liṅga] named Nāsatyeśvara, situated to the east of that, / which destroys great impurities.

16.163.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nāsatyeśvarāśvineśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 163 ..
16.163.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नासत्येश्वराश्विनेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिषष्ट्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 163 ..
16.163.m: Thus ends the one hundred sixty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Nāsatyeśvara and Aśvineśvara', in the first [section,] the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [book,] the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.164.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tasmātpūrveṇa saṃsthitam ..
mahāpāpaughaśamanaṃ pūjitaṃ sarvakāmadam .. 1 ..
16.164.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तस्मात्पूर्वेण संस्थितम् ..
महापापौघशमनं पूजितं सर्वकामदम् .. 1 ..
16.164.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to that situated to the east of that, / which calms the flood of great sins, is worshipped, and grants all desires.

16.164.s:
aśvineśvaranāmānaṃ dhanuṣāṃ paṃcake sthitam ..
sarvarogapraśamanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ sarvārthasādhakam .. 2 ..
16.164.d:
अश्विनेश्वरनामानं धनुषां पंचके स्थितम् ..
सर्वरोगप्रशमनं दृष्टं सर्वार्थसाधकम् .. 2 ..
16.164.m: Named Aśvineśvara, situated within five bows' length, / it alleviates all diseases; seen, it accomplishes all aims.

16.164.s:
ye kecidrogiṇo loke teṣāṃ tadbheṣajaṃ mahat ..
māghamāse dvitīyāyāṃ darśanaṃ tasya durlabham .. 3 ..
16.164.d:
ये केचिद्रोगिणो लोके तेषां तद्भेषजं महत् ..
माघमासे द्वितीयायां दर्शनं तस्य दुर्लभम् .. 3 ..
16.164.m: Whatever diseased people there are in the world, for them it is a great medicine. / In the month of Māgha, on the second [lunar day], the darśana of it is hard to attain.

16.164.s:
tasmātpaśyecca tadbhaktyā yadi śreyo'bhikāṃkṣitam ..
mahāpāpaughaśamanaṃ pūjitaṃ sarvakāmadam .. 4 ..
16.164.d:
तस्मात्पश्येच्च तद्भक्त्या यदि श्रेयोऽभिकांक्षितम् ..
महापापौघशमनं पूजितं सर्वकामदम् .. 4 ..
16.164.m: Therefore, one should behold it with devotion if the highest good is desired; / it calms the flood of great sins, is worshipped, and grants all desires.

16.164.s:
iti liṅgadvayaṃ devi sūryaputrapratiṣṭhitam ..
tasminneva dine paśyetsaṃyatātmā narottamaḥ .. 5 ..
16.164.d:
इति लिङ्गद्वयं देवि सूर्यपुत्रप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
तस्मिन्नेव दिने पश्येत्संयतात्मा नरोत्तमः .. 5 ..
16.164.m: Thus, O goddess, the pair of liṅgas was installed by the sons of the Sun. / On that very day, with self restrained, the best of men should behold [them].

16.164.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'śvineśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 164 ..
16.164.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येऽश्विनेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुःषष्ट्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः .. 164 ..
16.164.m: Thus ends the one hundred sixty-fourth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Aśvineśvara', in the first [section,] the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [book,] the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
